namespace CraneOptimizer.Application.Optimization.GeneticAlgorithms.Calculations
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Contains engineering calculations used for crane lift evaluation.
    /// This class is stateless and provides only static helper methods.
    /// </summary>
    public static class LiftCalculation
    {
        // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
        // RADIUS CALCULATION
        // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

        /// <summary>
        /// Calculates the working radius between the crane position
        /// and the element center of gravity (COG).
        ///
        /// For horizontal elements (slabs, beams laid flat):
        ///   radius = horizontal distance + halfElementLength
        ///   Reason: the crane must reach the far edge of a horizontal element,
        ///           not just its COG.
        ///
        /// For vertical elements (columns, walls standing upright):
        ///   radius = horizontal distance only
        ///   Reason: the element footprint is small in plan — the COG is the
        ///           correct reference point and no length offset is needed.
        ///
        /// Note: RiggingLength is NOT added here.
        ///       Rigging (slings/chains) runs vertically, so it affects
        ///       lift height only — see CalculateLiftHeight.
        /// </summary>
        public static double CalculateRadius(
            DomainPoint3D cranePosition,
            PrecastElement element)
        {
            double dx = cranePosition.X - element.ElementCOG.X;
            double dy = cranePosition.Y - element.ElementCOG.Y;

            double horizontalDistance = Math.Sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);

            // Only add half-length offset for horizontal elements.
            // An element is considered horizontal when its plan footprint
            // (length or width) is larger than its height.
            double lengthOffset = IsHorizontalElement(element)
                ? (element.ElementLength ?? 0) / 2.0
                : 0.0;

            return horizontalDistance + lengthOffset;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Determines whether an element is oriented horizontally in plan.
        ///
        /// Horizontal elements (slabs, beams) have their longest dimension
        /// in the X-Y plane → their plan length or width exceeds their height.
        ///
        /// Vertical elements (columns, walls) have height > plan dimensions.
        /// </summary>
        private static bool IsHorizontalElement(PrecastElement element)
        {
            double length = element.ElementLength ?? 0;
            double height = element.ElementHeight ?? 0;

            // If height data is missing, fall back to treating as horizontal
            // (conservative choice — adds the length offset).
            if (height <= 0)
                return true;

            return length > height;
        }

        // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
        // HEIGHT CALCULATION
        // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

        /// <summary>
        /// Calculates the required vertical lift height.
        ///
        /// Formula:
        ///   height = COG.Z + halfElementHeight + RiggingLength
        ///
        ///   COG.Z            → elevation of element center
        ///   halfElementHeight → from COG to the top of the element
        ///   RiggingLength    → vertical sling/chain length above the element
        ///
        /// This gives the required hook height above ground.
        /// </summary>
        public static double CalculateLiftHeight(
            PrecastElement element,
            GASettings settings)
        {
            double elementHalfHeight = (element.ElementHeight ?? 0) / 2.0;

            return element.ElementCOG.Z
                   + elementHalfHeight
                   + settings.RiggingLength;
        }

        // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
        // BOOM LENGTH CALCULATION
        // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

        /// <summary>
        /// Calculates the required boom length using the Pythagorean theorem.
        ///
        ///   BoomLength = √(Radius² + Height²)
        ///
        /// This represents the straight-line distance from the crane pivot
        /// to the hook position in 3D space.
        /// </summary>
        public static double CalculateRequiredBoomLength(
            double radius,
            double height)
        {
            return Math.Sqrt(radius * radius + height * height);
        }

        // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
        // LOAD CHART LOOKUP
        // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

        /// <summary>
        /// Looks up the available crane capacity from the load chart
        /// for the given radius and boom length.
        ///
        /// Strategy — conservative interpolation:
        ///   Find the nearest chart entry where BOTH:
        ///     tp.Radius    >= actual radius
        ///     tp.BoomLength >= actual boom length
        ///   Then take the entry with the SMALLEST values (closest to actual).
        ///
        /// This ensures we never use a capacity that was rated for a
        /// shorter radius or shorter boom than reality.
        ///
        /// Returns 0 if no valid entry exists in the chart.
        /// Callers must distinguish between 0 (no data) and OutOfRadius —
        /// use DetermineLiftStatus for full status classification.
        /// </summary>
        public static double CraneCapacity(
            CraneSpecification craneSpec,
            double radius,
            double boomLength,
            GASettings settings)
        {
            var candidate = craneSpec.LoadChart
                .Where(tp =>
                    tp.Radius >= radius &&
                    tp.BoomLength >= boomLength)
                .OrderBy(tp => tp.Radius)
                .ThenBy(tp => tp.BoomLength)
                .FirstOrDefault();

            if (candidate == null)
                return 0;

            return candidate.Capacity * settings.SafetyFactor;
        }

        // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
        // LIFT STATUS DETERMINATION
        // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

        /// <summary>
        /// Determines the full lift status for an element
        /// given the computed physical parameters.
        ///
        /// Evaluation order (fail-fast — most obvious failures first):
        ///
        ///   1. OutOfRadius  → radius exceeds crane's maximum reach
        ///   2. HeightFail   → boom length exceeds crane's maximum boom
        ///   3. NoChartData  → crane spec has no load chart entry for this
        ///                     radius/boom combination (gap in manufacturer data)
        ///   4. Overweight   → element weight exceeds available chart capacity
        ///   5. Liftable     → all checks passed
        ///
        /// The distinction between OutOfRadius and NoChartData is intentional:
        ///   OutOfRadius → crane physically cannot reach (geometric limit)
        ///   NoChartData → crane might reach, but capacity is unknown (data gap)
        ///   These must be treated differently in reporting and fitness scoring.
        /// </summary>
        public static LiftStatus DetermineLiftStatus(
            double radius,
            double boomLength,
            double requiredCapacity,
            CraneSpecification craneSpec,
            GASettings settings)
        {
            // ── 1. Geometric reach check ───────────────────────────
            if (radius > craneSpec.MaxRadius)
                return LiftStatus.OutOfRadius;

            // ── 2. Boom length check ───────────────────────────────
            if (boomLength > craneSpec.MaxBoomLength)
                return LiftStatus.HeightFail;

            // ── 3. Load chart data availability ───────────────────
            double available = CraneCapacity(craneSpec, radius, boomLength, settings);

            if (available <= 0)
                // Radius is within crane range, but no chart entry exists.
                // This is a data gap, not a geometric failure.
                return LiftStatus.SpecialCase;

            // ── 4. Capacity check ──────────────────────────────────
            if (requiredCapacity > available)
                return LiftStatus.Overweight;

            // ── 5. All checks passed ───────────────────────────────
            return LiftStatus.Liftable;
        }
    }

namespace CraneOptimizer.Application.Optimization.GeneticAlgorithms.Engine
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Main orchestration engine for the Genetic Algorithm.
    /// Coordinates all GA components.
    /// </summary>
    public class GAEngine : IGeneticAlgorithmEngine
    {
        private readonly IGAInitializer _initializer;
        private readonly IElementAssignmentService _assignmentService;
        private readonly IFitnessEvaluator _fitnessEvaluator;
        private readonly ISelectionStrategy _selection;
        private readonly ICrossoverOperator _crossover;
        private readonly IMutationOperator _mutation;
        private readonly IReplacementStrategy _replacement;

        public GAEngine(
            IGAInitializer initializer,
            IElementAssignmentService assignmentService,
            IFitnessEvaluator fitnessEvaluator,
            ISelectionStrategy selection,
            ICrossoverOperator crossover,
            IMutationOperator mutation,
            IReplacementStrategy replacement)
        {
            _initializer = initializer;
            _assignmentService = assignmentService;
            _fitnessEvaluator = fitnessEvaluator;
            _selection = selection;
            _crossover = crossover;
            _mutation = mutation;
            _replacement = replacement;
        }

        public CraneSolution Run(PlacementInput input)
        {
            int stagnantGenerations = 0;
            double bestFitness = double.MinValue;
            CraneSolution bestSolution = null;
            // Initialize deterministic random manager
            GARandomManager.Initialize(input.Settings.RandomSeed);

            // 1️⃣ Initialize population
            var population = _initializer.InitializePopulation(
                input.Zones,
                input.Elements,
                input.Settings.PopulationSize,
                input.Settings.MaxCranePositions,
                input.Settings);

            for (int generation = 0; generation < input.Settings.MaxGenerations; generation++)
            {
                foreach (var solution in population.Individuals)
                {
                    // 2️⃣ Evaluate assignment
                    var evaluation = _assignmentService.EvaluateAssignment(
                        solution,
                        input.Elements,
                        input.Assignment,
                        input.CraneSpec,
                        input.Settings);

                    // 3️⃣ Evaluate fitness
                    var fitness = _fitnessEvaluator.EvaluateFitness(
                        solution,
                        evaluation,
                        input.Settings);

                    solution.Fitness = fitness.FitnessScore;
                }
                // 2️⃣ Track best solution
                var currentBest = population.Individuals
                    .OrderByDescending(s => s.Fitness)
                    .First();

                if (currentBest.Fitness > bestFitness)
                {
                    bestFitness = currentBest.Fitness;
                    bestSolution = currentBest.DeepCopy();
                    stagnantGenerations = 0;
                }
                else
                {
                    stagnantGenerations++;
                }

                // 3️⃣ Early stopping
                if (stagnantGenerations >= input.Settings.EarlyStoppingGenerations)
                    break;

                // 4️⃣ Selection
                var parents = _selection.SelectParents(
                    population,
                    population.Individuals.Count);

                // 5️⃣ Crossover
                var children = new List<CraneSolution>();

                for (int i = 0; i < parents.Count - 1; i += 2)
                {
                    if (GARandomManager.Instance.NextDouble() < input.Settings.CrossoverRate)
                    {
                        var child1 = _crossover.Crossover(parents[i], parents[i + 1]);
                        var child2 = _crossover.Crossover(parents[i + 1], parents[i]);
                        children.Add(child1);
                        children.Add(child2);
                    }
                    else
                    {
                        children.Add(parents[i].DeepCopy());
                        children.Add(parents[i + 1].DeepCopy());
                    }
                }

                // 6️⃣ Mutation
                foreach (var child in children)
                {
                    if (GARandomManager.Instance.NextDouble() < input.Settings.MutationRate)
                        _mutation.Mutate(child, input.Zones);
                }
                foreach (var child in children)
                {
                    var evaluation = _assignmentService.EvaluateAssignment(
                        child,
                        input.Elements,
                        input.Assignment,
                        input.CraneSpec,
                        input.Settings);

                    var fitness = _fitnessEvaluator.EvaluateFitness(
                        child,
                        evaluation,
                        input.Settings);

                    child.Fitness = fitness.FitnessScore;
                }

                // 7️⃣ Replacement
                population = _replacement.Replace(population, children);
            }

            // 8️⃣ Return best solution
            return bestSolution;
        }
    }

namespace CraneOptimizer.Application.Optimization.GeneticAlgorithms.Interfaces
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Responsible for generating the initial population
    /// for the Genetic Algorithm.
    /// Supports both pure random and heuristic-guided initialization.
    /// </summary>
    public interface IGAInitializer
    {
        /// <summary>
        /// Creates the first population of crane placement solutions.
        /// 
        /// Strategy:
        ///   70% of individuals → pure random positions inside zones
        ///   30% of individuals → heuristic positions guided by element centroids
        /// 
        /// The heuristic individuals seed the population with smarter starting
        /// points, accelerating GA convergence without losing diversity.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="zones">
        /// List of crane placement zones defined by the user.
        /// All generated crane positions must remain inside these zones.
        /// </param>
        /// <param name="elements">
        /// Precast elements extracted from the IFC model.
        /// Used by the heuristic strategy to compute element centroids.
        /// </param>
        /// <param name="populationSize">
        /// Total number of individuals in the initial population.
        /// </param>
        /// <param name="maxCranePositions">
        /// Maximum number of crane setup positions allowed per chromosome.
        /// Each chromosome will have between 1 and maxCranePositions positions.
        /// </param>
        /// <returns>
        /// Initialized population ready for GA evaluation.
        /// </returns>
        Population InitializePopulation(
            List<GreenAreaZone> zones,
            List<PrecastElement> elements,
            int populationSize,
            int maxCranePositions,
            GASettings settings);
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Represents the chromosome of a GA individual.
    /// A chromosome contains a sequence of crane setup positions.
    /// Each position represents a crane relocation during construction.
    /// </summary>
    public class CraneChromosome
    {
        /// <summary>
        /// List of crane setup positions used by this chromosome.
        /// The order represents the sequence of crane relocations.
        /// </summary>

        /// <summary>
        /// Number of crane relocations represented by this chromosome.
        /// </summary>
        public int RelocationCount => CranePositions.Count;
    }
}namespace CraneOptimizer.Application.Optimization.GeneticAlgorithms.Models
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Represents a GA individual solution.
    /// Each solution contains a chromosome and its evaluated fitness score.
    /// </summary>
    public class CraneSolution
    {
        /// <summary>
        /// Chromosome containing the crane placement sequence.
        /// </summary>
        public CraneChromosome Chromosome { get; set; } = new();

        /// <summary>
        /// Final fitness score of the solution.
        /// Higher values represent better crane placement strategies.
        /// </summary>
        public double Fitness { get; set; }

        /// <summary>
        /// Total number of penalties accumulated during evaluation.
        /// Penalties include radius violations, overloads, or height failures.
        /// </summary>
        public int Penalty { get; set; }

        /// <summary>
        /// Percentage of building elements that can be successfully lifted.
        /// </summary>
        public double CoverageRatio { get; set; }

        public CraneSolution DeepCopy()
        {
            return new CraneSolution
            {
                Chromosome = new CraneChromosome
                {
                    CranePositions = new System.Collections.Generic.List<Domain.Common.DomainPoint3D>(Chromosome.CranePositions)
                },
                Fitness = this.Fitness,
                Penalty = this.Penalty,
                CoverageRatio = this.CoverageRatio
            };
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Default crossover operator for crane chromosomes.
    /// Combines crane positions from two parents to create a child solution.
    /// </summary>
    public class CrossoverOperator : ICrossoverOperator
    {
        private Random _random => GARandomManager.Instance;

        /// <summary>
        /// Generates a child solution by combining positions from two parents.
        /// </summary>
        public CraneSolution Crossover(CraneSolution parent1, CraneSolution parent2)
        {
            var child = new CraneSolution
            {
                Chromosome = new CraneChromosome()
            };

            // TODO:
            // 1️⃣ Choose crossover strategy
            // Example: single-point crossover

            // TODO:
            // 2️⃣ Copy some crane positions from parent1

            // TODO:
            // 3️⃣ Copy remaining positions from parent2

            // TODO:
            // 4️⃣ Ensure resulting chromosome is valid
            // (no empty chromosome, positions remain inside zones)

            var p1 = parent1.Chromosome.CranePositions;
            var p2 = parent2.Chromosome.CranePositions;

            int minLength = Math.Min(p1.Count, p2.Count);

            // Guard: if one of them is empty, take from the other
            if (minLength == 0)
            {
                child.Chromosome.CranePositions.AddRange(p1.Count > 0 ? p1 : p2);
                return child;
            }

            // 1️⃣ choose crossover point
            int cut = _random.Next(1, minLength);

            // 2️⃣ take from parent1
            for (int i = 0; i < cut; i++)
                child.Chromosome.CranePositions.Add(p1[i]);

            // 3️⃣ take from parent2
            for (int i = cut; i < p2.Count; i++)
                child.Chromosome.CranePositions.Add(p2[i]);

            // 4️⃣ ensure not empty
            if (child.Chromosome.CranePositions.Count == 0)
                child.Chromosome.CranePositions.Add(p1[0]);

            return child;
        }
    }

using CraneOptimizer.Application.Optimization.GeneticAlgorithms.Models;

namespace CraneOptimizer.Application.Optimization.GeneticAlgorithms.Services
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Evaluates whether building elements can be lifted
    /// by the crane positions defined in a GA solution.
    ///
    /// Assignment strategy — Best Position Selection:
    ///
    ///   For each element:
    ///     1. Check if the user has manually assigned it to a specific crane index.
    ///        If yes → evaluate that position only (user override).
    ///     2. If no assignment → try ALL crane positions in the chromosome.
    ///        Select the best feasible position using this priority:
    ///          Priority 1 → Liftable   (prefer any position that can lift)
    ///          Priority 2 → smallest radius among Liftable positions
    ///          Priority 3 → if no Liftable exists, return the least-bad failure
    /// </summary>
    public class ElementAssignmentService : IElementAssignmentService
    {
        // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
        // PUBLIC ENTRY POINT
        // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

        public AssignmentResult EvaluateAssignment(
            CraneSolution solution,
            List<PrecastElement> elements,
            Dictionary<int, List<string>> assignment,
            CraneSpecification craneSpec,
            GASettings settings)
        {
            var result = new AssignmentResult();

            foreach (var element in elements)
            {
                ElementEvaluationResult evaluation;

                // ── Check for user-defined assignment ─────────────────
                int? userAssignedIndex = ResolveUserAssignment(element, assignment);

                if (userAssignedIndex.HasValue)
                {
                    // User forced this element to a specific crane position
                    evaluation = EvaluateSinglePosition(
                        element,
                        solution,
                        userAssignedIndex.Value,
                        craneSpec,
                        settings);
                }
                else
                {
                    // No user override → try all positions and pick the best
                    evaluation = EvaluateBestPosition(
                        element,
                        solution,
                        craneSpec,
                        settings);
                }

                result.EvaluationResults.Add(evaluation);
            }

            UpdateAssignmentSummary(result);

            return result;
        }

        // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
        // USER ASSIGNMENT RESOLUTION
        // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

        /// <summary>
        /// Checks whether the user has manually assigned this element
        /// to a specific crane index.
        ///
        /// The assignment dictionary maps:
        ///   Key   = crane position index in the chromosome
        ///   Value = list of ElementIDs assigned to that crane
        ///
        /// Returns the crane index if found, null if no assignment exists.
        /// </summary>
        private int? ResolveUserAssignment(
            PrecastElement element,
            Dictionary<int, List<string>> assignment)
        {
            if (assignment == null || assignment.Count == 0)
                return null;

            foreach (var entry in assignment)
            {
                if (entry.Value.Contains(element.ElementID))
                    return entry.Key;
            }

            return null;
        }

        // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
        // SINGLE POSITION EVALUATION (user override)
        // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

        /// <summary>
        /// Evaluates the lift feasibility of one element
        /// against one specific crane position.
        ///
        /// Used when the user has manually assigned the element
        /// to a specific crane index.
        /// </summary>
        private ElementEvaluationResult EvaluateSinglePosition(
            PrecastElement element,
            CraneSolution solution,
            int craneIndex,
            CraneSpecification craneSpec,
            GASettings settings)
        {
            // Guard: if craneIndex is out of range, fall back to best-position
            if (craneIndex >= solution.Chromosome.CranePositions.Count)
                return EvaluateBestPosition(element, solution, craneSpec, settings);

            return ComputeEvaluationResult(element, solution, craneIndex, craneSpec, settings);
        }

        // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
        // BEST POSITION SELECTION (automatic — main logic)
        // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

        /// <summary>
        /// Tries all crane positions in the chromosome for this element
        /// and selects the best feasible one.
        ///
        /// Selection priority:
        ///   1. Prefer Liftable over any failure status
        ///   2. Among Liftable positions, prefer the smallest radius
        ///      (smaller radius = safer lift, less stress on crane)
        ///   3. If no Liftable position exists, return the least-bad failure:
        ///      Overweight > HeightFail > SpecialCase > OutOfRadius
        ///      (Overweight is closest to liftable — just too heavy at this position)
        /// </summary>
        private ElementEvaluationResult EvaluateBestPosition(
            PrecastElement element,
            CraneSolution solution,
            CraneSpecification craneSpec,
            GASettings settings)
        {
            var candidates = new List<ElementEvaluationResult>();

            // ── Evaluate all crane positions ───────────────────────
            for (int i = 0; i < solution.Chromosome.CranePositions.Count; i++)
            {
                var candidate = ComputeEvaluationResult(
                    element, solution, i, craneSpec, settings);

                candidates.Add(candidate);
            }

            // ── Pick the best result ───────────────────────────────
            return SelectBestCandidate(candidates);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Selects the best evaluation result from a list of candidates.
        ///
        /// Step 1: Find all Liftable candidates.
        ///         If any exist → return the one with the smallest radius.
        ///
        /// Step 2: No Liftable candidates → return the least-bad failure.
        ///         Failure ranking (higher = closer to liftable):
        ///           Overweight  = 3   (can reach, just too heavy here)
        ///           HeightFail  = 2   (can reach horizontally, boom too short)
        ///           SpecialCase = 1   (no chart data, unknown)
        ///           OutOfRadius = 0   (geometrically unreachable)
        /// </summary>
        private ElementEvaluationResult SelectBestCandidate(
            List<ElementEvaluationResult> candidates)
        {
            // ── Priority 1: any Liftable position ─────────────────
            var liftable = candidates
                .Where(c => c.Status == LiftStatus.Liftable)
                .OrderBy(c => c.Radius)
                .ThenBy(c => c.AssignedCraneIndex) // Deterministic tie-breaking
                .FirstOrDefault();

            if (liftable != null)
                return liftable;

            // ── Priority 2: least-bad failure ─────────────────────
            return candidates
                .OrderByDescending(c => GetFailureRank(c.Status))
                .ThenBy(c => c.Radius)
                .ThenBy(c => c.AssignedCraneIndex) // Deterministic tie-breaking
                .First();
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Returns a numeric rank for non-Liftable statuses.
        /// Higher rank = closer to being liftable = preferred fallback.
        /// </summary>
        private int GetFailureRank(LiftStatus status)
        {
            return status switch
            {
                LiftStatus.Overweight => 3,
                LiftStatus.HeightFail => 2,
                LiftStatus.SpecialCase => 1,
                LiftStatus.OutOfRadius => 0,
                _ => 0
            };
        }

        // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
        // CORE LIFT COMPUTATION
        // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

        /// <summary>
        /// Computes the full lift evaluation for one element
        /// against one crane position index.
        ///
        /// Steps:
        ///   1. Retrieve crane position from chromosome
        ///   2. Compute working radius       → LiftCalculation.CalculateRadius
        ///   3. Compute lift height          → LiftCalculation.CalculateLiftHeight
        ///   4. Compute required boom length → LiftCalculation.CalculateRequiredBoomLength
        ///   5. Determine lift status        → LiftCalculation.DetermineLiftStatus
        /// </summary>
        private ElementEvaluationResult ComputeEvaluationResult(
            PrecastElement element,
            CraneSolution solution,
            int craneIndex,
            CraneSpecification craneSpec,
            GASettings settings)
        {
            // Step 1 — Get crane position
            var cranePosition = solution.Chromosome.CranePositions[craneIndex];

            // Step 2 — Working radius (orientation-aware)
            double radius = LiftCalculation.CalculateRadius(cranePosition, element);

            // Step 3 — Vertical lift height
            double height = LiftCalculation.CalculateLiftHeight(element, settings);

            // Step 4 — Required boom length
            double boomLength = LiftCalculation.CalculateRequiredBoomLength(radius, height);

            // Step 5 — Required capacity = element weight
            double requiredCapacity = element.ElementWT ?? 0;

            // Step 6 — Determine full lift status
            LiftStatus status = LiftCalculation.DetermineLiftStatus(
                radius, boomLength, requiredCapacity, craneSpec, settings);

            return new ElementEvaluationResult
            {
                ElementId = element.ElementID,
                AssignedCraneIndex = craneIndex,
                Status = status,
                Radius = radius,
                BoomLength = boomLength,
                RequiredCapacity = requiredCapacity
            };
        }

        // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
        // ASSIGNMENT SUMMARY
        // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

        /// <summary>
        /// Computes summary statistics from all element evaluation results.
        ///
        /// Populates AssignedElements:
        ///   Key   = crane position index
        ///   Value = list of element IDs assigned to that crane
        ///
        /// These statistics are used by the FitnessEvaluator.
        /// </summary>
        private void UpdateAssignmentSummary(AssignmentResult result)
        {
            result.AssignedElements.Clear();

            foreach (var eval in result.EvaluationResults)
            {
                // Build AssignedElements dictionary for all results
                if (!result.AssignedElements.ContainsKey(eval.AssignedCraneIndex))
                    result.AssignedElements[eval.AssignedCraneIndex] = new List<string>();

                result.AssignedElements[eval.AssignedCraneIndex].Add(eval.ElementId);
            }
        }
    }
}using CraneOptimizer.Application.Optimization.GeneticAlgorithms.Interfaces;
using CraneOptimizer.Application.Optimization.GeneticAlgorithms.Models;
using CraneOptimizer.Application.Optimization.GeneticAlgorithms.Settings;

namespace CraneOptimizer.Application.Optimization.GeneticAlgorithms.Services
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Computes the fitness value of a GA solution
    /// based on lifting feasibility and penalties.
    ///
    /// ── Design principles ────────────────────────────────────────────
    ///
    ///  1. Coverage is the dominant signal.
    ///     A solution that lifts 90% of elements is always better than
    ///     one that lifts 50%, regardless of other penalties.
    ///     CoverageWeight must be the largest weight in GASettings.
    ///
    ///  2. Hard constraint — zero coverage → zero fitness.
    ///     A solution that cannot lift a single element has no value.
    ///     We return 0 immediately to avoid wasting GA selection pressure.
    ///
    ///  3. Penalties are normalised before weighting.
    ///     Raw counts (e.g. 12 out-of-radius elements) scale with
    ///     project size and create inconsistent pressure across projects.
    ///     We normalise all penalties to [0, 1] by dividing by total elements.
    ///     This keeps the fitness surface smooth and project-independent.
    ///
    ///  4. Relocation penalty is normalised by MaxCranePositions.
    ///     One relocation in a 3-position chromosome is not the same as
    ///     one relocation in a 10-position chromosome. Normalising removes
    ///     the bias introduced by the chromosome length range.
    ///
    ///  5. SpecialCase (no chart data) is penalised lightly.
    ///     These elements are unknowns — not confirmed failures.
    ///     A heavy penalty would discourage positions that might actually
    ///     be valid once chart data is filled in.
    ///
    ///  6. Fitness is always >= 0.
    ///     Negative fitness scores are valid mathematically but confuse
    ///     tournament selection and elitism implementations.
    ///     We clamp the final value at 0.
    ///
    ///  7. NEW — Duplicate coverage is penalised.
    ///     If multiple crane positions lift the SAME element,
    ///     only one counts toward coverage; the rest are penalised.
    ///     This forces GA to distribute lifting across positions.
    ///
    /// ── Fitness formula ──────────────────────────────────────────────
    ///
    ///   fitness =
    ///       CoverageWeight        * coverageRatio
    ///     - RelocationWeight      * relocationPenalty
    ///     - RadiusPenaltyWeight   * outOfRadius
    ///     - OverweightWeight      * overweight
    ///     - HeightPenaltyWeight   * heightFail
    ///     - SpecialCaseWeight     * specialCase
    ///     - DuplicationWeight     * duplicationPenalty   ← NEW
    ///
    /// </summary>
    public class FitnessEvaluator : IFitnessEvaluator
    {
        private const double SpecialCasePenaltyWeight = 1.0;

        public FitnessBreakdown EvaluateFitness(
            CraneSolution solution,
            AssignmentResult assignment,
            GASettings settings)
        {
            var breakdown = new FitnessBreakdown();
            var results = assignment.EvaluationResults;

            // ── Guard: empty evaluation ────────────────────────────
            if (results == null || results.Count == 0)
            {
                breakdown.FitnessScore = 0;
                return breakdown;
            }

            int total = results.Count;

            // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
            // NEW: TRACK UNIQUE COVERAGE + DUPLICATION
            // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════

            // Unique elements lifted (true coverage)
            int uniqueLiftableCount = results
                .Where(r => r.Status == LiftStatus.Liftable)
                .Select(r => r.ElementId)
                .Distinct()
                .Count();

            double coverageRatio = (double)uniqueLiftableCount / total;

            // ── Hard constraint: zero coverage → zero fitness ──────
            if (uniqueLiftableCount == 0)
            {
                breakdown.FitnessScore = 0;
                breakdown.CoverageRatio = 0;
                breakdown.LiftableElements = 0;
                breakdown.TotalElements = total;
                return breakdown;
            }

            // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
            // 2. RELOCATION PENALTY
            // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════

            int craneCount = solution.Chromosome.CranePositions.Count;

            double normalisedRelocation = settings.MaxCranePositions > 0
                ? (double)craneCount / settings.MaxCranePositions
                : 0;

            // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
            // 3. FAILURE PENALTIES
            // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════

            int outOfRadiusCount = results.Count(r => r.Status == LiftStatus.OutOfRadius);
            int overweightCount = results.Count(r => r.Status == LiftStatus.Overweight);
            int heightFailCount = results.Count(r => r.Status == LiftStatus.HeightFail);
            int specialCaseCount = results.Count(r => r.Status == LiftStatus.SpecialCase);

            double normOutOfRadius = (double)outOfRadiusCount / total;
            double normOverweight = (double)overweightCount / total;
            double normHeightFail = (double)heightFailCount / total;
            double normSpecialCase = (double)specialCaseCount / total;

            // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
            // 4. RADIUS QUALITY BONUS
            // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════

            double radiusQualityPenalty = 0;

            if (settings.MaxRadiusForNormalisation > 0)
            {
                var liftableResults = results.Where(r => r.Status == LiftStatus.Liftable).ToList();

                if (liftableResults.Count > 0)
                {
                    double avgRadius = liftableResults.Average(r => r.Radius);
                    radiusQualityPenalty = avgRadius / settings.MaxRadiusForNormalisation;
                    radiusQualityPenalty = Math.Min(radiusQualityPenalty, 1.0);
                }
            }

            // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
            // 5. BALANCE & RADIUS STD-DEV PENALTIES
            // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════

            var countsPerCrane = assignment.AssignedElements.Select(kv => kv.Value.Count).ToList();
            double variance = countsPerCrane.Count > 1 ? 
                countsPerCrane.Average(c => Math.Pow(c - countsPerCrane.Average(), 2)) : 0;
            double normalizedVariance = total > 0 ? Math.Min(variance / total, 1.0) : 0;
            double balancePenalty = settings.BalancePenaltyWeight * normalizedVariance;

            var liftableRadii = results.Where(r => r.Status == LiftStatus.Liftable).Select(r => r.Radius).ToList();
            double radiusStdDev = liftableRadii.Count > 1 ? 
                Math.Sqrt(liftableRadii.Average(r => Math.Pow(r - liftableRadii.Average(), 2))) : 0;
            double normalizedStdDev = settings.MaxRadiusForNormalisation > 0 ? 
                Math.Min(radiusStdDev / settings.MaxRadiusForNormalisation, 1.0) : 0;
            double radiusStdDevPenalty = settings.RadiusStdDevPenaltyWeight * normalizedStdDev;

            // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
            // 6. FINAL FITNESS
            // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════

            double fitness =
                  settings.CoverageWeight * coverageRatio
                - settings.RelocationWeight * normalisedRelocation
                - settings.RadiusPenaltyWeight * normOutOfRadius
                - settings.OverweightPenaltyWeight * normOverweight
                - settings.HeightPenaltyWeight * normHeightFail
                - SpecialCasePenaltyWeight * normSpecialCase
                - settings.RadiusPenaltyWeight * radiusQualityPenalty
                - balancePenalty
                - radiusStdDevPenalty;

            fitness = Math.Max(0, fitness);

            // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
            // 7. POPULATE BREAKDOWN
            // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════

            breakdown.FitnessScore = fitness;
            breakdown.CoverageRatio = coverageRatio;
            breakdown.LiftableElements = uniqueLiftableCount;
            breakdown.TotalElements = total;
            breakdown.RelocationPenalty = normalisedRelocation;
            breakdown.RadiusPenalty = normOutOfRadius;
            breakdown.OverweightPenalty = normOverweight;
            breakdown.HeightPenalty = normHeightFail;

            return breakdown;
        }
    }
}using CraneOptimizer.Application.Optimization.GeneticAlgorithms.Interfaces;
using CraneOptimizer.Application.Optimization.GeneticAlgorithms.Models;
using CraneOptimizer.Application.Optimization.GeneticAlgorithms.Settings;
using CraneOptimizer.Domain.Common;
using CraneOptimizer.Domain.Schemas;

namespace CraneOptimizer.Application.Optimization.GeneticAlgorithms.Services
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Default implementation of the GA population initializer.
    ///
    /// Initialization Strategy — 70% Random / 30% Heuristic:
    ///
    ///   70% → Pure random positions sampled inside crane placement zones.
    ///          Ensures population diversity and exploration of the search space.
    ///
    ///   30% → Heuristic positions guided by precast element centroids.
    ///          Elements are clustered by spatial proximity.
    ///          Each crane position is seeded near the centroid of a cluster.
    ///          This accelerates GA convergence by providing smarter starting points.
    /// </summary>
    public class GAInitializer : IGAInitializer
    {
        private Random Rng => GARandomManager.Instance;

        public GAInitializer(GASettings settings)
        {
        }

        // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
        // PUBLIC ENTRY POINT
        // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

        public Population InitializePopulation(
            List<GreenAreaZone> zones,
            List<PrecastElement> elements,
            int populationSize,
            int maxCranePositions,
            GASettings settings)
        {
            var population = new Population();

            // ── Split population into random vs heuristic ──────────
            int heuristicCount = (int)(populationSize * 0.30);
            int randomCount = populationSize - heuristicCount;

            // ── 70% Pure Random ────────────────────────────────────
            for (int i = 0; i < randomCount; i++)
            {
                var solution = CreateRandomSolution(zones, maxCranePositions);
                population.Individuals.Add(solution);
            }

            // ── 30% Heuristic (element-centroid guided) ────────────
            for (int i = 0; i < heuristicCount; i++)
            {
                var solution = CreateHeuristicSolution(zones, elements, maxCranePositions);
                population.Individuals.Add(solution);
            }

            return population;
        }

        // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
        // RANDOM SOLUTION (70%)
        // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

        /// <summary>
        /// Creates a fully random solution.
        /// Crane positions are sampled uniformly inside random zones.
        /// </summary>
        private CraneSolution CreateRandomSolution(
            List<GreenAreaZone> zones,
            int maxCranePositions)
        {
            var chromosome = new CraneChromosome();

            // Variable number of crane setups per chromosome
            int craneCount = Rng.Next(1, maxCranePositions + 1);

            for (int j = 0; j < craneCount; j++)
            {
                var zone = zones[Rng.Next(zones.Count)];
                var point = GenerateRandomPointInsideZone(zone);
                chromosome.CranePositions.Add(point);
            }

            return new CraneSolution
            {
                Chromosome = chromosome,
                Fitness = 0,
                Penalty = 0,
                CoverageRatio = 0
            };
        }

        // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
        // HEURISTIC SOLUTION (30%)
        // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

        /// <summary>
        /// Creates a heuristic solution guided by element spatial distribution.
        ///
        /// Steps:
        ///   1. Decide how many crane positions to use (1 → maxCranePositions)
        ///   2. Cluster elements into that many groups using K-Means style split
        ///   3. Compute the centroid of each cluster
        ///   4. Find the nearest valid point to that centroid inside a zone
        ///   5. Use that point as the crane position for this cluster
        /// </summary>
        private CraneSolution CreateHeuristicSolution(
            List<GreenAreaZone> zones,
            List<PrecastElement> elements,
            int maxCranePositions)
        {
            var chromosome = new CraneChromosome();

            int craneCount = Rng.Next(1, maxCranePositions + 1);

            // Step 1 — Cluster elements into craneCount groups
            var clusters = ClusterElements(elements, craneCount);

            foreach (var cluster in clusters)
            {
                if (cluster.Count == 0)
                    continue;

                // Step 2 — Compute spatial centroid of the cluster
                var centroid = CalculateCentroid(cluster);

                // Step 3 — Find nearest valid crane position inside zones
                var point = FindNearestValidPoint(centroid, zones);

                chromosome.CranePositions.Add(point);
            }

            // Fallback: if heuristic failed to produce positions, add one random
            if (chromosome.CranePositions.Count == 0)
            {
                var zone = zones[Rng.Next(zones.Count)];
                var point = GenerateRandomPointInsideZone(zone);
                chromosome.CranePositions.Add(point);
            }

            return new CraneSolution
            {
                Chromosome = chromosome,
                Fitness = 0,
                Penalty = 0,
                CoverageRatio = 0
            };
        }

        // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
        // CLUSTERING — Split elements into spatial groups
        // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

        /// <summary>
        /// Splits elements into k clusters based on X-axis spatial ordering.
        ///
        /// Simple approach: sort elements by X coordinate, divide evenly.
        /// This is a fast approximation — not full K-Means — but sufficient
        /// to produce spatially meaningful cluster centroids for seeding.
        /// </summary>
        private List<List<PrecastElement>> ClusterElements(
            List<PrecastElement> elements,
            int k)
        {
            // Sort by X coordinate for a simple spatial split
            var sorted = elements
                .OrderBy(e => e.ElementCOG.X)
                .ThenBy(e => e.ElementCOG.Y)
                .ToList();

            var clusters = new List<List<PrecastElement>>();

            // Divide sorted elements evenly into k groups
            int chunkSize = (int)Math.Ceiling((double)sorted.Count / k);

            for (int i = 0; i < k; i++)
            {
                var cluster = sorted
                    .Skip(i * chunkSize)
                    .Take(chunkSize)
                    .ToList();

                clusters.Add(cluster);
            }

            return clusters;
        }

        // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
        // CENTROID — Compute spatial center of a cluster
        // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

        /// <summary>
        /// Calculates the average X/Y position of all elements in a cluster.
        /// This centroid represents the ideal crane position for this group.
        /// </summary>
        private DomainPoint3D CalculateCentroid(List<PrecastElement> elements)
        {
            double x = elements.Average(e => e.ElementCOG.X);
            double y = elements.Average(e => e.ElementCOG.Y);

            return new DomainPoint3D(x, y, 0);
        }

        // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
        // NEAREST VALID POINT — Map centroid to a zone-valid position
        // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

        /// <summary>
        /// Finds the nearest valid crane position inside any zone
        /// relative to the provided centroid.
        ///
        /// Strategy:
        ///   1. If centroid is already inside a zone → use it directly
        ///   2. Otherwise → find the zone whose centroid is closest
        ///      and sample a random point inside that zone
        /// </summary>
        private DomainPoint3D FindNearestValidPoint(
            DomainPoint3D centroid,
            List<GreenAreaZone> zones)
        {
            // Case 1: centroid falls inside one of the zones
            foreach (var zone in zones)
            {
                if (IsPointInsidePolygon(centroid, zone.Vertices))
                    return centroid;
            }

            // Case 2: find the closest zone and sample inside it
            var closestZone = zones
                .OrderBy(z => DistanceToZoneCentroid(centroid, z))
                .First();

            return GenerateRandomPointInsideZone(closestZone);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Computes distance from a point to the centroid of a zone's vertices.
        /// Used to find the closest zone when the element centroid falls outside all zones.
        /// </summary>
        private double DistanceToZoneCentroid(DomainPoint3D point, GreenAreaZone zone)
        {
            double zx = zone.Vertices.Average(v => v.X);
            double zy = zone.Vertices.Average(v => v.Y);

            double dx = point.X - zx;
            double dy = point.Y - zy;

            return Math.Sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
        }

        // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
        // GEOMETRY HELPERS
        // ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

        /// <summary>
        /// Generates a random point inside a polygon zone.
        /// Uses bounding box rejection sampling with ray-casting validation.
        /// </summary>
        private DomainPoint3D GenerateRandomPointInsideZone(GreenAreaZone zone)
        {
            var bbox = GetBoundingBox(zone.Vertices);

            while (true)
            {
                double x = bbox.minX + Rng.NextDouble() * (bbox.maxX - bbox.minX);
                double y = bbox.minY + Rng.NextDouble() * (bbox.maxY - bbox.minY);

                var point = new DomainPoint3D(x, y, 0);

                if (IsPointInsidePolygon(point, zone.Vertices))
                    return point;
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Calculates the bounding box (min/max X and Y) of a polygon.
        /// </summary>
        private (double minX, double maxX, double minY, double maxY)
            GetBoundingBox(List<DomainPoint3D> vertices)
        {
            return (
                vertices.Min(v => v.X),
                vertices.Max(v => v.X),
                vertices.Min(v => v.Y),
                vertices.Max(v => v.Y)
            );
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Ray-casting algorithm to determine if a point lies inside a polygon.
        /// Casts a horizontal ray from the point to the right and counts
        /// how many polygon edges it crosses — odd = inside, even = outside.
        /// </summary>
        private bool IsPointInsidePolygon(DomainPoint3D point, List<DomainPoint3D> polygon)
        {
            bool inside = false;

            for (int i = 0, j = polygon.Count - 1; i < polygon.Count; j = i++)
            {
                var pi = polygon[i];
                var pj = polygon[j];

                bool intersect =
                    ((pi.Y > point.Y) != (pj.Y > point.Y)) &&
                    (point.X < (pj.X - pi.X) * (point.Y - pi.Y) / (pj.Y - pi.Y) + pi.X);

                if (intersect)
                    inside = !inside;
            }

            return inside;
        }
    }
}using System;
using System.Threading;

namespace CraneOptimizer.Application.Optimization.GeneticAlgorithms.Services
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Provides a thread-safe, centralized Random instance for the entire GA execution flow.
    /// This ensures complete determinism when a seed is provided, even across multiple concurrent optimization runs.
    /// </summary>
    public static class GARandomManager
    {
        private static readonly AsyncLocal<Random> _random = new AsyncLocal<Random>();

        /// <summary>
        /// Gets the centralized Random instance for the current execution context.
        /// If not initialized, defaults to an unseeded Random.
        /// </summary>
        public static Random Instance
        {
            get
            {
                if (_random.Value == null)
                    _random.Value = new Random();
                
                return _random.Value;
            }
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Initializes the Random instance with the provided seed for deterministic behavior.
        /// Call this exactly once at the start of GAEngine.Run.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="seed">The deterministic random seed, or null for random behavior.</param>
        public static void Initialize(int? seed)
        {
            _random.Value = seed.HasValue ? new Random(seed.Value) : new Random();
        }
    }
}

    /// <summary>
    /// Mutation operator that slightly modifies crane positions
    /// to maintain population diversity.
    /// </summary>
    public class MutationOperator : IMutationOperator
    {
        private Random _random => GARandomManager.Instance;

        /// <summary>
        /// Applies mutation to a solution.
        /// </summary>
        public void Mutate(CraneSolution solution , List<GreenAreaZone> zones)
        {
            // TODO:
            // 1️⃣ Select random crane position from chromosome

            // TODO:
            // 2️⃣ Slightly modify X or Y coordinate

            // Example:
            // position.X += random small value
            // position.Y += random small value

            // TODO:
            // 3️⃣ Ensure position remains valid
            // (inside crane placement zone)
            var positions = solution.Chromosome.CranePositions;

            if (positions == null || positions.Count == 0)
                return;

            // 1️⃣ pick random position
            int index = _random.Next(positions.Count);
            var p = positions[index];

            // 2️⃣ perturb
            double deltaX = (_random.NextDouble() * 10) - 5;
            double deltaY = (_random.NextDouble() * 10) - 5;

            var mutated = new DomainPoint3D(
                p.X + deltaX,
                p.Y + deltaY,
                p.Z
            );

            // 3️⃣ validate (Reject strategy)
            if (IsInsideAnyZone(mutated, zones))
            {
                positions[index] = mutated;
            }
            // else: ignore mutation (keep original)
        }
        private bool IsInsideAnyZone(DomainPoint3D point, List<GreenAreaZone> zones)
        {
            return zones.Any(z => IsPointInsidePolygon(point, z.Vertices));
        }
        private bool IsPointInsidePolygon(DomainPoint3D point, List<DomainPoint3D> polygon)
        {
            bool inside = false;

            for (int i = 0, j = polygon.Count - 1; i < polygon.Count; j = i++)
            {
                var pi = polygon[i];
                var pj = polygon[j];

                bool intersect =
                    ((pi.Y > point.Y) != (pj.Y > point.Y)) &&
                    (point.X < (pj.X - pi.X) * (point.Y - pi.Y) / (pj.Y - pi.Y) + pi.X);

                if (intersect)
                    inside = !inside;
            }

            return inside;
        }
    }

namespace CraneOptimizer.Application.Optimization.GeneticAlgorithms.Services
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Replacement strategy used to build the next generation.
    /// Combines old population with new children.
    /// </summary>
    public class ReplacementStrategy : IReplacementStrategy
    {
        /// <summary>
        /// Replaces the current population with a new generation. (elites strategy)
        /// </summary>
        public Population Replace(Population oldPopulation, List<CraneSolution> children)
        {
            // TODO:
            // 1️⃣ Combine old population with children

            // 2️⃣ Sort individuals by fitness

            // 3️⃣ Keep best individuals up to population size

            // 4️⃣ Create new population object

            int populationSize = oldPopulation.Individuals.Count;

            // 1. Calculate elite count (10%)
            int eliteCount = (int)(populationSize * 0.1);

            // 2. Extract best individuals from the old population
            var elites = oldPopulation.Individuals
                .OrderByDescending(i => i.Fitness)
                .ThenByDescending(i => i.CoverageRatio)
                .ThenBy(i => i.Chromosome.CranePositions.Sum(p => p.X + p.Y + p.Z))
                .Take(eliteCount)
                .ToList();

            // 3. Merge old + children, but exclude elites to prevent duplication
            var nonElitesMerged = oldPopulation.Individuals
                .Except(elites)
                .Concat(children)
                .ToList();

            // 4. Sort remaining merged pool and select enough to fill the population
            var selectedNonElites = nonElitesMerged
                .OrderByDescending(i => i.Fitness)
                .ThenByDescending(i => i.CoverageRatio)
                .ThenBy(i => i.Chromosome.CranePositions.Sum(p => p.X + p.Y + p.Z))
                .Take(populationSize - eliteCount)
                .ToList();

            // 5. Combine elites and selected non-elites to form exactly populationSize
            var nextGeneration = elites
                .Concat(selectedNonElites)
                .ToList();

            return new Population
            {
                Individuals = nextGeneration,
                Generation = oldPopulation.Generation + 1
            };
        }
    }

namespace CraneOptimizer.Application.Optimization.GeneticAlgorithms.Services
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Tournament selection strategy.
    /// Selects parents by running small competitions
    /// between randomly chosen individuals.
    /// </summary>
    public class TournamentSelection : ISelectionStrategy
    {
        private Random _random => GARandomManager.Instance;

        /// <summary>
        /// Number of individuals competing in each tournament.
        /// Typical values: 2 or 3.
        /// </summary>
        private const int TournamentSize = 3;

        /// <summary>
        /// Selects parent solutions from the population.
        /// </summary>
        public List<CraneSolution> SelectParents(
            Population population,
            int numberOfParents)
        {
            var parents = new List<CraneSolution>();

            for (int i = 0; i < numberOfParents; i++)
            {
                // 1️⃣ randomly pick tournament candidates
                var candidates = PickRandomCandidates(population);

                // 2️⃣ choose the best individual from the tournament
                var winner = SelectBestCandidate(candidates);

                parents.Add(winner);
            }

            return parents;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Randomly selects individuals from the population
        /// to participate in a tournament.
        /// </summary>
        private List<CraneSolution> PickRandomCandidates(Population population)
        {
            var candidates = new List<CraneSolution>();

            var pool = population.Individuals.ToList();

            for (int i = 0; i < TournamentSize; i++)
            {
                if (pool.Count == 0) break;
                int index = _random.Next(pool.Count);
                candidates.Add(pool[index]);
                pool.RemoveAt(index);
            }

            return candidates;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Chooses the individual with the highest fitness
        /// among tournament candidates.
        /// </summary>
        private CraneSolution SelectBestCandidate(List<CraneSolution> candidates)
        {
            // Deterministic tie-breaking to avoid random selection of identical fitness
            return candidates
                .OrderByDescending(c => c.Fitness)
                .ThenByDescending(c => c.CoverageRatio)
                .ThenBy(c => c.Chromosome.CranePositions.Count)
                .First();
        }
    }
}namespace CraneOptimizer.Application.Optimization.GeneticAlgorithms.Settings
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Configuration parameters of the Genetic Algorithm.
    /// </summary>
    public class GASettings
    {
        /// <summary>
        /// Number of individuals per population.
        /// </summary>
        public int PopulationSize { get; set; }

        /// <summary>
        /// Maximum number of generations.
        /// </summary>
        public int MaxGenerations { get; set; }

        /// <summary>
        /// Probability of mutation.
        /// </summary>
        public double MutationRate { get; set; }

        /// <summary>
        /// Probability of crossover.
        /// </summary>
        public double CrossoverRate { get; set; }

        /// <summary>
        /// Additional rigging length used during lifting calculations.
        /// Default value is typically around 2 meters.
        /// </summary>
        public double RiggingLength { get; set; } = 2.0;

        /// <summary>
        /// Safety factor applied to crane lifting capacity.
        /// </summary>
        public double SafetyFactor { get; set; } = 0.9;

        /// <summary>
        /// Maximum number of crane setup positions allowed in a chromosome.
        /// </summary>
        public int MaxCranePositions { get; set; } = 3;

        /// <summary>
        /// Random seed for deterministic runs (optional).
        /// if null -> fully random behaviour.
        /// </summary>
        public int? RandomSeed { get; set; } = 42;

        // ------------------------------
        // Fitness function weights
        // ------------------------------

        /// <summary>
        /// Weight assigned to element coverage ratio.
        /// Higher value prioritizes lifting more elements.
        /// </summary>
        public double CoverageWeight { get; set; } = 10;

        /// <summary>
        /// Weight applied to crane relocation penalty.
        /// Higher value discourages multiple crane setups.
        /// </summary>
        public double RelocationWeight { get; set; } = 5;

        /// <summary>
        /// Weight applied to large working radius penalty.
        /// </summary>
        public double RadiusPenaltyWeight { get; set; } = 3;

        /// <summary>
        /// Weight applied when elements exceed crane capacity.
        /// </summary>
        public double OverweightPenaltyWeight { get; set; } = 10;

        /// <summary>
        /// Weight applied when required lifting height is invalid.
        /// </summary>
        public double HeightPenaltyWeight { get; set; } = 5;

        /// <summary>
        /// Normalisation factor for working radius penalty.
        /// Converts raw radius values into a [0, 1] scale for consistent fitness evaluation.
        /// </summary>
        public double MaxRadiusForNormalisation { get; set; } = 50;

        /// <summary>
        /// Number of consecutive generations without fitness improvement
        /// </summary>
        public int EarlyStoppingGenerations { get; set; } = 20;

        public double RadiusStdDevPenaltyWeight { get; set; } = 2.0;
        public double BalancePenaltyWeight { get; set; } = 2.0;
    }

global using System;
global using System.Collections.Generic;
global using System.Linq;
global using System.Threading;
global using System.Threading.Tasks;
﻿using CraneOptimizer.Domain.Entities;
using CraneOptimizer.Domain.Interfaces;
using CraneOptimizer.Infrastructure.Contexts;
using Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore;

namespace CraneOptimizer.Infrastructure.Repositories
{
    public class CraneRepository : ICraneRepository
    {
        private readonly CraneDbContext _context;

        public CraneRepository(CraneDbContext context)
        {
            _context = context;
        }

        public async Task<List<Crane>> GetAllAsync()
        {
            return await GetAllWithSpecsAsync();
        }

        public async Task<List<Crane>> GetAllWithSpecsAsync()
        {
            return await _context.Cranes
                                .Include(c => c.Specifications)
                                .ThenInclude(s => s.LoadChart)
                                .AsNoTracking()
                                .ToListAsync();
        }

        public async Task<Crane?> GetByIdWithSpecsAsync(int id)
        {
            return await _context.Cranes
                .AsNoTracking()
                .Include(c => c.Specifications)
                .ThenInclude(s => s.LoadChart)
                .FirstOrDefaultAsync(c => c.Id == id);
        }
        public async Task AddAsync(Crane crane)
        {
            await _context.Cranes.AddAsync(crane);
            await _context.SaveChangesAsync();
        }

        public async Task AddRangeAsync(List<Crane> cranes)
        {
            using var transaction = await _context.Database.BeginTransactionAsync();

            try
            {
                _context.ChangeTracker.AutoDetectChangesEnabled = false;

                await _context.Cranes.AddRangeAsync(cranes);
                await _context.SaveChangesAsync();

                await transaction.CommitAsync();
            }
            catch
            {
                await transaction.RollbackAsync();
                throw;
            }
            finally
            {
                _context.ChangeTracker.AutoDetectChangesEnabled = true;
            }
        }

        public async Task UpdateAsync(Crane crane)
        {
            _context.Cranes.Update(crane);
            await _context.SaveChangesAsync();
        }

        public async Task DeleteAsync(int id)
        {
            var crane = await _context.Cranes.FindAsync(id);
            if (crane == null) return;

            _context.Cranes.Remove(crane);
            await _context.SaveChangesAsync();
        }

        public async Task<bool> ExistsByNameAsync(string name)
        {
            return await _context.Cranes
                .AnyAsync(c => c.Name == name);
        }
    }
