﻿using CraneOptimizer.Domain.Common;
using CraneOptimizer.Domain.Interfaces;
using CraneOptimizer.Domain.Schemas;
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.IO;
using Xbim.Common.Geometry;
using Xbim.Common.XbimExtensions;
using Xbim.Ifc;
using Xbim.Ifc4.Interfaces;
using Xbim.ModelGeometry.Scene;

namespace CraneOptimizer.Infrastructure.Repositories
{
    public class IfcReaderRepository : IIfcReaderRepository
    {
        private Xbim3DModelContext _geometryContext;

        public List<PrecastElement> ReadElements(string ifcPath)
        {
            var elements = new List<PrecastElement>();

            try
            {
                using var model = IfcStore.Open(ifcPath);

                _geometryContext = new Xbim3DModelContext(model);
                _geometryContext.CreateContext();
                var products = model.Instances
                    .OfType<IIfcProduct>()
                    .Where(p => p is IIfcBuildingElement && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(p.Name?.ToString())).ToList();

                int count = 0;
                int total = products.Count;

                foreach (var p in products)
                {
                    count++;

                    var bbox = GetBoundingBoxSize(p);
                    var cog = GetCOGFromShapeGeometry(p);
                    var element = new PrecastElement
                    {
                        ElementID = p.GlobalId,
                        ElementType = p.ExpressType?.Name,

                        ElementLength = GetPropertyDouble(p, "length"),
                        ElementWidth = GetPropertyDouble(p, "width"),
                        ElementHeight = GetPropertyDouble(p, "height"),

                        ElementVolume = GetQuantity(p, "volume") ??
                                        GetPropertyDouble(p, "volume"),

                        ElementWT = GetQuantity(p, "weight") ??
                                    GetPropertyDouble(p, "weight"),

                        ElementMaterial = GetMaterial(p),

                        BBoxLength = bbox?.L,
                        BBoxWidth = bbox?.W,
                        BBoxHeight = bbox?.H,

                        ElementCOG = cog.HasValue
                                            ? new DomainPoint3D(cog.Value.X, cog.Value.Y, cog.Value.Z)
                                            : new DomainPoint3D(),
                    };

                    elements.Add(element);

                    if (count % 10 == 0)
                        Debug.WriteLine($"Processing {count}/{total} elements...");
                }

                Debug.WriteLine($"Loaded {elements.Count} elements successfully");
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Debug.WriteLine($"Error loading IFC file: {ex.Message}");
                throw;
            }
            finally
            {
                _geometryContext = null;
            }

            return elements;
        }
        public List<PrecastElement> ReadElements(string path, IProgress<double> progress)
        {
            var result = new List<PrecastElement>();

            using var model = IfcStore.Open(path);

            _geometryContext = new Xbim3DModelContext(model);
            _geometryContext.CreateContext();

            var products = model.Instances
                .OfType<IIfcProduct>()
                .Where(p => p is IIfcBuildingElement && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(p.Name))
                .ToList();

            int total = products.Count;
            int processed = 0;

            foreach (var p in products)
            {
                var bbox = GetBoundingBoxSize(p);
                var cog = GetCOGFromShapeGeometry(p);

                var element = new PrecastElement
                {
                    ElementID = p.GlobalId,
                    ElementType = p.ExpressType?.Name,

                    ElementLength = GetPropertyDouble(p, "length"),
                    ElementWidth = GetPropertyDouble(p, "width"),
                    ElementHeight = GetPropertyDouble(p, "height"),

                    ElementVolume = GetQuantity(p, "volume") ??
                                    GetPropertyDouble(p, "volume"),

                    ElementWT = GetQuantity(p, "weight") ??
                                GetPropertyDouble(p, "weight"),

                    ElementMaterial = GetMaterial(p),

                    BBoxLength = bbox?.L,
                    BBoxWidth = bbox?.W,
                    BBoxHeight = bbox?.H,

                    ElementCOG = cog.HasValue
                        ? new DomainPoint3D(cog.Value.X, cog.Value.Y, cog.Value.Z)
                        : new DomainPoint3D(),
                };

                result.Add(element);

                processed++;
                progress?.Report((double)processed / total * 100.0);
            }

            _geometryContext = null;

            return result;
        }
        private XbimPoint3D? GetCOGFromShapeGeometry(IIfcProduct product)
        {
            try
            {
                var shapeInstances = _geometryContext
                    .ShapeInstancesOf(product)
                    .ToList();

                if (!shapeInstances.Any())
                    return null;

                double totalVolume = 0;
                double weightedX = 0;
                double weightedY = 0;
                double weightedZ = 0;

                foreach (var shapeInstance in shapeInstances)
                {
                    var shapeGeometry = _geometryContext.ShapeGeometry(shapeInstance);
                    if (shapeGeometry == null)
                        continue;

                    var transform = shapeInstance.Transformation;

                    var result = CalculateCentroidFromShapeGeometry(
                        shapeGeometry,
                        transform);

                    if (result.HasValue)
                    {
                        var (centroid, volume) = result.Value;

                        if (volume > 0)
                        {
                            totalVolume += volume;
                            weightedX += centroid.X * volume;
                            weightedY += centroid.Y * volume;
                            weightedZ += centroid.Z * volume;
                        }
                    }
                }

                if (totalVolume > 0)
                {
                    return new XbimPoint3D(
                        weightedX / totalVolume,
                        weightedY / totalVolume,
                        weightedZ / totalVolume);
                }

                return GetCOGFromBoundingBox(product);
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Debug.WriteLine($"COG error: {ex.Message}");
                return GetCOGFromBoundingBox(product);
            }
        }

        private (XbimPoint3D centroid, double volume)? CalculateCentroidFromShapeGeometry(XbimShapeGeometry shapeGeometry, XbimMatrix3D transform)
        {
            try
            {
                var data = shapeGeometry.ShapeData;

                if (data == null || data.Length == 0)
                    return null;

                var bytes = Convert.FromBase64String(data);
                using var ms = new MemoryStream(bytes);
                using var br = new BinaryReader(ms);

                var mesh = br.ReadShapeTriangulation();

                if (mesh?.Vertices == null || mesh?.Faces == null)
                    return null;

                var vertices = mesh.Vertices.ToList();

                double totalVolume = 0;
                double cx = 0;
                double cy = 0;
                double cz = 0;

                foreach (var face in mesh.Faces)
                {
                    var indices = face.Indices.ToList();

                    for (int i = 0; i < indices.Count - 2; i += 3)
                    {
                        var p0 = transform.Transform(vertices[indices[i]]);
                        var p1 = transform.Transform(vertices[indices[i + 1]]);
                        var p2 = transform.Transform(vertices[indices[i + 2]]);

                        var tetraVol = SignedTetrahedronVolume(p0, p1, p2);

                        cx += (p0.X + p1.X + p2.X) / 4.0 * tetraVol;
                        cy += (p0.Y + p1.Y + p2.Y) / 4.0 * tetraVol;
                        cz += (p0.Z + p1.Z + p2.Z) / 4.0 * tetraVol;

                        totalVolume += tetraVol;
                    }
                }

                var absVolume = Math.Abs(totalVolume);

                if (absVolume > 1e-10)
                {
                    return (
                        new XbimPoint3D(
                            cx / totalVolume,
                            cy / totalVolume,
                            cz / totalVolume),
                        absVolume);
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Debug.WriteLine($"Mesh parse error: {ex.Message}");
            }

            return null;
        }

        private static double SignedTetrahedronVolume(XbimPoint3D a, XbimPoint3D b, XbimPoint3D c)
        {
            return
                (a.X * (b.Y * c.Z - c.Y * b.Z) -
                 a.Y * (b.X * c.Z - c.X * b.Z) +
                 a.Z * (b.X * c.Y - c.X * b.Y)) / 6.0;
        }

        private XbimPoint3D? GetCOGFromBoundingBox(IIfcProduct product)
        {
            try
            {
                var shapes = _geometryContext
                    .ShapeInstancesOf(product)
                    .ToList();

                if (!shapes.Any())
                    return null;

                double minX = double.MaxValue;
                double minY = double.MaxValue;
                double minZ = double.MaxValue;

                double maxX = double.MinValue;
                double maxY = double.MinValue;
                double maxZ = double.MinValue;

                foreach (var shape in shapes)
                {
                    var bbox = shape.BoundingBox;
                    var transform = shape.Transformation;

                    var corners = new[]
                    {
                        new XbimPoint3D(bbox.Min.X, bbox.Min.Y, bbox.Min.Z),
                        new XbimPoint3D(bbox.Max.X, bbox.Min.Y, bbox.Min.Z),
                        new XbimPoint3D(bbox.Min.X, bbox.Max.Y, bbox.Min.Z),
                        new XbimPoint3D(bbox.Max.X, bbox.Max.Y, bbox.Min.Z),

                        new XbimPoint3D(bbox.Min.X, bbox.Min.Y, bbox.Max.Z),
                        new XbimPoint3D(bbox.Max.X, bbox.Min.Y, bbox.Max.Z),
                        new XbimPoint3D(bbox.Min.X, bbox.Max.Y, bbox.Max.Z),
                        new XbimPoint3D(bbox.Max.X, bbox.Max.Y, bbox.Max.Z)
                    };

                    foreach (var c in corners)
                    {
                        var w = transform.Transform(c);

                        minX = Math.Min(minX, w.X);
                        minY = Math.Min(minY, w.Y);
                        minZ = Math.Min(minZ, w.Z);

                        maxX = Math.Max(maxX, w.X);
                        maxY = Math.Max(maxY, w.Y);
                        maxZ = Math.Max(maxZ, w.Z);
                    }
                }

                return new XbimPoint3D(
                    (minX + maxX) / 2,
                    (minY + maxY) / 2,
                    (minZ + maxZ) / 2);
            }
            catch
            {
                return null;
            }
        }

        private double? GetPropertyDouble(IIfcProduct p, string keyword)
        {
            var rels = p.IsDefinedBy
                .Where(r => r.RelatingPropertyDefinition is IIfcPropertySet)
                .Select(r => r.RelatingPropertyDefinition as IIfcPropertySet);

            foreach (var pset in rels)
            {
                foreach (var prop in pset?.HasProperties
                             .OfType<IIfcPropertySingleValue>() ?? [])
                {
                    if (prop.Name.ToString().ToLower().Contains(keyword))
                    {
                        if (double.TryParse(
                            prop.NominalValue?.ToString(),
                            System.Globalization.NumberStyles.Any,
                            System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,
                            out double v))
                            return v;
                    }
                }
            }

            return null;
        }

        private double? GetQuantity(IIfcProduct p, string keyword)
        {
            var rels = p.IsDefinedBy
                .Where(r => r.RelatingPropertyDefinition is IIfcElementQuantity)
                .Select(r => r.RelatingPropertyDefinition as IIfcElementQuantity);

            foreach (var qSet in rels)
            {
                foreach (var q in qSet?.Quantities)
                {
                    if (!q.Name.ToString().ToLower().Contains(keyword))
                        continue;

                    if (q is IIfcQuantityLength qLen) return qLen.LengthValue;
                    if (q is IIfcQuantityArea qArea) return qArea.AreaValue;
                    if (q is IIfcQuantityVolume qVol) return qVol.VolumeValue;
                    if (q is IIfcQuantityWeight qW) return qW.WeightValue;
                }
            }

            return null;
        }

        private string GetMaterial(IIfcProduct p)
        {
            try
            {
                var rel = p.HasAssociations
                    ?.OfType<IIfcRelAssociatesMaterial>()
                    .FirstOrDefault();

                if (rel == null) return null;

                var mat = rel.RelatingMaterial;

                if (mat is IIfcMaterial m)
                    return m.Name;

                if (mat is IIfcMaterialLayer ml)
                    return ml.Material?.Name;

                if (mat is IIfcMaterialLayerSet set)
                    return string.Join(", ",
                        set.MaterialLayers
                           .Select(l => l.Material?.Name)
                           .Where(n => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(n)));

                if (mat is IIfcMaterialList list)
                    return string.Join(", ",
                        list.Materials
                            .Select(x => x.Name)
                            .Where(n => !string.IsNullOrEmpty(n)));
            }
            catch { }

            return null;
        }

        private (double L, double W, double H)? GetBoundingBoxSize(IIfcProduct product)
        {
            var shapes = _geometryContext.ShapeInstancesOf(product).ToList();

            if (!shapes.Any())
                return null;

            double minX = double.MaxValue, minY = double.MaxValue, minZ = double.MaxValue;
            double maxX = double.MinValue, maxY = double.MinValue, maxZ = double.MinValue;

            foreach (var shape in shapes)
            {
                var bbox = shape.BoundingBox;
                var transform = shape.Transformation;

                var corners = new[]
                {
            new XbimPoint3D(bbox.Min.X, bbox.Min.Y, bbox.Min.Z),
            new XbimPoint3D(bbox.Max.X, bbox.Min.Y, bbox.Min.Z),
            new XbimPoint3D(bbox.Min.X, bbox.Max.Y, bbox.Min.Z),
            new XbimPoint3D(bbox.Max.X, bbox.Max.Y, bbox.Min.Z),
            new XbimPoint3D(bbox.Min.X, bbox.Min.Y, bbox.Max.Z),
            new XbimPoint3D(bbox.Max.X, bbox.Min.Y, bbox.Max.Z),
            new XbimPoint3D(bbox.Min.X, bbox.Max.Y, bbox.Max.Z),
            new XbimPoint3D(bbox.Max.X, bbox.Max.Y, bbox.Max.Z)
        };

                foreach (var c in corners)
                {
                    var w = transform.Transform(c);

                    minX = Math.Min(minX, w.X);
                    minY = Math.Min(minY, w.Y);
                    minZ = Math.Min(minZ, w.Z);

                    maxX = Math.Max(maxX, w.X);
                    maxY = Math.Max(maxY, w.Y);
                    maxZ = Math.Max(maxZ, w.Z);
                }
            }

            return (
                maxX - minX,
                maxY - minY,
                maxZ - minZ
            );
        }
    }

namespace CraneOptimizer.UI
{
    public partial class App : System.Windows.Application
    {
        public static ServiceProvider ServiceProvider { get; private set; } = null!;

        protected override void OnStartup(StartupEventArgs e)
        {
            // Global exception handlers
            this.DispatcherUnhandledException += App_DispatcherUnhandledException;
            AppDomain.CurrentDomain.UnhandledException += CurrentDomain_UnhandledException;
            TaskScheduler.UnobservedTaskException += TaskScheduler_UnobservedTaskException;

            var configuration = new ConfigurationBuilder()
                .SetBasePath(AppContext.BaseDirectory)
                .AddJsonFile("Data/appsettings.json", optional: false)
                .Build();

            var services = new ServiceCollection();

            var connectionString = configuration.GetConnectionString("DefaultConnection");

            // =========================
            // DbContext
            // =========================
            services.AddDbContext<CraneDbContext>(options =>
                options.UseSqlite(connectionString));

            // =========================
            // Infrastructure
            // =========================
            services.AddScoped<ICraneRepository, CraneRepository>();
            services.AddScoped<IIfcReaderRepository, IfcReaderRepository>();

            // =========================
            // UI Services
            // =========================
            services.AddSingleton<IDialogService, DialogService>();

            // =========================
            // Scene
            // =========================
            services.AddSingleton<SceneService>();
            services.AddSingleton<DrawingService>();
            services.AddSingleton<CoordinateService>();

            // =========================
            // GA
            // =========================
            RegisterGAServices(services);
            services.AddScoped<GAInputBuilder>();
            services.AddScoped<ICranePlacementService, CranePlacementService>();

            // =========================
            // Rendering and Geometry Builders
            // =========================
            services.AddSingleton<ElementVisualBuilder>();
            services.AddSingleton<IRenderingService, HelixRenderingService>();
            services.AddSingleton<ISceneService, SceneService>();
            services.AddSingleton<IIfcOptionsDialogService, IfcOptionsDialogService>();

            // =========================
            // ViewModels
            // =========================
            services.AddSingleton<MainViewModel>();
            services.AddSingleton<DrawingViewModel>();
            services.AddSingleton<CranePlacementViewModel>();
            services.AddSingleton<IfcViewerViewModel>();
            services.AddSingleton<DxfTabViewModel>();

            // =========================
            // Views
            // =========================
            services.AddSingleton<MainWindow>();

            ServiceProvider = services.BuildServiceProvider();

            var mainWindow = ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<MainWindow>();
            // DataContext is already assigned in MainWindow's constructor via DI.
            // Assigning it a second time here would toggle bindings unnecessarily.

            mainWindow.Show();

            base.OnStartup(e);
        }

        protected override void OnExit(ExitEventArgs e)
        {
            // Shut down the Dispatcher FIRST so no pending render callbacks
            // can fire against ViewModels that are about to be disposed.
            Dispatcher.InvokeShutdown();

            try
            {
                ServiceProvider?.Dispose();
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                Debug.WriteLine($"Error disposing ServiceProvider: {ex}");
            }

            base.OnExit(e);
        }

        #region Global exception handlers

        private void App_DispatcherUnhandledException(object sender, DispatcherUnhandledExceptionEventArgs e)
        {
            // Log and show — capture stack trace
            Debug.WriteLine($"DispatcherUnhandledException: {e.Exception}");
            MessageBox.Show($"Unhandled UI exception:\n{e.Exception}\n\nSee Output window for details.", "Unhandled Exception", MessageBoxButton.OK, MessageBoxImage.Error);
            // If you want the app to continue, set e.Handled = true; otherwise the app will shut down
            e.Handled = false;
        }

        private void CurrentDomain_UnhandledException(object sender, UnhandledExceptionEventArgs e)
        {
            Debug.WriteLine($"CurrentDomain UnhandledException: {e.ExceptionObject}");
            // Do not attempt UI actions here if not on UI thread
        }

        private void TaskScheduler_UnobservedTaskException(object? sender, UnobservedTaskExceptionEventArgs e)
        {
            Debug.WriteLine($"UnobservedTaskException: {e.Exception}");
            e.SetObserved();
        }

        #endregion

        private static void RegisterGAServices(IServiceCollection services)
        {
            services.AddScoped<IGeneticAlgorithmEngine, GAEngine>();

            services.AddScoped<IGAInitializer, GAInitializer>();
            services.AddScoped<IElementAssignmentService, ElementAssignmentService>();
            services.AddScoped<IFitnessEvaluator, FitnessEvaluator>();
            services.AddSingleton<CraneSetupViewModel>();
            services.AddScoped<ISelectionStrategy, TournamentSelection>();
            services.AddScoped<ICrossoverOperator, CrossoverOperator>();
            services.AddScoped<IMutationOperator, MutationOperator>();
            services.AddScoped<IReplacementStrategy, ReplacementStrategy>();
            services.AddSingleton<GASettings>();
        }
    }

namespace CraneOptimizer.UI.Core.Base
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Base ViewModel. Suppresses PropertyChanged notifications during application
    /// shutdown to prevent WPF's binding engine from evaluating expressions against
    /// a partially-disposed object graph, which would yield DependencyProperty.UnsetValue
    /// and crash the rendering pipeline.
    /// </summary>
    public class ViewModelBase : INotifyPropertyChanged
    {
        public event PropertyChangedEventHandler? PropertyChanged;

        protected void OnPropertyChanged([CallerMemberName] string? propertyName = null)
        {
            // Do not raise notifications after the Dispatcher has been shut down.
            // At that point the UI has already been torn down and any attempt to
            // propagate a binding update would touch a dead rendering pipeline.
            if (System.Windows.Application.Current == null
                || !System.Windows.Application.Current.Dispatcher.HasShutdownStarted)
            {
                PropertyChanged?.Invoke(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(propertyName));
            }
        }
    }
}
﻿using System.Windows.Input;

namespace CraneOptimizer.UI.Core.Commands
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Non-generic RelayCommand for parameterless actions.
    /// </summary>
    public class RelayCommand : ICommand
    {
        private readonly Action _execute;
        private readonly Func<bool>? _canExecute;

        public RelayCommand(Action execute, Func<bool>? canExecute = null)
        {
            _execute = execute;
            _canExecute = canExecute;
        }

        public bool CanExecute(object? parameter) => _canExecute?.Invoke() ?? true;
        public void Execute(object? parameter) => _execute();

        public event EventHandler? CanExecuteChanged
        {
            add => CommandManager.RequerySuggested += value;
            remove => CommandManager.RequerySuggested -= value;
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Generic RelayCommand for commands that receive a typed parameter.
    /// </summary>
    public class RelayCommand<T> : ICommand
    {
        private readonly Action<T?> _execute;
        private readonly Func<T?, bool>? _canExecute;

        public RelayCommand(Action<T?> execute, Func<T?, bool>? canExecute = null)
        {
            _execute = execute;
            _canExecute = canExecute;
        }

        public bool CanExecute(object? parameter)
            => _canExecute?.Invoke((T?)parameter) ?? true;

        public void Execute(object? parameter)
            => _execute((T?)parameter);

        public event EventHandler? CanExecuteChanged
        {
            add => CommandManager.RequerySuggested += value;
            remove => CommandManager.RequerySuggested -= value;
        }
    }

namespace CraneOptimizer.UI.Core.Converters
{
    public class BoolToColorConverter : IValueConverter
    {
        public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
        {
            if (value is not bool boolValue || parameter is not string paramStr)
                return Binding.DoNothing;

            var parts = paramStr.Split('|');
            if (parts.Length != 2)
                return Binding.DoNothing;

            var trueColor = parts[0].Trim();
            var falseColor = parts[1].Trim();

            var colorString = boolValue ? trueColor : falseColor;

            try
            {
                return (SolidColorBrush)new BrushConverter().ConvertFromString(colorString)!;
            }
            catch
            {
                return Binding.DoNothing;
            }
        }

        public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
            => throw new NotImplementedException();
    }
}

        }

        public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)

    public class LiftStatusToBrushConverter : IValueConverter
    {
        public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
        {
            if (value is not LiftStatus status)
                return Brushes.Gray;

            return status switch
            {
                LiftStatus.Liftable => Brushes.Green,
                LiftStatus.OutOfRadius => Brushes.Red,
                LiftStatus.Overweight => Brushes.Red,
                LiftStatus.HeightFail => Brushes.Red,
                LiftStatus.SpecialCase => Brushes.Yellow,
                _ => Brushes.Gray
            };
        }
        public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
        {
            throw new NotImplementedException();
        }
    }

namespace CraneOptimizer.UI.Core.Converters.DXF
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Converts a hex colour string e.g. "#E74C3C" to System.Windows.Media.Color.
    /// Used in the DXF layer list to display colour swatches from DxfLayerInfo.ColorHex.
    /// WPF's type converter handles literal strings in markup but NOT data-bound strings —
    /// this explicit converter is required for bindings to Color properties.
    /// </summary>
    [ValueConversion(typeof(string), typeof(Color))]
    public class HexStringToColorConverter : IValueConverter
    {
        public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
        {
            if (value is string hex && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(hex))
            {
                try { return (Color)ColorConverter.ConvertFromString(hex); }
                catch { /* fall through */ }
            }
            return Colors.Gray;
        }

        public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
            => throw new NotImplementedException();
    }
}﻿using System.Globalization;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Data;

namespace CraneOptimizer.UI.Core.Converters.DXF
{
    /// <summary>
    /// null / empty string → Collapsed  |  any non-null / non-empty value → Visible
    /// </summary>
    [ValueConversion(typeof(object), typeof(Visibility))]
    public class NullToCollapsedConverter : IValueConverter
    {
        public object Convert(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
        {
            if (value == null)
                return Visibility.Collapsed;

            if (value is string s)
                return string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(s) ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible;

            // For int / collection Count — collapse on zero
            if (value is int i)
                return i == 0 ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible;

            return Visibility.Visible;
        }

        public object ConvertBack(object value, Type targetType, object parameter, CultureInfo culture)
            => throw new NotImplementedException();
    }

﻿using CraneOptimizer.Domain.Schemas;
using DomainPoint = CraneOptimizer.Domain.Common.DomainPoint3D;

namespace CraneOptimizer.UI.Core.Services
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Handles user drawing logic (state + polygon creation).
    /// Keeps UI thin.
    /// </summary>
    public class DrawingService
    {
        private readonly List<DomainPoint> _points = new();

        public void Start() => _points.Clear();
        public bool TryAddPoint(DomainPoint point)
        {
            if (_points.Count < 2)
            {
                _points.Add(point);
                return true;
            }

            var newStart = _points.Last();
            var newEnd = point;

            for (int i = 0; i < _points.Count - 2; i++)
            {
                var a1 = _points[i];
                var a2 = _points[i + 1];

                if (DoLinesIntersect(a1, a2, newStart, newEnd))
                    return false;
            }

            _points.Add(point);
            return true;
        }
        public List<DomainPoint> GetPoints() => _points;

        public void AddPoint(DomainPoint point) => _points.Add(point);
        public GreenAreaZone? BuildZone()
        {
            if (_points.Count < 3) return null;

            var zone = new GreenAreaZone
            {
                Vertices = _points.Select(p => new DomainPoint(p.X, p.Y, p.Z)).ToList()
            };

            return zone;
        }
        private bool DoLinesIntersect(
                        DomainPoint p1, DomainPoint p2,
                        DomainPoint p3, DomainPoint p4)
        {
            double d1 = Direction(p3, p4, p1);
            double d2 = Direction(p3, p4, p2);
            double d3 = Direction(p1, p2, p3);
            double d4 = Direction(p1, p2, p4);

            if ((d1 > 0 && d2 < 0 || d1 < 0 && d2 > 0) &&
                (d3 > 0 && d4 < 0 || d3 < 0 && d4 > 0))
                return true;

            return false;
        }
        private double Direction(DomainPoint a, DomainPoint b, DomainPoint c)
        {
            return (c.X - a.X) * (b.Y - a.Y) - (c.Y - a.Y) * (b.X - a.X);
        }
    }
}﻿using CraneOptimizer.UI.Core.Interfaces;
using HelixToolkit.Wpf;
using System.Windows.Media.Media3D;

namespace CraneOptimizer.UI.Core.Services
{
    public class HelixRenderingService : IRenderingService
    {
        private HelixViewport3D? _viewport;

        private readonly Dictionary<string, List<Visual3D>> _layers = new();

        public void Initialize(HelixViewport3D viewport)
        {
            if (_viewport != null) return;

            _viewport = viewport;
            _viewport.Children.Clear();

            _viewport.Children.Add(new SunLight());
            _viewport.Children.Add(new GridLinesVisual3D { Width = 5000, Length = 5000 });
            _viewport.Children.Add(new CoordinateSystemVisual3D());
        }

        // =========================
        // Render with Layer
        // =========================
        public void Render<T>(IEnumerable<T> items, IVisualBuilder<T> builder, string layerKey)
        {
            EnsureInitialized();

            ClearLayer(layerKey);

            var visuals = new List<Visual3D>();

            foreach (var item in items)
            {
                var visual = builder.Build(item);
                _viewport!.Children.Add(visual);
                visuals.Add(visual);
            }

            _layers[layerKey] = visuals;
        }

        // =========================
        // Clear specific layer
        // =========================
        public void ClearLayer(string layerKey)
        {
            if (!_layers.ContainsKey(layerKey)) return;

            foreach (var visual in _layers[layerKey])
            {
                _viewport!.Children.Remove(visual);
            }

            _layers.Remove(layerKey);
        }

        // =========================
        // Clear all
        // =========================
        public void Clear()
        {
            EnsureInitialized();

            _viewport!.Children.Clear();
            _layers.Clear();

            _viewport.Children.Add(new SunLight());
            _viewport.Children.Add(new GridLinesVisual3D { Width = 200, Length = 200 });
            _viewport.Children.Add(new CoordinateSystemVisual3D());
        }

        private void EnsureInitialized()
        {
            if (_viewport == null)
                throw new System.InvalidOperationException("RenderingService not initialized");
        }

        public HelixViewport3D? GetViewport() => _viewport;

    }

namespace CraneOptimizer.UI.Features.F0_CoordinateSystem
{
    public class CoordinateService
    {
        public const double MillimetersToMetersScale = 0.001;
        public const double MetersToMillimetersScale = 1000.0;

        public double NormalizeLength(double lengthInMillimeters)
        {
            return lengthInMillimeters * MillimetersToMetersScale;
        }

        public double DenormalizeLength(double lengthInMeters)
        {
            return lengthInMeters * MetersToMillimetersScale;
        }

        public DomainPoint3D NormalizePoint(DomainPoint3D point)
        {
            return new DomainPoint3D(
                NormalizeLength(point.X),
                NormalizeLength(point.Y),
                NormalizeLength(point.Z));
        }

        public DomainPoint3D DenormalizePoint(DomainPoint3D point)
        {
            return new DomainPoint3D(
                DenormalizeLength(point.X),
                DenormalizeLength(point.Y),
                DenormalizeLength(point.Z));
        }

        public bool IsValidPoint(DomainPoint3D? point)
        {
            return point != null
                && IsFinite(point.X)
                && IsFinite(point.Y)
                && IsFinite(point.Z);
        }

        public PrecastElement NormalizeElementToMeters(PrecastElement element)
        {
            return new PrecastElement
            {
                ElementID = element.ElementID,
                ElementType = element.ElementType,
                ElementLength = NormalizeNullableLength(element.ElementLength),
                ElementWidth = NormalizeNullableLength(element.ElementWidth),
                ElementHeight = NormalizeNullableLength(element.ElementHeight),
                ElementMaterial = element.ElementMaterial,
                ElementWT = element.ElementWT,
                ElementVolume = element.ElementVolume,
                ElementCOG = NormalizePoint(element.ElementCOG),
                BBoxLength = NormalizeNullableLength(element.BBoxLength),
                BBoxWidth = NormalizeNullableLength(element.BBoxWidth),
                BBoxHeight = NormalizeNullableLength(element.BBoxHeight)
            };
        }

        public GreenAreaZone NormalizeZoneToMeters(GreenAreaZone zone)
        {
            var normalizedVertices = new List<DomainPoint3D>(zone.Vertices.Count);

            for (int i = 0; i < zone.Vertices.Count; i++)
            {
                normalizedVertices.Add(NormalizePoint(zone.Vertices[i]));
            }

            return new GreenAreaZone
            {
                ZoneId = zone.ZoneId,
                Name = zone.Name,
                Type = zone.Type,
                Area = zone.Area * MillimetersToMetersScale * MillimetersToMetersScale,
                Vertices = normalizedVertices
            };
        }

        private static bool IsFinite(double value)
        {
            return !double.IsNaN(value) && !double.IsInfinity(value);
        }

        private double? NormalizeNullableLength(double? value)
        {
            return value.HasValue ? NormalizeLength(value.Value) : null;
        }
    }
}
﻿using System;

namespace CraneOptimizer.UI.Features.F11_DXF.Models
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Axis-aligned bounding rectangle of all DXF entities in DXF world coordinates.
    /// Used by DxfAlignmentService and DxfCanvasRenderer.
    /// CANONICAL LOCATION — do NOT copy or redefine this class elsewhere.
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class DxfBounds
    {
        // ── Raw bounds ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

        public double MinX { get; set; } = double.MaxValue;
        public double MaxX { get; set; } = double.MinValue;
        public double MinY { get; set; } = double.MaxValue;
        public double MaxY { get; set; } = double.MinValue;

        // ── Derived properties ────────────────────────────────────────────────

        /// <summary>True when no geometry has been ingested yet (sentinel values).</summary>
        public bool IsEmpty => MinX >= MaxX || MinY >= MaxY;

        public double Width => IsEmpty ? 0 : MaxX - MinX;
        public double Height => IsEmpty ? 0 : MaxY - MinY;
        public double CenterX => (MinX + MaxX) * 0.5;
        public double CenterY => (MinY + MaxY) * 0.5;

        // ── Factory ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

        public static DxfBounds Empty => new DxfBounds();

        // ── Mutation helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

        public void Expand(double x, double y)
        {
            if (x < MinX) MinX = x;
            if (x > MaxX) MaxX = x;
            if (y < MinY) MinY = y;
            if (y > MaxY) MaxY = y;
        }

        public DxfBounds WithPadding(double pad) => new DxfBounds
        {
            MinX = MinX - pad,
            MaxX = MaxX + pad,
            MinY = MinY - pad,
            MaxY = MaxY + pad
        };

        public override string ToString() =>
            IsEmpty
                ? "DxfBounds(Empty)"
                : $"DxfBounds(X:{MinX:F2}–{MaxX:F2}  Y:{MinY:F2}–{MaxY:F2}  W:{Width:F2} H:{Height:F2})";
    }
}

﻿using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.ComponentModel;
using System.Linq;
using System.Runtime.CompilerServices;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace CraneOptimizer.UI.Features.F11_DXF.Models
{
    /// <summary>
  /// Serialisable snapshot of how a DXF coordinate system maps onto the
  /// IFC / world coordinate system.  All offset values are in metres (SI).
  ///
  /// Transform order applied to every DXF vertex:
  ///   1. Scale about the DXF origin
  ///   2. Rotate clockwise about Z  (degrees)
  ///   3. Translate by (OffsetX, OffsetY)
  /// </summary>
    public class DxfTransformModel : INotifyPropertyChanged
    {
        // ── Transform parameters ──────────────────────────────────────────────

        private double _offsetX;
        public double OffsetX
        {
            get => _offsetX;
            set
            {
                if (_offsetX != value)
                {
                    _offsetX = value;
                    OnPropertyChanged();
                    OnPropertyChanged(nameof(IsDirty));
                }
            }
        }

        private double _offsetY;
        public double OffsetY
        {
            get => _offsetY;
            set
            {
                if (_offsetY != value)
                {
                    _offsetY = value;
                    OnPropertyChanged();
                    OnPropertyChanged(nameof(IsDirty));
                }
            }
        }

        private double _scale = 1.0;
        public double Scale
        {
            get => _scale;
            set
            {
                double clamped = Math.Max(0.0001, Math.Min(10000.0, value));
                if (Math.Abs(_scale - clamped) > 1e-9)
                {
                    _scale = clamped;
                    OnPropertyChanged();
                    OnPropertyChanged(nameof(IsDirty));
                }
            }
        }

        private double _rotationDegrees;
        /// <summary>Clockwise rotation in degrees, normalised to [0, 360).</summary>
        public double RotationDegrees
        {
            get => _rotationDegrees;
            set
            {
                double normalised = ((value % 360) + 360) % 360;
                if (Math.Abs(_rotationDegrees - normalised) > 1e-9)
                {
                    _rotationDegrees = normalised;
                    OnPropertyChanged();
                    OnPropertyChanged(nameof(IsDirty));
                }
            }
        }

        // ── Reference-point pairing (point-match method) ──────────────────────

        private double _dxfRefX;
        public double DxfRefX { get => _dxfRefX; set { _dxfRefX = value; OnPropertyChanged(); } }

        private double _dxfRefY;
        public double DxfRefY { get => _dxfRefY; set { _dxfRefY = value; OnPropertyChanged(); } }

        private double _ifcRefX;
        public double IfcRefX { get => _ifcRefX; set { _ifcRefX = value; OnPropertyChanged(); } }

        private double _ifcRefY;
        public double IfcRefY { get => _ifcRefY; set { _ifcRefY = value; OnPropertyChanged(); } }

        // ── Visual options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────

        private double _opacity = 0.70;
        /// <summary>DXF overlay opacity in the 3D viewport (0.1 – 1.0).</summary>
        public double Opacity
        {
            get => _opacity;
            set
            {
                double v = Math.Clamp(value, 0.1, 1.0);
                if (Math.Abs(_opacity - v) > 1e-9) { _opacity = v; OnPropertyChanged(); }
            }
        }

        private bool _showGrid = true;
        public bool ShowGrid
        {
            get => _showGrid;
            set { _showGrid = value; OnPropertyChanged(); }
        }

        private bool _snapToGrid;
        public bool SnapToGrid
        {
            get => _snapToGrid;
            set { _snapToGrid = value; OnPropertyChanged(); }
        }

        private double _gridSpacing = 5.0;
        /// <summary>Grid spacing in metres for the 2-D canvas viewer.</summary>
        public double GridSpacing
        {
            get => _gridSpacing;
            set { _gridSpacing = Math.Max(0.1, value); OnPropertyChanged(); }
        }

        // ── Computed helpers ──────────────────────────────────────────────────

        /// <summary>True when any parameter differs from identity.</summary>
        public bool IsDirty =>
            Math.Abs(OffsetX) > 1e-9 ||
            Math.Abs(OffsetY) > 1e-9 ||
            Math.Abs(Scale - 1.0) > 1e-9 ||
            Math.Abs(RotationDegrees) > 1e-9;

        /// <summary>Rotation in radians (negate when passing to Math.Cos/Sin for CW→CCW).</summary>
        public double RotationRadians => RotationDegrees * Math.PI / 180.0;

        // ── Serialisation helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────

        /// <summary>Serialise to [tx, ty, scale, rot] for database storage.</summary>
        public double[] ToArray() => new[] { OffsetX, OffsetY, Scale, RotationDegrees };

        /// <summary>Restore from a flat double array produced by <see cref="ToArray"/>.</summary>
        public static DxfTransformModel FromArray(double[] arr)
        {
            if (arr == null || arr.Length < 4)
                return new DxfTransformModel();

            return new DxfTransformModel
            {
                OffsetX = arr[0],
                OffsetY = arr[1],
                Scale = arr[2],
                RotationDegrees = arr[3]
            };
        }

        public DxfTransformModel Clone() => new DxfTransformModel
        {
            OffsetX = OffsetX,
            OffsetY = OffsetY,
            Scale = Scale,
            RotationDegrees = RotationDegrees,
            DxfRefX = DxfRefX,
            DxfRefY = DxfRefY,
            IfcRefX = IfcRefX,
            IfcRefY = IfcRefY,
            Opacity = Opacity,
            ShowGrid = ShowGrid,
            SnapToGrid = SnapToGrid,
            GridSpacing = GridSpacing
        };

        public void Reset()
        {
            OffsetX = OffsetY = DxfRefX = DxfRefY = IfcRefX = IfcRefY = 0;
            Scale = 1.0;
            RotationDegrees = 0;
        }

        // ── INotifyPropertyChanged ────────────────────────────────────────────

        public event PropertyChangedEventHandler? PropertyChanged;

        protected void OnPropertyChanged([CallerMemberName] string? name = null)
            => PropertyChanged?.Invoke(this, new PropertyChangedEventArgs(name));
    }
}
﻿using CraneOptimizer.UI.Features.F11_DXF.Models;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Globalization;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace CraneOptimizer.UI.Features.F11_DXF.Services
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Stateless Application-layer service that owns all alignment maths for
    /// the DXF-to-IFC overlay.
    ///
    /// Rules:
    ///  • No WPF / Windows dependencies — pure C#.
    ///  • No state: every method receives and returns explicit arguments.
    ///  • Works only with Models (DxfTransformModel, DxfBounds).
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class DxfAlignmentService
    {
        // =====================================================================
        //  Manual-transform application
        // =====================================================================

        /// <summary>
        /// Parses the four text-box values from the UI and, if all are valid,
        /// writes them into <paramref name="model"/>.
        /// </summary>
        /// <returns>true if all four values are valid and the model was updated.</returns>
        public bool TryApplyManual(
            DxfTransformModel model,
            string offsetXText,
            string offsetYText,
            string scaleText,
            string rotationText,
            out string error)
        {
            if (model == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(model));

            bool ok = true;
            error = "";

            if (!TryParseDouble(offsetXText, out double offsetX))
            { error += "OffsetX must be a number.\n"; ok = false; }

            if (!TryParseDouble(offsetYText, out double offsetY))
            { error += "OffsetY must be a number.\n"; ok = false; }

            if (!TryParseDouble(scaleText, out double scale) || scale <= 0)
            { error += "Scale must be a positive number.\n"; ok = false; }

            if (!TryParseDouble(rotationText, out double rotation))
            { error += "Rotation must be a number (degrees).\n"; ok = false; }

            if (!ok) { error = error.TrimEnd('\n'); return false; }

            model.OffsetX = offsetX;
            model.OffsetY = offsetY;
            model.Scale = scale;
            model.RotationDegrees = rotation;

            error = "";
            return true;
        }

        // =====================================================================
        //  Point-match
        // =====================================================================

        /// <summary>
        /// Computes and applies a pure-translation offset so that the DXF
        /// reference point maps onto the IFC world reference point.
        /// Scale and rotation are preserved.
        /// </summary>
        public void ApplyPointMatch(
            DxfTransformModel model,
            (double X, double Y) dxfRef,
            (double X, double Y) ifcRef)
        {
            if (model == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(model));

            double s = model.Scale;
            double rad = -model.RotationRadians;
            double cos = Math.Cos(rad);
            double sin = Math.Sin(rad);

            double worldX = s * (cos * dxfRef.X - sin * dxfRef.Y);
            double worldY = s * (sin * dxfRef.X + cos * dxfRef.Y);

            model.OffsetX = ifcRef.X - worldX;
            model.OffsetY = ifcRef.Y - worldY;
        }

        // =====================================================================
        //  Auto-fit helpers
        // =====================================================================

        /// <summary>
        /// Suggests a scale factor that fits the DXF drawing inside a square
        /// canvas of <paramref name="targetSizeMetres"/> metres on each side.
        /// </summary>
        public double SuggestScale(DxfBounds bounds, double targetSizeMetres)
        {
            if (bounds == null || bounds.IsEmpty || targetSizeMetres <= 0)
                return 1.0;

            double maxExtent = Math.Max(bounds.Width, bounds.Height);
            return maxExtent <= 0 ? 1.0 : targetSizeMetres / maxExtent;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Suggests translation offsets (metres) so the scaled DXF is centred
        /// on the given world origin.
        /// </summary>
        public (double Tx, double Ty) SuggestCenterOffset(
            DxfBounds bounds, double scale, double originX, double originY)
        {
            if (bounds == null || bounds.IsEmpty)
                return (originX, originY);

            double scaledCx = bounds.CenterX * scale;
            double scaledCy = bounds.CenterY * scale;
            return (originX - scaledCx, originY - scaledCy);
        }

        // =====================================================================
        //  Undo / snapshot
        // =====================================================================

        /// <summary>Creates an opaque snapshot for undo. Treat as a black-box token.</summary>
        public object Snapshot(DxfTransformModel model)
        {
            if (model == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(model));
            return model.Clone();
        }

        /// <summary>Restores a transform model to the state captured by <see cref="Snapshot"/>.</summary>
        public void Restore(DxfTransformModel model, object snapshot)
        {
            if (model == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(model));
            if (snapshot == null) throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(snapshot));

            if (snapshot is not DxfTransformModel saved)
                throw new ArgumentException(
                    "Snapshot was not produced by DxfAlignmentService.Snapshot.", nameof(snapshot));

            model.OffsetX = saved.OffsetX;
            model.OffsetY = saved.OffsetY;
            model.Scale = saved.Scale;
            model.RotationDegrees = saved.RotationDegrees;
            model.DxfRefX = saved.DxfRefX;
            model.DxfRefY = saved.DxfRefY;
            model.IfcRefX = saved.IfcRefX;
            model.IfcRefY = saved.IfcRefY;
            model.Opacity = saved.Opacity;
            model.ShowGrid = saved.ShowGrid;
            model.SnapToGrid = saved.SnapToGrid;
            model.GridSpacing = saved.GridSpacing;
        }

        // =====================================================================
        //  Private helpers
        // =====================================================================

        private static bool TryParseDouble(string text, out double value)
            => double.TryParse(
                text?.Trim(),
                NumberStyles.Float | NumberStyles.AllowLeadingSign,
                CultureInfo.InvariantCulture,
                out value);
    }
}
﻿using CraneOptimizer.UI.Features.F11_DXF.Models;

using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.Tasks;

namespace CraneOptimizer.UI.Features.F11_DXF.Services
{
    /// <summary>
 /// Persistence contract for DXF overlay data.
 /// Implemented in the Infrastructure layer — never reference EF Core here.
 /// </summary>
    public interface IDxfRepository
    {
        /// <summary>Persist a DXF file path and its alignment transform for a project.</summary>
        Task SaveAsync(int projectId, string filePath, DxfTransformModel transform);

        /// <summary>Load the last saved transform for a project, or null if none.</summary>
        Task<(string? FilePath, DxfTransformModel? Transform)> LoadAsync(int projectId);

        /// <summary>Remove all DXF records for a project.</summary>
        Task DeleteAsync(int projectId);
    }
}
using CraneOptimizer.UI.Core.Base;
using CraneOptimizer.UI.Features.F11_DXF.Models;
using CraneOptimizer.UI.Features.F11_DXF.Services;
using Microsoft.Win32;
using netDxf;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using System.Windows.Input;
using System.Windows.Media.Media3D;
using CraneOptimizer.UI.Core.Commands;
using CraneOptimizer.UI.Features.F11_DXF.Views;
using System.Collections.ObjectModel;


namespace CraneOptimizer.UI.Features.F11_DXF.ViewModels
{
    public sealed class DxfAlignmentViewModel : ViewModelBase
    {
        // ── Injected collaborators ────────────────────────────────────────────

        private readonly DxfUploader? _uploader;
        private readonly DxfAlignmentService _service = new();
        private DxfCanvasRenderer? _canvasRenderer;

        // ── Domain model ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

        public DxfTransformModel Transform { get; } = new();

        // ── Undo stack ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

        private readonly Stack<object> _undoStack = new();
        private const int MaxUndoDepth = 20;

        // ── Loaded document ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

        private DxfDocument? _loadedDocument;

        // ── Empty layers fallback ─────────────────────────────────────────────

        private static readonly ObservableCollection<DxfLayerInfo> _emptyLayers = new();

        // ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
        //  Constructor
        // ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

        public DxfAlignmentViewModel(
            DxfUploader? uploader = null,
            DxfCanvasRenderer? canvasRenderer = null)
        {
            _uploader = uploader;
            _canvasRenderer = canvasRenderer;

            Transform.PropertyChanged += (_, _) => SyncTextFromModel();
            Transform.PropertyChanged += (_, _) => OnPropertyChanged(nameof(TransformSummary));

            LoadDxfCommand = new RelayCommand(ExecuteLoadDxf);
            ApplyManualCommand = new RelayCommand(ExecuteApplyManual);
            ApplyPointMatchCommand = new RelayCommand(ExecuteApplyPointMatch);
            AutoFitCommand = new RelayCommand(
                ExecuteAutoFit,
                () => _canvasRenderer != null && !_canvasRenderer.RawBounds.IsEmpty);
            ResetCommand = new RelayCommand(ExecuteReset);
            UndoCommand = new RelayCommand(ExecuteUndo, () => CanUndo);

            SyncTextFromModel();
        }

        // ── SetRenderer (called by View after Loaded) ─────────────────────────

        public void SetRenderer(DxfCanvasRenderer renderer)
        {
            _canvasRenderer = renderer;
            CommandManager.InvalidateRequerySuggested();
            OnPropertyChanged(nameof(Layers));
        }

        // ── GetResultTransform (called by Dialog after ShowDialog) ─────────────

        public Matrix3D GetResultTransform()
        {
            double s = Transform.Scale;
            double rad = -Transform.RotationRadians;
            double cos = Math.Cos(rad);
            double sin = Math.Sin(rad);

            return new Matrix3D(
                s * cos, -s * sin, 0, 0,
                s * sin, s * cos, 0, 0,
                0, 0, 1, 0,
                Transform.OffsetX, Transform.OffsetY, 0, 1);
        }

        // ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
        //  Commands
        // ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

        public ICommand LoadDxfCommand { get; }
        public ICommand ApplyManualCommand { get; }
        public ICommand ApplyPointMatchCommand { get; }
        public ICommand AutoFitCommand { get; }
        public ICommand ResetCommand { get; }
        public ICommand UndoCommand { get; }

        // ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
        //  Bindable properties — file info
        // ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

        private string _dxfFilePath = "";
        public string DxfFilePath
        {
            get => _dxfFilePath;
            private set { _dxfFilePath = value ?? ""; OnPropertyChanged(); }
        }

        private string _dxfFileName = "";
        public string DxfFileName
        {
            get => _dxfFileName;
            private set { _dxfFileName = value ?? ""; OnPropertyChanged(); }
        }

        private string _dxfInfo = "";
        public string DxfInfo
        {
            get => _dxfInfo;
            private set { _dxfInfo = value ?? ""; OnPropertyChanged(); }
        }

        // ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
        //  Bindable properties — status / feedback
        // ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

        private string _statusMessage = "No DXF file loaded.";
        public string StatusMessage
        {
            get => _statusMessage;
            set { _statusMessage = value ?? ""; OnPropertyChanged(); }
        }

        private string _validationError = "";
        public string ValidationError
        {
            get => _validationError;
            set { _validationError = value ?? ""; OnPropertyChanged(); }
        }

        private bool _isDxfLoading;
        public bool IsDxfLoading
        {
            get => _isDxfLoading;
            private set { _isDxfLoading = value; OnPropertyChanged(); }
        }

        // ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
        //  Bindable properties — transform text boxes
        // ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

        private string _offsetXText = "0.000";
        private string _offsetYText = "0.000";
        private string _scaleText = "1.0000";
        private string _rotationText = "0.00";

        public string OffsetXText
        {
            get => _offsetXText;
            set { _offsetXText = value; OnPropertyChanged(); }
        }

        public string OffsetYText
        {
            get => _offsetYText;
            set { _offsetYText = value; OnPropertyChanged(); }
        }

        public string ScaleText
        {
            get => _scaleText;
            set { _scaleText = value; OnPropertyChanged(); }
        }

        public string RotationText
        {
            get => _rotationText;
            set { _rotationText = value; OnPropertyChanged(); }
        }

        // ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
        //  Bindable properties — point-match reference fields
        // ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

        private string _dxfRefXText = "0";
        private string _dxfRefYText = "0";
        private string _ifcRefXText = "0";
        private string _ifcRefYText = "0";

        public string DxfRefXText { get => _dxfRefXText; set { _dxfRefXText = value; OnPropertyChanged(); } }
        public string DxfRefYText { get => _dxfRefYText; set { _dxfRefYText = value; OnPropertyChanged(); } }
        public string IfcRefXText { get => _ifcRefXText; set { _ifcRefXText = value; OnPropertyChanged(); } }
        public string IfcRefYText { get => _ifcRefYText; set { _ifcRefYText = value; OnPropertyChanged(); } }

        // ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
        //  Bindable properties — visual / overlay
        // ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

        public double Opacity
        {
            get => Transform.Opacity;
            set { Transform.Opacity = value; OnPropertyChanged(); PushToUploader(); }
        }

        // ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
        //  Bindable properties — computed / read-only
        // ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

        public string TransformSummary =>
            $"Offset({Transform.OffsetX:F2}, {Transform.OffsetY:F2})  " +
            $"Scale={Transform.Scale:F4}  Rot={Transform.RotationDegrees:F1}°";

        public bool CanUndo => _undoStack.Count > 0;

        public ObservableCollection<DxfLayerInfo> Layers =>
            _canvasRenderer?.Layers ?? _emptyLayers;

        // ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
        //  Command execute methods
        // ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

        private void ExecuteLoadDxf()
        {
            IsDxfLoading = true;
            ValidationError = "";

            try
            {
                var dlg = new OpenFileDialog
                {
                    Title = "Open DXF Site Plan",
                    Filter = "DXF files (*.dxf)|*.dxf|All files (*.*)|*.*"
                };

                if (dlg.ShowDialog() != true) return;

                var doc = DxfDocument.Load(dlg.FileName);

                if (doc == null)
                {
                    StatusMessage = "⚠  Failed to parse DXF (null document returned).";
                    return;
                }

                _loadedDocument = doc;
                DxfFilePath = dlg.FileName;
                DxfFileName = Path.GetFileName(dlg.FileName);

                int total =
                    doc.Entities.Lines.Count() +
                    doc.Entities.Polylines2D.Count() +
                    doc.Entities.Arcs.Count() +
                    doc.Entities.Circles.Count();

                long fileSizeKb = new FileInfo(dlg.FileName).Length / 1024;
                DxfInfo = $"{total:N0} entities  •  {doc.Layers.Count} layers  •  {fileSizeKb:F0} KB";

                _canvasRenderer?.LoadDocument(doc);
                OnPropertyChanged(nameof(Layers));

                if (_uploader != null)
                {
                    PushToUploader();
                    StatusMessage = $"✓  Loaded: {DxfFileName}";
                }
                else
                {
                    StatusMessage = $"✓  Loaded: {DxfFileName}  " +
                                    "(IFC not yet loaded — transform will apply when IFC opens)";
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                StatusMessage = $"⚠  Error loading DXF: {ex.Message}";
            }
            finally
            {
                IsDxfLoading = false;
            }
        }

        private void ExecuteApplyManual()
        {
            PushUndoSnapshot();

            bool ok = _service.TryApplyManual(
                Transform,
                OffsetXText, OffsetYText, ScaleText, RotationText,
                out string error);

            if (!ok) { ValidationError = error; return; }

            ValidationError = "";
            PushToUploader();
            _canvasRenderer?.FitToView();
            StatusMessage = $"✓  Transform applied — {TransformSummary}";
        }

        private void ExecuteApplyPointMatch()
        {
            if (!double.TryParse(DxfRefXText, out double dxfX) ||
                !double.TryParse(DxfRefYText, out double dxfY))
            {
                ValidationError = "DXF reference coordinates must be numeric values.";
                return;
            }

            if (!double.TryParse(IfcRefXText, out double ifcX) ||
                !double.TryParse(IfcRefYText, out double ifcY))
            {
                ValidationError = "IFC reference coordinates must be numeric values.";
                return;
            }

            ValidationError = "";
            PushUndoSnapshot();
            _service.ApplyPointMatch(Transform, (dxfX, dxfY), (ifcX, ifcY));

            PushToUploader();
            _canvasRenderer?.FitToView();
            StatusMessage =
                $"✓  Point-match applied — offset: ({Transform.OffsetX:F2}, {Transform.OffsetY:F2}) m";
        }

        private void ExecuteAutoFit()
        {
            if (_canvasRenderer == null || _canvasRenderer.RawBounds.IsEmpty) return;

            PushUndoSnapshot();

            double sc = _service.SuggestScale(_canvasRenderer.RawBounds, 500.0);
            (double tx, double ty) = _service.SuggestCenterOffset(
                _canvasRenderer.RawBounds, sc, 0d, 0d);

            Transform.Scale = sc;
            Transform.OffsetX = tx;
            Transform.OffsetY = ty;

            SyncTextFromModel();
            PushToUploader();
            _canvasRenderer.FitToView();
            StatusMessage = $"✓  Auto-fit: scale={sc:F4}, offset=({tx:F2}, {ty:F2})";
        }

        private void ExecuteReset()
        {
            PushUndoSnapshot();
            Transform.Reset();
            SyncTextFromModel();
            PushToUploader();
            _canvasRenderer?.FitToView();
            StatusMessage = "Transform reset to identity.";
        }

        private void ExecuteUndo()
        {
            if (_undoStack.Count == 0) return;

            var snap = _undoStack.Pop();
            _service.Restore(Transform, snap);
            SyncTextFromModel();
            PushToUploader();
            _canvasRenderer?.Redraw();
            StatusMessage = "Undo applied.";
            OnPropertyChanged(nameof(CanUndo));
            CommandManager.InvalidateRequerySuggested();
        }

        // ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
        //  Helpers
        // ═════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

        private void SyncTextFromModel()
        {
            _offsetXText = Transform.OffsetX.ToString("F3");
            _offsetYText = Transform.OffsetY.ToString("F3");
            _scaleText = Transform.Scale.ToString("F4");
            _rotationText = Transform.RotationDegrees.ToString("F2");

            OnPropertyChanged(nameof(OffsetXText));
            OnPropertyChanged(nameof(OffsetYText));
            OnPropertyChanged(nameof(ScaleText));
            OnPropertyChanged(nameof(RotationText));
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Forces text boxes to re-sync from the model.
        /// Called by DxfAlignmentDialog after RestoreTransform sets model values.
        /// </summary>
        public void RefreshTextBoxes() => SyncTextFromModel();

        private void PushUndoSnapshot()
        {
            if (_undoStack.Count >= MaxUndoDepth) return;
            _undoStack.Push(_service.Snapshot(Transform));
            OnPropertyChanged(nameof(CanUndo));
            CommandManager.InvalidateRequerySuggested();
        }

        private void PushToUploader()
        {
            if (_uploader == null) return;
            _uploader.AlignmentTransform = GetResultTransform();
            _uploader.Opacity = Opacity;

            // Re-render if the dialog loaded a file OR if the uploader was pre-loaded
            // externally (via DxfTabViewModel.ExecuteUploadDxf before opening the dialog).
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(DxfFilePath) ||
                !string.IsNullOrEmpty(_uploader.LoadedFilePath))
                _uploader.ReApplyTransform();
        }
    }
}
using CraneOptimizer.UI.Core.Base;
using CraneOptimizer.UI.Core.Commands;
using CraneOptimizer.UI.Features.F11_DXF.Views;
using HelixToolkit.Wpf;
using Microsoft.Win32;
using System.IO;
using System.Windows.Input;
using System.Windows.Media.Media3D;

namespace CraneOptimizer.UI.Features.F11_DXF.ViewModels
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Self-contained ViewModel for the DXF ribbon tab.
    /// Has no dependency on IFC modules.
    /// 
    /// Workflow:
    ///   1. User clicks "Upload DXF" → file picker → path stored, status updated.
    ///   2. User clicks "Align"      → DxfAlignmentDialog opens → transform stored.
    /// </summary>
    public class DxfTabViewModel : ViewModelBase
    {
        // ── Backing fields ────────────────────────────────────────────────
        private DxfUploader? _uploader;
        private string? _loadedFilePath;
        private string _loadedFileName = string.Empty;
        private string _statusMessage  = "No DXF loaded";
        private bool   _hasDxfLoaded;
        private Matrix3D? _pendingTransform;

        // ── Alignment dialog state ───────────────────────────────────────────
        // Persisted between sessions so the user’s last offset/scale/rotation
        // is restored when the dialog is re-opened.
        private double[] _savedTransformArray = { 0, 0, 1.0, 0 };

        // Non-modal dialog reference — reuse if already open
        private DxfAlignmentDialog? _openDialog;

        // ── Commands ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
        public ICommand UploadDxfCommand      { get; }
        public ICommand AlignCommand          { get; }

        // Stubs — visual only, no backend logic yet
        public ICommand AddAnotherDxfCommand  { get; }
        public ICommand DeleteCommand         { get; }
        public ICommand SelectCommand         { get; }
        public ICommand SelectAllCommand      { get; }

        // ── Constructor ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
        public DxfTabViewModel()
        {
            UploadDxfCommand     = new RelayCommand(ExecuteUploadDxf);
            AlignCommand         = new RelayCommand(ExecuteAlign, () => HasDxfLoaded);

            // Stub commands — registered but do nothing yet
            AddAnotherDxfCommand = new RelayCommand(() => { });
            DeleteCommand        = new RelayCommand(() => { });
            SelectCommand        = new RelayCommand(() => { });
            SelectAllCommand     = new RelayCommand(() => { });
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Called by MainWindow after the Helix viewport is ready.
        /// Creates the DxfUploader that renders DXF lines into the 3-D scene.
        /// Pattern mirrors IRenderingService.Initialize(IfcViewer).
        /// </summary>
        public void Initialize(HelixViewport3D viewport)
        {
            _uploader = new DxfUploader(viewport);
        }

        // ── Bindable Properties ───────────────────────────────────────────

        /// <summary>Display name of the currently loaded DXF file (filename only).</summary>
        public string LoadedFileName
        {
            get => _loadedFileName;
            private set { _loadedFileName = value; OnPropertyChanged(); }
        }

        /// <summary>Status text shown in the tab's status strip.</summary>
        public string StatusMessage
        {
            get => _statusMessage;
            private set { _statusMessage = value; OnPropertyChanged(); }
        }

        /// <summary>True when a DXF file has been loaded. Controls Align button enabled state.</summary>
        public bool HasDxfLoaded
        {
            get => _hasDxfLoaded;
            private set { _hasDxfLoaded = value; OnPropertyChanged(); }
        }

        /// <summary>The transform matrix produced by the last alignment session.</summary>
        public Matrix3D? PendingTransform
        {
            get => _pendingTransform;
            private set { _pendingTransform = value; OnPropertyChanged(); }
        }

        // ── Command Implementations ───────────────────────────────────────

        /// <summary>
        /// Upload DXF:
        ///   1. Opens a file picker → user selects a .dxf file.
        ///   2. Calls _uploader.LoadDxf() → renders DXF lines into the 3D viewport immediately.
        ///   3. Immediately opens the DxfAlignmentDialog (with the loaded uploader) for alignment.
        /// Mirrors the reference ZoneModuleController.LoadDxf() pattern exactly.
        /// </summary>
        private void ExecuteUploadDxf()
        {
            var picker = new OpenFileDialog
            {
                Title  = "Select DXF File",
                Filter = "DXF Files (*.dxf)|*.dxf|All Files (*.*)|*.*"
            };

            if (picker.ShowDialog() != true) return;

            _loadedFilePath = picker.FileName;
            LoadedFileName  = Path.GetFileName(picker.FileName);
            StatusMessage   = $"Loading: {LoadedFileName}...";

            // ── Render into the 3D Helix viewport immediately ─────────────
            if (_uploader != null)
            {
                bool success;
                try   { success = _uploader.LoadDxf(_loadedFilePath); }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    StatusMessage = $"⚠ DXF load failed: {ex.Message}";
                    return;
                }

                if (!success)
                {
                    StatusMessage = $"⚠ Could not load DXF: {_uploader.LastLoadDiagnostic}";
                    System.Windows.MessageBox.Show(
                        $"Could not load DXF file.\n\n{_uploader.LastLoadDiagnostic}\n\n" +
                        "Ensure the file is AutoCAD 2010+ DXF format.",
                        "DXF Load Failed",
                        System.Windows.MessageBoxButton.OK,
                        System.Windows.MessageBoxImage.Error);
                    return;
                }
            }

            HasDxfLoaded  = true;
            StatusMessage = $"Loaded: {LoadedFileName}";

            // Open the alignment dialog immediately — uploader is now pre-loaded
            ExecuteAlign();
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Align — opens the DXF alignment dialog as a NON-MODAL window so the user
        /// can still zoom / pan / rotate the Helix 3-D viewport while it is open.
        ///
        /// Behaviour:
        ///  • If already open  → bring it to front.
        ///  • If closed        → create new dialog, restore last transform, show non-modal.
        ///  • On close         → save transform array so next open shows same values.
        /// </summary>
        private void ExecuteAlign()
        {
            // If the dialog is already open, just bring it to the foreground
            if (_openDialog != null)
            {
                _openDialog.Activate();
                return;
            }

            if (_uploader == null) return;

            try
            {
                var dlg = new DxfAlignmentDialog(_uploader);
                dlg.Owner = System.Windows.Application.Current.MainWindow;

                // Restore the values the user entered last time
                dlg.RestoreTransform(_savedTransformArray);

                // Save transform + clear reference when user closes the dialog
                dlg.Closed += (s, e) =>
                {
                    _savedTransformArray = dlg.GetTransformArray();
                    _openDialog = null;
                    StatusMessage = $"Aligned: {LoadedFileName}";
                };

                _openDialog = dlg;
                dlg.Show();   // non-modal — viewport stays interactive
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                StatusMessage = $"Alignment error: {ex.Message}";
            }
        }
    }
}
using CraneOptimizer.UI.Features.F11_DXF.ViewModels;
