using System.Windows.Media.Media3D;

namespace CraneOptimizer.UI.Features.F11_DXF.Views
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Code-behind for DxfAlignmentDialog.xaml.
    ///
    /// The dialog is opened NON-MODALLY via Show() so the user can still
    /// interact with the 3D Helix viewport (zoom / pan / rotate) while
    /// the dialog is visible.
    ///
    /// Usage (from DxfTabViewModel):
    /// <code>
    ///   var dlg = new DxfAlignmentDialog(uploader);
    ///   dlg.Owner  = Application.Current.MainWindow;
    ///   dlg.RestoreTransform(savedArray);      // optional — restore last session
    ///   dlg.Closed += (s, e) => Save(dlg.GetTransformArray());
    ///   dlg.Show();                             // non-modal
    /// </code>
    /// </summary>
    public partial class DxfAlignmentDialog : Window
    {
        private readonly DxfAlignmentViewModel _vm;
        private readonly DxfCanvasRenderer _renderer;

        // ── Constructors ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────

        /// <summary>Opens the alignment dialog in pre-load mode (no 3-D uploader).</summary>
        public DxfAlignmentDialog()
            : this(uploader: null) { }

        /// <summary>
        /// Opens the alignment dialog with an active 3-D uploader so transform
        /// changes update the Helix viewport in real time.
        /// </summary>
        public DxfAlignmentDialog(DxfUploader? uploader)
        {
            InitializeComponent();

            _vm       = new DxfAlignmentViewModel(uploader);
            _renderer = new DxfCanvasRenderer();

            DataContext = _vm;
        }

        // ── Public API ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

        /// <summary>
        /// Restores previously saved transform values into the dialog so the user
        /// sees the same offset / scale / rotation they last entered.
        /// Must be called BEFORE Show().
        /// </summary>
        public void RestoreTransform(double[]? arr)
        {
            if (arr == null || arr.Length < 4) return;

            _vm.Transform.OffsetX         = arr[0];
            _vm.Transform.OffsetY         = arr[1];
            _vm.Transform.Scale           = arr[2];
            _vm.Transform.RotationDegrees = arr[3];
            _vm.RefreshTextBoxes();          // sync text boxes to new model values

            // Push restored values to the 3-D uploader immediately
            if (_vm.ApplyManualCommand.CanExecute(null))
                _vm.ApplyManualCommand.Execute(null);
        }

        /// <summary>Snapshot of [OffsetX, OffsetY, Scale, RotationDegrees] to persist.</summary>
        public double[] GetTransformArray() => _vm.Transform.ToArray();

        /// <summary>Returns the 4×4 alignment Matrix3D (for reading back the transform).</summary>
        public Matrix3D GetResultTransform() => _vm.GetResultTransform();

        /// <summary>File path of the DXF loaded inside the dialog (may be empty).</summary>
        public string LoadedDxfFilePath => _vm.DxfFilePath;

        // ── Lifecycle ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

        private void Window_Loaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            _renderer.Attach(DxfCanvas, _vm.Transform);
            _vm.SetRenderer(_renderer);
        }

        private void Window_Closed(object sender, EventArgs e)
        {
            _renderer.Detach();
        }

        // ── Chrome handlers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

        private void TitleBar_MouseLeftButtonDown(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
        {
            if (e.ButtonState == MouseButtonState.Pressed)
                DragMove();
        }

        private void MinimizeButton_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
            => WindowState = WindowState.Minimized;

        private void CloseButton_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
            => Close();

        // ── Button handlers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────

        /// <summary>
        /// Apply — parses text boxes, pushes transform to 3-D uploader, stays open.
        /// </summary>
        private void Apply_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            if (_vm.ApplyManualCommand.CanExecute(null))
                _vm.ApplyManualCommand.Execute(null);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Apply &amp; Close — applies the transform then closes the dialog.
        /// Does NOT set DialogResult (non-modal windows cannot use DialogResult).
        /// </summary>
        private void ApplyAndClose_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            if (_vm.ApplyManualCommand.CanExecute(null))
                _vm.ApplyManualCommand.Execute(null);
            Close();
        }

        /// <summary>Close without applying additional changes.</summary>
        private void Cancel_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
            => Close();

        /// <summary>Escape key closes the dialog.</summary>
        protected override void OnKeyDown(KeyEventArgs e)
        {
            base.OnKeyDown(e);
            if (e.Key == Key.Escape)
                Close();
        }
    }
}
using CraneOptimizer.UI.Features.F11_DXF.Models;
using netDxf;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Collections.ObjectModel;
using System.Diagnostics;
using System.Linq;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Controls;
using System.Windows.Media;
using System.Windows.Shapes;

namespace CraneOptimizer.UI.Features.F11_DXF.Views
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Renders a <see cref="DxfDocument"/> onto a WPF <see cref="Canvas"/> as 2-D line
    /// geometry for the alignment-dialog preview.
    ///
    /// Responsibilities:
    ///  • Parse DXF entities → WPF shapes on the canvas.
    ///  • Maintain pan / zoom via a <see cref="TransformGroup"/>.
    ///  • Expose <see cref="RawBounds"/> for auto-fit calculations.
    ///  • Expose <see cref="Layers"/> for the layers ListBox.
    /// </summary>
    public sealed class DxfCanvasRenderer
    {
        // ── State ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

        private Canvas? _canvas;
        private DxfTransformModel? _transformModel;
        private DxfDocument? _document;

        private readonly TranslateTransform _panTransform = new();
        private readonly ScaleTransform _zoomTransform = new(1, 1);
        private readonly TransformGroup _viewTransform = new();

        private Point _lastPan;
        private bool _isPanning;

        // ── Public surface ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────

        /// <summary>Axis-aligned bounding box of all raw (untransformed) DXF geometry.</summary>
        public DxfBounds RawBounds { get; private set; } = DxfBounds.Empty;

        /// <summary>Observable list of layers for UI binding.</summary>
        public ObservableCollection<DxfLayerInfo> Layers { get; } = new();

        // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
        //  Lifecycle
        // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

        /// <summary>
        /// Wire up the renderer to a XAML <see cref="Canvas"/>.
        /// Call this from the Window.Loaded handler so ActualWidth / Height are valid.
        /// </summary>
        public void Attach(Canvas canvas, DxfTransformModel transformModel)
        {
            _canvas = canvas ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(canvas));
            _transformModel = transformModel ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(transformModel));

            _viewTransform.Children.Clear();
            _viewTransform.Children.Add(_zoomTransform);
            _viewTransform.Children.Add(_panTransform);

            _canvas.RenderTransform = _viewTransform;

            _canvas.MouseWheel += Canvas_MouseWheel;
            _canvas.MouseLeftButtonDown += Canvas_MouseLeftButtonDown;
            _canvas.MouseLeftButtonUp += Canvas_MouseLeftButtonUp;
            _canvas.MouseMove += Canvas_MouseMove;

            if (_document != null)
                Redraw();
        }

        /// <summary>Unhook events so the canvas can be GC'd.</summary>
        public void Detach()
        {
            if (_canvas != null)
            {
                _canvas.MouseWheel -= Canvas_MouseWheel;
                _canvas.MouseLeftButtonDown -= Canvas_MouseLeftButtonDown;
                _canvas.MouseLeftButtonUp -= Canvas_MouseLeftButtonUp;
                _canvas.MouseMove -= Canvas_MouseMove;
                _canvas.RenderTransform = Transform.Identity;
                _canvas = null;
            }
        }

        // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
        //  Load / draw
        // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

        /// <summary>Loads and immediately renders a DXF document.</summary>
        public void LoadDocument(DxfDocument doc)
        {
            _document = doc ?? throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(doc));
            BuildLayerList(doc);
            Redraw();
            FitToView();
        }

        /// <summary>Clears and redraws the canvas from the current document.</summary>
        public void Redraw()
        {
            if (_canvas == null || _document == null) return;

            _canvas.Children.Clear();
            RawBounds = DxfBounds.Empty;

            var bounds = new DxfBounds();
            var visibleLayers = new HashSet<string>(
                Layers.Where(l => l.IsVisible).Select(l => l.Name),
                StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

            DrawLines(_document, bounds, visibleLayers);
            DrawPolylines2D(_document, bounds, visibleLayers);
            DrawCircles(_document, bounds, visibleLayers);
            DrawArcs(_document, bounds, visibleLayers);

            RawBounds = bounds;
            Log($"Redraw done. Bounds: {bounds}");
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Resets pan/zoom so the entire drawing fits inside the current canvas size.
        /// </summary>
        public void FitToView()
        {
            if (_canvas == null || RawBounds.IsEmpty) return;

            double cw = _canvas.ActualWidth;
            double ch = _canvas.ActualHeight;
            if (cw <= 0 || ch <= 0) return;

            double padding = 20;
            double usableW = cw - padding * 2;
            double usableH = ch - padding * 2;
            if (usableW <= 0 || usableH <= 0) return;

            double scaleX = usableW / RawBounds.Width;
            double scaleY = usableH / RawBounds.Height;
            double scale = Math.Min(scaleX, scaleY);

            // DXF Y-axis points up; WPF Y-axis points down → flip Y
            _zoomTransform.ScaleX = scale;
            _zoomTransform.ScaleY = -scale;

            _panTransform.X = padding - RawBounds.MinX * scale;
            _panTransform.Y = ch - padding + RawBounds.MinY * scale;
        }

        // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
        //  Entity rendering
        // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

        private void DrawLines(DxfDocument doc, DxfBounds bounds, HashSet<string> visibleLayers)
        {
            try
            {
                foreach (var line in doc.Entities.Lines)
                {
                    if (!visibleLayers.Contains(line.Layer.Name)) continue;

                    double x1 = line.StartPoint.X, y1 = line.StartPoint.Y;
                    double x2 = line.EndPoint.X, y2 = line.EndPoint.Y;

                    bounds.Expand(x1, y1);
                    bounds.Expand(x2, y2);

                    AddLine(x1, y1, x2, y2, ResolveColor(line.Color, line.Layer));
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex) { Log($"Lines error: {ex.Message}"); }
        }

        private void DrawPolylines2D(DxfDocument doc, DxfBounds bounds, HashSet<string> visibleLayers)
        {
            try
            {
                foreach (var poly in doc.Entities.Polylines2D)
                {
                    if (!visibleLayers.Contains(poly.Layer.Name)) continue;

                    var pts = new List<Point>();
                    foreach (var v in poly.Vertexes)
                    {
                        double x = v.Position.X, y = v.Position.Y;
                        bounds.Expand(x, y);
                        pts.Add(new Point(x, y));
                    }

                    if (pts.Count < 2) continue;
                    var brush = ResolveColor(poly.Color, poly.Layer);

                    int count = poly.IsClosed ? pts.Count : pts.Count - 1;
                    for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
                        AddLine(pts[i].X, pts[i].Y,
                                pts[(i + 1) % pts.Count].X,
                                pts[(i + 1) % pts.Count].Y,
                                brush);
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex) { Log($"Polylines2D error: {ex.Message}"); }
        }

        private void DrawCircles(DxfDocument doc, DxfBounds bounds, HashSet<string> visibleLayers)
        {
            try
            {
                foreach (var circle in doc.Entities.Circles)
                {
                    if (!visibleLayers.Contains(circle.Layer.Name)) continue;

                    double cx = circle.Center.X, cy = circle.Center.Y, r = circle.Radius;
                    bounds.Expand(cx - r, cy - r);
                    bounds.Expand(cx + r, cy + r);

                    var brush = ResolveColor(circle.Color, circle.Layer);
                    const int seg = 36;
                    for (int i = 0; i < seg; i++)
                    {
                        double a1 = i * Math.PI * 2 / seg;
                        double a2 = (i + 1) * Math.PI * 2 / seg;
                        AddLine(cx + r * Math.Cos(a1), cy + r * Math.Sin(a1),
                                cx + r * Math.Cos(a2), cy + r * Math.Sin(a2),
                                brush);
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex) { Log($"Circles error: {ex.Message}"); }
        }

        private void DrawArcs(DxfDocument doc, DxfBounds bounds, HashSet<string> visibleLayers)
        {
            try
            {
                foreach (var arc in doc.Entities.Arcs)
                {
                    if (!visibleLayers.Contains(arc.Layer.Name)) continue;

                    double cx = arc.Center.X, cy = arc.Center.Y, r = arc.Radius;
                    bounds.Expand(cx - r, cy - r);
                    bounds.Expand(cx + r, cy + r);

                    var brush = ResolveColor(arc.Color, arc.Layer);

                    double startDeg = arc.StartAngle;
                    double endDeg = arc.EndAngle;
                    if (endDeg <= startDeg) endDeg += 360;
                    double span = endDeg - startDeg;
                    int seg = Math.Max(3, (int)(span / 5));

                    for (int i = 0; i < seg; i++)
                    {
                        double a1 = (startDeg + i * span / seg) * Math.PI / 180;
                        double a2 = (startDeg + (i + 1) * span / seg) * Math.PI / 180;
                        AddLine(cx + r * Math.Cos(a1), cy + r * Math.Sin(a1),
                                cx + r * Math.Cos(a2), cy + r * Math.Sin(a2),
                                brush);
                    }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex) { Log($"Arcs error: {ex.Message}"); }
        }

        // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
        //  Canvas helpers
        // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

        private void AddLine(double x1, double y1, double x2, double y2, Brush stroke)
        {
            if (_canvas == null) return;
            _canvas.Children.Add(new Line
            {
                X1 = x1, Y1 = y1,
                X2 = x2, Y2 = y2,
                Stroke = stroke,
                StrokeThickness = 0.5
            });
        }

        // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
        //  Layer extraction
        // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

        private void BuildLayerList(DxfDocument doc)
        {
            Layers.Clear();

            // Count entities per layer
            var counts = new Dictionary<string, int>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
            foreach (var e in doc.Entities.Lines) Inc(counts, e.Layer.Name);
            foreach (var e in doc.Entities.Polylines2D) Inc(counts, e.Layer.Name);
            foreach (var e in doc.Entities.Circles) Inc(counts, e.Layer.Name);
            foreach (var e in doc.Entities.Arcs) Inc(counts, e.Layer.Name);

            foreach (var layer in doc.Layers)
            {
                counts.TryGetValue(layer.Name, out int cnt);
                Layers.Add(new DxfLayerInfo
                {
                    Name = layer.Name,
                    ColorHex = AciToHex(layer.Color),
                    EntityCount = cnt,
                    IsVisible = true
                });
            }

            // Wire visibility toggling
            foreach (var li in Layers)
                li.PropertyChanged += (_, _) => Redraw();
        }

        private static void Inc(Dictionary<string, int> d, string key)
        {
            d.TryGetValue(key, out int c);
            d[key] = c + 1;
        }

        // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
        //  Colour helpers
        // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

        private static Brush ResolveColor(netDxf.AciColor color, netDxf.Tables.Layer layer)
        {
            try
            {
                var c = color.IsByLayer ? layer.Color : color;
                byte r = (byte)((c.Index > 0 && c.Index < 256) ? AciPalette(c.Index, 0) : 160);
                byte g = (byte)((c.Index > 0 && c.Index < 256) ? AciPalette(c.Index, 1) : 160);
                byte b = (byte)((c.Index > 0 && c.Index < 256) ? AciPalette(c.Index, 2) : 160);
                return new SolidColorBrush(Color.FromRgb(r, g, b));
            }
            catch
            {
                return Brushes.Gray;
            }
        }

        private static string AciToHex(netDxf.AciColor color)
        {
            try
            {
                if (color.Index > 0 && color.Index < 256)
                {
                    byte r = (byte)AciPalette(color.Index, 0);
                    byte g = (byte)AciPalette(color.Index, 1);
                    byte b = (byte)AciPalette(color.Index, 2);
                    return $"#{r:X2}{g:X2}{b:X2}";
                }
            }
            catch { }
            return "#A0A0A0";
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Minimal ACI palette lookup (first 10 standard colours, rest grey).
        /// Component: 0=R, 1=G, 2=B.
        /// </summary>
        private static int AciPalette(int index, int component)
        {
            // Standard ACI colours 1-9
            int[][] table =
            {
                new[]{ 255, 0, 0 },     // 1 = Red
                new[]{ 255, 255, 0 },   // 2 = Yellow
                new[]{ 0, 255, 0 },     // 3 = Green
                new[]{ 0, 255, 255 },   // 4 = Cyan
                new[]{ 0, 0, 255 },     // 5 = Blue
                new[]{ 255, 0, 255 },   // 6 = Magenta
                new[]{ 255, 255, 255 }, // 7 = White
                new[]{ 128, 128, 128 }, // 8 = Dark grey
                new[]{ 192, 192, 192 }, // 9 = Light grey
            };

            if (index >= 1 && index <= 9)
                return table[index - 1][component];

            return 160; // fallback grey
        }

        // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
        //  Pan / zoom handlers
        // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

        private void Canvas_MouseWheel(object sender, System.Windows.Input.MouseWheelEventArgs e)
        {
            double factor = e.Delta > 0 ? 1.15 : 1.0 / 1.15;
            _zoomTransform.ScaleX *= factor;
            _zoomTransform.ScaleY *= factor; // preserves Y-flip sign
        }

        private void Canvas_MouseLeftButtonDown(object sender, System.Windows.Input.MouseButtonEventArgs e)
        {
            _isPanning = true;
            _lastPan = e.GetPosition((UIElement)_canvas!.Parent);
            _canvas.CaptureMouse();
        }

        private void Canvas_MouseLeftButtonUp(object sender, System.Windows.Input.MouseButtonEventArgs e)
        {
            _isPanning = false;
            _canvas?.ReleaseMouseCapture();
        }

        private void Canvas_MouseMove(object sender, System.Windows.Input.MouseEventArgs e)
        {
            if (!_isPanning || _canvas == null) return;

            var pos = e.GetPosition((UIElement)_canvas.Parent);
            _panTransform.X += pos.X - _lastPan.X;
            _panTransform.Y += pos.Y - _lastPan.Y;
            _lastPan = pos;
        }

        // ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

        private static void Log(string msg)
            => Debug.WriteLine($"[DxfCanvasRenderer] {msg}");
    }
}

using HelixToolkit.Wpf;
using netDxf;
using netDxf.Header;
using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using System.Windows.Media.Media3D;
using System.Windows.Media;

namespace CraneOptimizer.UI.Features.F11_DXF.Views
{
    public class DxfUploader
    {
        private readonly HelixViewport3D _viewport;
        private readonly List<ModelVisual3D> _dxfVisuals = new();

        public List<Point3D> SnapPoints { get; private set; } = new();
        public bool IsLoaded { get; private set; }
        public string? LoadedFilePath { get; private set; }
        public bool IsVisible { get; private set; } = true;

        public string LastLoadDiagnostic { get; private set; } = "";

        private double _opacity = 0.7;
        public double Opacity
        {
            get => _opacity;
            set { _opacity = Math.Clamp(value, 0.1, 1.0); RefreshOpacity(); }
        }

        public Matrix3D AlignmentTransform { get; set; } = Matrix3D.Identity;

        public DxfUploader(HelixViewport3D viewport)
        {
            _viewport = viewport;
        }

        // ── LoadDxf — returns true on success, never throws ───────────────────

        public bool LoadDxf(string filePath)
        {
            LastLoadDiagnostic = "";
            try
            {
                DxfVersion version;
                try
                {
                    version = DxfDocument.CheckDxfFileVersion(filePath);
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    LastLoadDiagnostic = $"Cannot read DXF version: {ex.Message}";
                    return false;
                }

                Log($"DXF version detected: {version}");

                if (version < DxfVersion.AutoCad2000)
                {
                    LastLoadDiagnostic =
                        $"DXF version too old: {version}\n" +
                        "netDxf requires AutoCad2000 or higher.\n" +
                        "Save your file as AutoCAD 2010 DXF and try again.";
                    Log(LastLoadDiagnostic);
                    return false;
                }

                DxfDocument? dxf = null;
                try
                {
                    dxf = DxfDocument.Load(filePath);
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    LastLoadDiagnostic = $"DxfDocument.Load threw: {ex.GetType().Name}: {ex.Message}";
                    Log(LastLoadDiagnostic);
                    return false;
                }

                if (dxf == null)
                {
                    LastLoadDiagnostic = "DxfDocument.Load returned null — file may be corrupt.";
                    Log(LastLoadDiagnostic);
                    return false;
                }

                Clear();
                LoadedFilePath = filePath;
                IsLoaded = true;

                int pointCount = RenderDxf(dxf);
                Log($"Render done. Points: {pointCount}");
                return true;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                LastLoadDiagnostic = $"Unexpected: {ex.GetType().Name}: {ex.Message}";
                Log(LastLoadDiagnostic);
                IsLoaded = false;
                return false;
            }
        }

        // ── RenderDxf ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

        private int RenderDxf(DxfDocument dxf)
        {
            var pts = new Point3DCollection();
            SnapPoints.Clear();

            int lineCount = 0, polyCount = 0, circleCount = 0, arcCount = 0, splineCount = 0;

            // Lines
            try
            {
                foreach (var line in dxf.Entities.Lines)
                {
                    try
                    {
                        var a = TransformPoint(line.StartPoint.X, line.StartPoint.Y);
                        var b = TransformPoint(line.EndPoint.X, line.EndPoint.Y);
                        pts.Add(a); pts.Add(b);
                        SnapPoints.Add(a); SnapPoints.Add(b);
                        SnapPoints.Add(new Point3D((a.X + b.X) / 2, (a.Y + b.Y) / 2, 0));
                        lineCount++;
                    }
                    catch { }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex) { Log($"Lines collection error: {ex.Message}"); }

            // Polylines2D
            try
            {
                foreach (var poly in dxf.Entities.Polylines2D)
                {
                    try
                    {
                        var verts = new List<Point3D>();
                        foreach (var v in poly.Vertexes)
                            verts.Add(TransformPoint(v.Position.X, v.Position.Y));

                        if (verts.Count < 2) continue;

                        int count = poly.IsClosed ? verts.Count : verts.Count - 1;
                        for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
                        {
                            pts.Add(verts[i]);
                            pts.Add(verts[(i + 1) % verts.Count]);
                        }
                        SnapPoints.AddRange(verts);
                        polyCount++;
                    }
                    catch { }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex) { Log($"Polylines2D collection error: {ex.Message}"); }

            // Circles
            try
            {
                foreach (var circle in dxf.Entities.Circles)
                {
                    try
                    {
                        var center = TransformPoint(circle.Center.X, circle.Center.Y);
                        double r = circle.Radius;
                        const int seg = 36;
                        for (int i = 0; i < seg; i++)
                        {
                            double a1 = i * Math.PI * 2 / seg;
                            double a2 = (i + 1) * Math.PI * 2 / seg;
                            pts.Add(new Point3D(center.X + r * Math.Cos(a1), center.Y + r * Math.Sin(a1), 0.002));
                            pts.Add(new Point3D(center.X + r * Math.Cos(a2), center.Y + r * Math.Sin(a2), 0.002));
                        }
                        SnapPoints.Add(center);
                        circleCount++;
                    }
                    catch { }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex) { Log($"Circles collection error: {ex.Message}"); }

            // Arcs
            try
            {
                foreach (var arc in dxf.Entities.Arcs)
                {
                    try
                    {
                        var center = TransformPoint(arc.Center.X, arc.Center.Y);
                        double r = arc.Radius;
                        double startDeg = arc.StartAngle;
                        double endDeg = arc.EndAngle;
                        if (endDeg <= startDeg) endDeg += 360;
                        double span = endDeg - startDeg;
                        int seg = Math.Max(3, (int)(span / 5));
                        for (int i = 0; i < seg; i++)
                        {
                            double a1 = (startDeg + i * span / seg) * Math.PI / 180;
                            double a2 = (startDeg + (i + 1) * span / seg) * Math.PI / 180;
                            pts.Add(new Point3D(center.X + r * Math.Cos(a1), center.Y + r * Math.Sin(a1), 0.002));
                            pts.Add(new Point3D(center.X + r * Math.Cos(a2), center.Y + r * Math.Sin(a2), 0.002));
                        }
                        SnapPoints.Add(center);
                        arcCount++;
                    }
                    catch { }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex) { Log($"Arcs collection error: {ex.Message}"); }

            // Splines
            try
            {
                foreach (var spline in dxf.Entities.Splines)
                {
                    try
                    {
                        var ctrlPts = new List<Point3D>();
                        foreach (var cp in spline.ControlPoints)
                        {
                            double cx = 0, cy = 0;
                            bool ok = false;

                            if (!ok)
                            {
                                try { var pos = ((dynamic)cp).Position; cx = (double)pos.X; cy = (double)pos.Y; ok = true; }
                                catch { }
                            }
                            if (!ok)
                            {
                                try { cx = (double)((dynamic)cp).X; cy = (double)((dynamic)cp).Y; ok = true; }
                                catch { }
                            }

                            if (ok) ctrlPts.Add(TransformPoint(cx, cy));
                        }

                        if (ctrlPts.Count < 2) continue;
                        for (int i = 0; i < ctrlPts.Count - 1; i++)
                        {
                            pts.Add(ctrlPts[i]);
                            pts.Add(ctrlPts[i + 1]);
                        }
                        SnapPoints.AddRange(ctrlPts);
                        splineCount++;
                    }
                    catch { }
                }
            }
            catch (Exception ex) { Log($"Splines collection error: {ex.Message}"); }

            Log($"Entities — Lines:{lineCount} Polys:{polyCount} Circles:{circleCount} Arcs:{arcCount} Splines:{splineCount}");

            if (pts.Count > 0)
            {
                byte alpha = (byte)(_opacity * 255);
                var dxfLines = new LinesVisual3D
                {
                    Color = Color.FromArgb(alpha, 160, 160, 160),
                    Thickness = 1.0,
                    Points = pts
                };
                _viewport.Children.Add(dxfLines);
                _dxfVisuals.Add(dxfLines);
            }

            return pts.Count;
        }

        // ── Helpers ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

        private Point3D TransformPoint(double x, double y)
        {
            var pt = new Point3D(x, y, 0.002);
            return AlignmentTransform.Transform(pt);
        }

        public void ToggleVisibility()
        {
            IsVisible = !IsVisible;
            foreach (var v in _dxfVisuals)
            {
                if (IsVisible) { if (!_viewport.Children.Contains(v)) _viewport.Children.Add(v); }
                else { _viewport.Children.Remove(v); }
            }
        }

        private void RefreshOpacity()
        {
            if (!IsLoaded || string.IsNullOrEmpty(LoadedFilePath)) return;
            LoadDxf(LoadedFilePath);
        }

        public void ReApplyTransform()
        {
            if (!IsLoaded || string.IsNullOrEmpty(LoadedFilePath)) return;
            LoadDxf(LoadedFilePath);
        }

        public void Clear()
        {
            foreach (var v in _dxfVisuals) _viewport.Children.Remove(v);
            _dxfVisuals.Clear();
            SnapPoints.Clear();
            IsLoaded = false;
        }

        private static void Log(string msg)
            => System.Diagnostics.Debug.WriteLine($"[DxfUploader] {msg}");
    }
}

﻿using CraneOptimizer.Application.Optimization.GeneticAlgorithms.Models;
using CraneOptimizer.Domain.Schemas;
using CraneOptimizer.UI.Core.Interfaces;
using HelixToolkit.Geometry;
using System.Numerics;
using System.Windows.Media;
using System.Windows.Media.Media3D;

namespace CraneOptimizer.UI.Features.F2_IfcViewer
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Builds visual representation of IFC elements (no viewport logic).
    /// </summary>
    public class ElementVisualBuilder : IVisualBuilder<(PrecastElement element, LiftStatus? status)>
    {
        public Visual3D Build((PrecastElement element, LiftStatus? status) item)
        {
            return BuildInternal(item.element, item.status);
        }

        private ModelVisual3D BuildInternal(PrecastElement element, LiftStatus? status)
        {
            var meshBuilder = new MeshBuilder(true, true);

            meshBuilder.AddBox(
                new Vector3(
                    (float)element.ElementCOG.X,
                    (float)element.ElementCOG.Y,
                    (float)element.ElementCOG.Z),

                (float)(element.BBoxLength ?? 1),
                (float)(element.BBoxWidth ?? 1),
                (float)(element.BBoxHeight ?? 1)
            );

            var helixMesh = meshBuilder.ToMesh();

            var mesh = new System.Windows.Media.Media3D.MeshGeometry3D
            {
                Positions = new Point3DCollection(
                    helixMesh.Positions.Select(p => new Point3D(p.X, p.Y, p.Z))),

                TriangleIndices = new Int32Collection(helixMesh.TriangleIndices),

                Normals = new Vector3DCollection(
                    helixMesh.Normals.Select(n => new Vector3D(n.X, n.Y, n.Z)))
            };

            var color = GetColor(status);

            var material = new DiffuseMaterial(
                new SolidColorBrush(color));

            var model = new GeometryModel3D
            {
                Geometry = mesh,
                Material = material,
                BackMaterial = material
            };

            return new ModelVisual3D { Content = model };
        }

        private Color GetColor(LiftStatus? status)
        {
            if (status == null)
                return Colors.Gray;

            return status switch
            {
                LiftStatus.Liftable => Colors.Green,

                LiftStatus.OutOfRadius => Colors.Red,
                LiftStatus.Overweight => Colors.Red,
                LiftStatus.HeightFail => Colors.Red,

                LiftStatus.SpecialCase => Colors.Yellow,

                _ => Colors.Gray
            };
        }
    }

﻿using CraneOptimizer.Domain.Interfaces;
using CraneOptimizer.Domain.Schemas;
using CraneOptimizer.UI.Core.Base;
using CraneOptimizer.UI.Core.Commands;
using CraneOptimizer.UI.Core.Interfaces;
using CraneOptimizer.UI.Features.F2_IfcViewer.Models;
using CraneOptimizer.UI.Features.F2_IfcViewer.Services;
using System.Windows.Input;

namespace CraneOptimizer.UI.Features.F2_IfcViewer.ViewModels
{
    public class IfcViewerViewModel : ViewModelBase
    {
        private readonly IIfcReaderRepository _ifcReader;
        private readonly ISceneService _scene;
        private readonly IIfcOptionsDialogService _dialogService;
        private readonly IDialogService _dialog;

        public ICommand LoadIfcCommand { get; }

        private bool _isLoading;
        public bool IsLoading
        {
            get => _isLoading;
            set { _isLoading = value; OnPropertyChanged(); }
        }

        private string _status = "Idle";
        public string Status
        {
            get => _status;
            set { _status = value; OnPropertyChanged(); }
        }

        private double _progress;
        public double Progress
        {
            get => _progress;
            set { _progress = value; OnPropertyChanged(); }
        }

        public IfcViewerViewModel(
            IIfcReaderRepository ifcReader,
            ISceneService scene,
            IDialogService dialog,
            IIfcOptionsDialogService dialogService)
        {
            _ifcReader = ifcReader;
            _scene = scene;
            _dialog = dialog;
            _dialogService = dialogService;

            LoadIfcCommand = new RelayCommand(async () => await LoadIfcAsync(), () => !IsLoading);
        }

        private async Task LoadIfcAsync()
        {
            try
            {
                IsLoading = true;
                Progress = 0;
                Status = "Selecting file...";

                var path = _dialog.OpenFile("IFC (*.ifc)|*.ifc");
                if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(path)) return;

                var filter = _dialogService.Show(path);
                if (filter == null) return;

                Status = "Reading IFC...";

                var progress = new Progress<double>(p =>
                {
                    Progress = p;
                    Status = $"Reading IFC... {p:F0}%";
                });

                var all = await Task.Run(() =>
                    _ifcReader.ReadElements(path, progress));

                if (all == null || !all.Any())
                {
                    _dialog.ShowMessage("No elements found.");
                    return;
                }

                Status = "Filtering...";
                var visible = ApplyFilter(all, filter);

                Status = "Updating scene...";
                _scene.SetElements(visible);

                Progress = 100;
                Status = $"Loaded {visible.Count} elements";
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                _dialog.ShowMessage(ex.Message);
            }
            finally
            {
                IsLoading = false;
            }
        }

        private static List<PrecastElement> ApplyFilter(
            List<PrecastElement> elements,
            IfcFilterOptions options)
        {
            return elements.Where(e =>
            {
                var t = e.ElementType ?? "";

                if (options.HideGrids && t.Contains("IfcGrid", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) return false;
                if (options.HideLevels && t.Contains("IfcBuildingStorey", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) return false;
                if (options.HideAnnotations && t.Contains("IfcAnnotation", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) return false;
                if (options.HideSite && t.Contains("IfcSite", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) return false;
                if (options.HideSpaces && t.Contains("IfcSpace", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) return false;
                if (options.HideOpenings && t.Contains("IfcOpeningElement", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) return false;
                if (options.HideVirtualElements && t.Contains("IfcVirtualElement", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)) return false;

                return true;
            }).ToList();
        }
    }

﻿// CraneVisualBuilder.cs  (replaces the existing stub)
using CraneOptimizer.Domain.Entities;
using CraneOptimizer.Domain.Entities.Enums;
using CraneOptimizer.UI.Core.Interfaces;
using HelixToolkit.Geometry;
using System.Numerics;
using System.Windows.Media;
using System.Windows.Media.Media3D;

namespace CraneOptimizer.UI.Features.F3_CraneSetup
{
    public class CraneVisualBuilder : IVisualBuilder<Crane>
    {
        private readonly Action<ModelVisual3D>? _onBuilt;
        public CraneVisualBuilder() { }
        public CraneVisualBuilder(Action<ModelVisual3D> onBuilt)
        {
            _onBuilt = onBuilt;
        }
        public Visual3D Build(Crane crane)
        {
            // A ModelVisual3D is the WPF 3D container.
            // We build separate meshes for each part and combine them.
            var group = new Model3DGroup();
            var visual = new ModelVisual3D { Content = group, Transform = new TranslateTransform3D(0, 0, 0) };
            // ── Part 1: Vehicle Body ──────────────────────────────────────
            // Use the real dimensions from the database.
            // The body sits on Z=0, so its centre is at Z = VehicleHeight / 2
            double bodyX = crane.VehicleLength;   // length along X axis
            double bodyY = crane.VehicleWidth;    // width along Y axis
            double bodyZ = crane.VehicleHeight;   // height along Z axis

            var bodyMesh = BuildBox(
                centerX: 0,
                centerY: 0,
                centerZ: bodyZ / 2.0,   // sit on the ground
                sizeX: bodyX,
                sizeY: bodyY,
                sizeZ: bodyZ,
                color: Colors.DarkOrange
            );
            group.Children.Add(bodyMesh);

            // ── Part 2: Boom ──────────────────────────────────────────────
            // The boom starts at the top of the body and points upward.
            // We use MaxBoomLength from the first CraneSpecification.
            var spec = crane.Specifications.FirstOrDefault();
            if (spec != null)
            {
                double boomLength = spec.MaxBoomLength;
                double boomThickness = Math.Max(bodyY * 0.08, 0.3); // 8% of body width, min 0.3m

                // The boom is a thin vertical box on top of the body
                var boomMesh = BuildBox(
                    centerX: 0,
                    centerY: 0,
                    centerZ: bodyZ + (boomLength / 2.0),  // starts at top of body
                    sizeX: boomThickness,
                    sizeY: boomThickness,
                    sizeZ: boomLength,
                    color: Colors.Yellow
                );
                group.Children.Add(boomMesh);
            }

            // ── Part 3: Outriggers (Mobile/Crawler only) ──────────────────
            if (crane.OutriggerLength.HasValue && crane.OutriggerWidth.HasValue)
            {
                double oL = crane.OutriggerLength.Value;
                double oW = crane.OutriggerWidth.Value;
                double oH = bodyZ * 0.15;   // outrigger height = 15% of body height

                // Outriggers extend symmetrically from each side of the body
                double halfSpanX = oW / 2.0;
                double halfSpanY = oL / 2.0;

                // Four outrigger pads — one at each corner
                double[] xOffsets = { -halfSpanX, halfSpanX, -halfSpanX, halfSpanX };
                double[] yOffsets = { -halfSpanY, -halfSpanY, halfSpanY, halfSpanY };

                double padSize = Math.Max(oL * 0.15, 0.5); // 0.5m minimum pad

                for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
                {
                    var pad = BuildBox(
                        centerX: xOffsets[i],
                        centerY: yOffsets[i],
                        centerZ: oH / 2.0,
                        sizeX: padSize,
                        sizeY: padSize,
                        sizeZ: oH,
                        color: Colors.DarkGray
                    );
                    group.Children.Add(pad);
                }
                _onBuilt?.Invoke(visual);

                return visual;
            }



            // ── Wrap in ModelVisual3D ─────────────────────────────────────
            // ModelVisual3D is the object that actually gets added to the viewport.
            // We give it a TranslateTransform3D so dragging only updates the transform,
            // not the geometry (much faster).

            return visual;
        }

        // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
        // PRIVATE HELPER: Builds one coloured box mesh
        // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
        private GeometryModel3D BuildBox(
            double centerX, double centerY, double centerZ,
            double sizeX, double sizeY, double sizeZ,
            Color color)
        {
            // MeshBuilder is a HelixToolkit utility — it accumulates geometry
            // and produces a standard WPF MeshGeometry3D at the end.
            var mb = new MeshBuilder(true, true);

            mb.AddBox(
                new Vector3((float)centerX, (float)centerY, (float)centerZ),
                (float)sizeX,
                (float)sizeY,
                (float)sizeZ
            );

            var helixMesh = mb.ToMesh();

            // Convert from HelixToolkit's internal format to WPF's MeshGeometry3D
            var wpfMesh = new System.Windows.Media.Media3D.MeshGeometry3D
            {
                Positions = new Point3DCollection(helixMesh.Positions.Select(p => new Point3D(p.X, p.Y, p.Z))),
                TriangleIndices = new Int32Collection(helixMesh.TriangleIndices),
                Normals = new Vector3DCollection(helixMesh.Normals.Select(n => new Vector3D(n.X, n.Y, n.Z)))
            };

            var material = new DiffuseMaterial(new SolidColorBrush(color));

            return new GeometryModel3D
            {
                Geometry = wpfMesh,
                Material = material,
                BackMaterial = material   // visible from all angles
            };

        }
    }
}﻿using CraneOptimizer.Domain.Common;
using CraneOptimizer.Domain.Schemas;

namespace CraneOptimizer.UI.Features.F3_CraneSetup
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Enforces green zone boundary rules during crane dragging.
    ///
    /// Rule:
    ///   • If no zones exist → any position is allowed (return as-is).
    ///   • If zones exist    → position must be inside at least one zone.
    ///                         If it is outside, CLAMP it to the nearest valid point.
    /// </summary>
    public static class GreenZoneConstraint
    {
        /// <summary>
        /// Returns the nearest allowed position for the given candidate point.
        /// </summary>
        public static DomainPoint3D Clamp(DomainPoint3D candidate, List<GreenAreaZone> zones)
        {
            // No zones → free movement
            if (zones == null || zones.Count == 0)
                return candidate;

            // Already inside a zone → accept as-is
            if (IsInsideAnyZone(candidate, zones))
                return candidate;

            // Outside all zones → find the closest point on any zone boundary
            // This is the "clamp" behaviour: the crane snaps to the edge.
            return FindNearestBoundaryPoint(candidate, zones);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Returns true if the point is inside any green zone polygon.
        /// Uses the Ray Casting algorithm (same as your existing GA code).
        /// </summary>
        public static bool IsInsideAnyZone(DomainPoint3D point, List<GreenAreaZone> zones)
        {
            return zones.Any(zone => IsPointInsidePolygon(point, zone.Vertices));
        }

        // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
        // RAY CASTING — point-in-polygon test
        // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
        // This is the same algorithm already used in your GAInitializer and
        // MutationOperator — extracted here so the UI can reuse it too.
        //
        // How it works: cast a horizontal ray from the point to the right.
        // Count how many times it crosses a polygon edge.
        // Odd count → inside. Even count → outside.
        private static bool IsPointInsidePolygon(DomainPoint3D point, List<DomainPoint3D> polygon)
        {
            bool inside = false;

            for (int i = 0, j = polygon.Count - 1; i < polygon.Count; j = i++)
            {
                var pi = polygon[i];
                var pj = polygon[j];

                bool crossesY = (pi.Y > point.Y) != (pj.Y > point.Y);
                bool crossesX = point.X < (pj.X - pi.X) * (point.Y - pi.Y) / (pj.Y - pi.Y) + pi.X;

                if (crossesY && crossesX)
                    inside = !inside;
            }

            return inside;
        }

        // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
        // CLAMPING — find closest point on zone boundary
        // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
        private static DomainPoint3D FindNearestBoundaryPoint(
            DomainPoint3D candidate,
            List<GreenAreaZone> zones)
        {
            DomainPoint3D? best = null;
            double bestDist = double.MaxValue;

            foreach (var zone in zones)
            {
                var verts = zone.Vertices;

                for (int i = 0, j = verts.Count - 1; i < verts.Count; j = i++)
                {
                    // Project candidate onto this edge; clamp to segment endpoints
                    var closest = ClosestPointOnSegment(candidate, verts[j], verts[i]);
                    double dist = Distance2D(candidate, closest);

                    if (dist < bestDist)
                    {
                        bestDist = dist;
                        best = closest;
                    }
                }
            }

            return best ?? candidate;
        }

        private static DomainPoint3D ClosestPointOnSegment(
            DomainPoint3D p, DomainPoint3D a, DomainPoint3D b)
        {
            double abX = b.X - a.X;
            double abY = b.Y - a.Y;
            double len2 = abX * abX + abY * abY;

            if (len2 < 1e-10) return a; // degenerate segment

            // t is the 0→1 parameter along the segment
            double t = ((p.X - a.X) * abX + (p.Y - a.Y) * abY) / len2;
            t = Math.Clamp(t, 0.0, 1.0);

            return new DomainPoint3D(
                a.X + t * abX,
                a.Y + t * abY,
                0   // ground plane Z
            );
        }

        private static double Distance2D(DomainPoint3D a, DomainPoint3D b)
        {
            double dx = a.X - b.X;
            double dy = a.Y - b.Y;
            return Math.Sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy);
        }
    }

namespace CraneOptimizer.UI.Features.F3_CraneSetup.ViewModels
{
    public class CraneManagerViewModel : ViewModelBase
    {
        // ── Properties ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
        public ObservableCollection<CraneItemViewModel> Cranes { get; } = new();

        private CraneItemViewModel? _selectedCrane;
        public CraneItemViewModel? SelectedCrane
        {
            get => _selectedCrane;
            set { _selectedCrane = value; OnPropertyChanged(); }
        }

        // ── Commands ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
        public ICommand AddTowerCraneCommand  { get; }
        public ICommand AddMobileCraneCommand { get; }
        public ICommand RemoveCraneCommand    { get; }
        public ICommand RemoveAllCranesCommand{ get; }

        public CraneManagerViewModel()
        {
            AddTowerCraneCommand   = new RelayCommand(AddTowerCrane);
            AddMobileCraneCommand  = new RelayCommand(AddMobileCrane);
            RemoveCraneCommand     = new RelayCommand<CraneItemViewModel>(RemoveCrane);
            RemoveAllCranesCommand = new RelayCommand(RemoveAll);
        }

        private void AddTowerCrane()
        {
            var crane = new CraneItemViewModel
            {
                Name = $"Tower Crane {Cranes.Count + 1}",
                Type = "TowerCrane"
            };
            Cranes.Add(crane);
            SelectedCrane = crane;
        }

        private void AddMobileCrane()
        {
            var crane = new CraneItemViewModel
            {
                Name = $"Mobile Crane {Cranes.Count + 1}",
                Type = "MobileCrane"
            };
            Cranes.Add(crane);
            SelectedCrane = crane;
        }

        private void RemoveCrane(CraneItemViewModel? crane)
        {
            if (crane != null) Cranes.Remove(crane);
        }

        private void RemoveAll() => Cranes.Clear();
    }

    public class CraneItemViewModel : ViewModelBase
    {
        private string _name = string.Empty;
        private string _type = string.Empty;

        public string Name
        {
            get => _name;
            set { _name = value; OnPropertyChanged(); }
        }

        public string Type
        {
            get => _type;
            set { _type = value; OnPropertyChanged(); }
        }
    }
}
﻿using CraneOptimizer.Domain.Common;
using CraneOptimizer.Domain.Entities;
using CraneOptimizer.Domain.Schemas;
using CraneOptimizer.UI.Core.Base;

namespace CraneOptimizer.UI.Features.F3_CraneSetup.ViewModels
{
    public class CraneSetupViewModel : ViewModelBase
    {
        // ── Dependencies (injected via constructor) ───────────────────────
        private readonly IRenderingService _render;
        private readonly ISceneService _scene;

        // ── Dragging state ────────────────────────────────────────────────
        // This stores the visual that is currently in the viewport.
        // We keep a reference so we can move it (change its Transform) on drag.
        private ModelVisual3D? _craneVisual;

        // Whether the user is currently dragging the crane
        private bool _isDragging;

        // The last known valid position (so we can revert if zone check fails)
        private DomainPoint3D _lastValidPosition = new(0, 0, 0);

        // ── Bound Properties ──────────────────────────────────────────────
        private Crane? _selectedCrane;
        public Crane? SelectedCrane
        {
            get => _selectedCrane;
            set
            {
                _selectedCrane = value;
                OnPropertyChanged();
                // When crane changes, re-render it
                OnCraneChanged(value);
            }
        }

        private DomainPoint3D? _currentPosition;
        public DomainPoint3D? CurrentPosition
        {
            get => _currentPosition;
            set { _currentPosition = value; OnPropertyChanged(); }
        }

        private bool _isDraggingActive;
        public bool IsDraggingActive
        {
            get => _isDraggingActive;
            set { _isDraggingActive = value; OnPropertyChanged(); }
        }

        // ── Constructor ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
        public CraneSetupViewModel(IRenderingService render, ISceneService scene)
        {
            _render = render;
            _scene = scene;

            // Listen to scene changes: when a new crane is set via ISceneService,
            // update our local SelectedCrane automatically.

        }
        // In CraneSetupViewModel.UpdateDrag(), add colour feedback:

        public void UpdateDrag(DomainPoint3D worldPoint, List<GreenAreaZone> zones)
        {
            if (!_isDragging) return;

            bool hasZones = zones != null && zones.Count > 0;
            bool isInside = !hasZones || GreenZoneConstraint.IsInsideAnyZone(worldPoint, zones);

            // Visual feedback: update status for the View to display
            IsPositionValid = isInside;

            var constrained = GreenZoneConstraint.Clamp(worldPoint, zones!);
            MoveCraneVisualTo(constrained);
            CurrentPosition = constrained;
        }

        // Add this property to CraneSetupViewModel:
        private bool _isPositionValid = true;
        public bool IsPositionValid
        {
            get => _isPositionValid;
            set { _isPositionValid = value; OnPropertyChanged(); }
        }

        // ── Called when the selected crane changes ────────────────────────
        private void OnCraneChanged(Crane? crane)
        {
            // Remove any existing crane visual from the viewport
            _render.ClearLayer("Crane");
            _render.ClearLayer("CraneRadius");
            _craneVisual = null;

            if (crane == null) return;

            // Build and render the crane model
            // We pass [crane] as a single-item list to Render()
            _render.Render(new[] { crane }, new CraneVisualBuilder(visual => RegisterCraneVisual(visual)),  // pass the callback
            "Crane");

            // Also render the max-radius circle
            var spec = crane.Specifications.FirstOrDefault();
            if (spec != null)
            {
                _render.Render(
                    new[] { crane },
                    new CraneRadiusBuilder(),
                    "CraneRadius"
                );
            }

            // Store the default position
            _lastValidPosition = new DomainPoint3D(0, 0, 0);
            CurrentPosition = _lastValidPosition;
        }

        // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
        // DRAG API — called by the View's mouse event handlers
        // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

        /// <summary>
        /// Call this from MouseDown when the user clicks on the crane.
        /// </summary>
        public void BeginDrag()
        {
            if (_selectedCrane == null) return;
            _isDragging = true;
            IsDraggingActive = true;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Call this from MouseMove. worldPoint is the 3D position on
        /// the ground plane where the mouse is currently pointing.
        /// </summary>


        /// <summary>
        /// Call this from MouseUp. Finalises the position.
        /// </summary>
        public void EndDrag(List<GreenAreaZone> zones)
        {
            if (!_isDragging) return;

            _isDragging = false;
            IsDraggingActive = false;

            if (CurrentPosition != null)
            {
                // Final validation
                var final = GreenZoneConstraint.Clamp(CurrentPosition, zones);
                MoveCraneVisualTo(final);
                _lastValidPosition = final;
                CurrentPosition = final;
            }
        }

        // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
        // PRIVATE HELPERS
        // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

        /// <summary>
        /// Moves the crane's 3D visual to a new X,Y position on the ground plane.
        /// This does NOT rebuild the mesh — it only changes the Transform.
        /// This is what makes dragging feel smooth and fast.
        /// </summary>
        private void MoveCraneVisualTo(DomainPoint3D pos)
        {
            if (_craneVisual == null) return;

            // TranslateTransform3D offsets the entire visual in 3D space
            _craneVisual.Transform = new TranslateTransform3D(pos.X, pos.Y, pos.Z);
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Called by CraneVisualBuilder after it creates the visual,
        /// so we can store a reference for drag operations.
        /// </summary>
        public void RegisterCraneVisual(ModelVisual3D visual)
        {
            _craneVisual = visual;
        }

    }

{
    public partial class LoadChartImportDialog : Window
    {
        private string? _loadedFilePath;

        public LoadChartImportDialog()
        {
            InitializeComponent();
        }

        private void Method_Checked(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            if (DropTitle == null) return;
            bool isCsv = RboCsv.IsChecked == true;
            DropTitle.Text     = isCsv ? "Drop CSV here" : "Drop PDF here";
            DropIcon.Text      = isCsv ? "📄" : "📑";
            PdfPagePanel.Visibility = isCsv ? Visibility.Collapsed : Visibility.Visible;
        }

        private void DropZone_Click(object sender, System.Windows.Input.MouseButtonEventArgs e)
        {
            var dlg = new OpenFileDialog
            {
                Filter = RboCsv.IsChecked == true
                    ? "CSV files (*.csv)|*.csv"
                    : "PDF files (*.pdf)|*.pdf"
            };
            if (dlg.ShowDialog() == true)
                LoadFile(dlg.FileName);
        }

        private void DropZone_DragOver(object sender, DragEventArgs e)
            => e.Effects = e.Data.GetDataPresent(DataFormats.FileDrop)
                ? DragDropEffects.Copy : DragDropEffects.None;

        private void DropZone_DragEnter(object sender, DragEventArgs e)
            => DropZone.Opacity = 0.7;

        private void DropZone_DragLeave(object sender, DragEventArgs e)
            => DropZone.Opacity = 1.0;

        private void DropZone_Drop(object sender, DragEventArgs e)
        {
            DropZone.Opacity = 1.0;
            if (e.Data.GetData(DataFormats.FileDrop) is string[] files && files.Length > 0)
                LoadFile(files[0]);
        }

        private void LoadFile(string path)
        {
            _loadedFilePath    = path;
            TxtFileName.Text   = Path.GetFileName(path);
            var info = new FileInfo(path);
            TxtFileSize.Text   = $"{info.Length / 1024.0:F1} KB";
            FileInfoPanel.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
            AxisPanel.Visibility     = Visibility.Visible;
            TxtStatus.Text     = $"File loaded: {Path.GetFileName(path)}";
            TxtGridStats.Text  = "Ready to parse";
            // TODO: parse CSV/PDF into ChartGrid
        }

        private void AxisOrientation_Changed(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            // TODO: re-transpose grid data when axis flips
        }

        private void ReExtract_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            // TODO: re-parse PDF at specified page number
        }

        private void BtnSave_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(TxtModel.Text))
            {
                TxtStatus.Text = "Please enter a model name before saving.";
                return;
            }
            // TODO: persist chart to database
            DialogResult = true;
            Close();
        }

        private void BtnCancel_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            DialogResult = false;
            Close();
        }
    }

﻿using CraneOptimizer.Domain.Common;
using CraneOptimizer.UI.Core.Interfaces;
using HelixToolkit.Wpf;
using System.Windows.Media;
using System.Windows.Media.Media3D;

namespace CraneOptimizer.UI.Features.F7_Zones
{
    public class PreviewLinesBuilder : IVisualBuilder<List<DomainPoint3D>>
    {
        public Visual3D Build(List<DomainPoint3D> points)
        {
            var lines = new LinesVisual3D
            {
                Color = Colors.Yellow,
                Thickness = 2
            };

            for (int i = 0; i < points.Count - 1; i++)
            {
                var p1 = points[i];
                var p2 = points[i + 1];

                lines.Points.Add(new Point3D(p1.X, p1.Y, p1.Z));
                lines.Points.Add(new Point3D(p2.X, p2.Y, p2.Z));
            }

            if (points.Count >= 3)
            {
                var first = points[0];
                var last = points[^1];

                lines.Points.Add(new Point3D(last.X, last.Y, last.Z));
                lines.Points.Add(new Point3D(first.X, first.Y, first.Z));
            }

            return lines;
        }
    }
}
﻿using CraneOptimizer.Domain.Schemas;
using CraneOptimizer.Domain.Schemas.Enums;
using CraneOptimizer.UI.Core.Interfaces;
using HelixToolkit.Wpf;
using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Media;
using System.Windows.Media.Media3D;

namespace CraneOptimizer.UI.Features.F7_Zones
{
    public class ZoneVisualBuilder : IVisualBuilder<GreenAreaZone>
    {
        private readonly ISceneService _scene;

        public ZoneVisualBuilder(ISceneService scene)
        {
            _scene = scene;
        }

        public Visual3D Build(GreenAreaZone zone)
        {
            var meshBuilder = new HelixToolkit.Geometry.MeshBuilder(false, false);

            var points = zone.Vertices
                .Select(v => new Point3D(v.X, v.Y, v.Z))
                .ToList();

            if (points.Count < 3)
                return new ModelVisual3D();

            bool isSelected = _scene.SelectedZone == zone;

            var baseColor = zone.Type == ZoneType.Forbidden
                ? Colors.Red
                : Colors.Green;

            var finalColor = isSelected ? Colors.Yellow : baseColor;

            var border = new LinesVisual3D
            {
                Color = finalColor,
                Thickness = isSelected ? 5 : 3
            };

            for (int i = 0; i < points.Count; i++)
            {
                border.Points.Add(points[i]);
                border.Points.Add(points[(i + 1) % points.Count]);
            }

            var vectors = zone.Vertices
                .Select(v => new System.Numerics.Vector3((float)v.X, (float)v.Y, (float)v.Z))
                .ToList();

            meshBuilder.AddPolygon(vectors);

            var helixMesh = meshBuilder.ToMesh();

            var wpfMesh = new MeshGeometry3D
            {
                Positions = new Point3DCollection(
                    helixMesh.Positions.Select(p => new Point3D(p.X, p.Y, p.Z))),
                TriangleIndices = new Int32Collection(helixMesh.TriangleIndices)
            };

            var material = new DiffuseMaterial(
                new SolidColorBrush(finalColor)
                {
                    Opacity = isSelected ? 0.85 : 0.5
                });

            var model = new GeometryModel3D
            {
                Geometry = wpfMesh,
                Material = material,
                BackMaterial = material
            };

            var container = new ModelVisual3D { Content = model };

            container.SetValue(FrameworkElement.TagProperty, zone);

            container.Children.Add(border);

            return container;
        }
    }
}﻿using CraneOptimizer.Domain.Common;

namespace CraneOptimizer.UI.Features.F7_Zones.ViewModels
{
    public class DrawingViewModel : ViewModelBase
    {
        private readonly DrawingService _drawing;
        private readonly ISceneService _scene;
        private readonly IRenderingService _render;
        private DomainPoint3D? _currentHover;

        public DrawingViewModel(
            DrawingService drawing,
            ISceneService scene,
            IRenderingService render)
        {
            _drawing = drawing;
            _scene = scene;
            _render = render;

            StartAllowedCommand = new RelayCommand(StartAllowed);
            StartForbiddenCommand = new RelayCommand(StartForbidden);

            FinishCommand = new RelayCommand(Finish, () => IsDrawing);
            CancelCommand = new RelayCommand(Cancel, () => IsDrawing);
            UndoCommand = new RelayCommand(Undo, () => IsDrawing);
        }

        // ─────────────────────────────
        // State
        // ─────────────────────────────
        private bool _isDrawing;
        public bool IsDrawing
        {
            get => _isDrawing;
            private set
            {
                _isDrawing = value;
                OnPropertyChanged();
                CommandManager.InvalidateRequerySuggested();
            }
        }

        private ZoneType _currentType = ZoneType.Allowed;

        // ─────────────────────────────
        // Commands
        // ─────────────────────────────
        public ICommand StartAllowedCommand { get; }
        public ICommand StartForbiddenCommand { get; }
        public ICommand FinishCommand { get; }
        public ICommand CancelCommand { get; }
        public ICommand UndoCommand { get; }

        // ─────────────────────────────
        // Start
        // ─────────────────────────────
        public void Start()
        {
            _drawing.Start();
            _currentHover = null;
            _render.ClearLayer("Preview");
            IsDrawing = true;
        }

        private void StartAllowed()
        {
            _currentType = ZoneType.Allowed;
            Start();
        }

        private void StartForbidden()
        {
            _currentType = ZoneType.Forbidden;
            Start();
        }

        // ─────────────────────────────
        // Add Point
        // ─────────────────────────────
        public void AddPoint(DomainPoint3D point)
        {
            if (!IsDrawing) return;

            if (!_drawing.TryAddPoint(point))
                return;

            _currentHover = null;
            RenderPreview();
        }

        public void SetHoverPoint(DomainPoint3D point)
        {
            if (!IsDrawing) return;

            _currentHover = point;
            RenderPreview();
        }

        // ─────────────────────────────
        // Finish
        // ─────────────────────────────
        public void Finish()
        {
            if (!IsDrawing) return;

            var pts = _drawing.GetPoints();

            if (pts.Count >= 3)
            {
                var first = pts[0];
                var last = pts[^1];

                if (!ArePointsEqual(first, last))
                {
                    pts.Add(new DomainPoint3D(first.X, first.Y, first.Z));
                }
            }

            var zone = _drawing.BuildZone();

            if (zone != null)
            {
                zone.Type = _currentType;
                _scene.AddZone(zone);
            }

            _render.ClearLayer("Preview");
            _currentHover = null;
            _drawing.Start();
            IsDrawing = false;
        }

        // ─────────────────────────────
        // Cancel
        // ─────────────────────────────
        private void Cancel()
        {
            _currentHover = null;
            _drawing.Start();
            _render.ClearLayer("Preview");
            IsDrawing = false;
        }

        // ─────────────────────────────
        // Undo
        // ─────────────────────────────
        private void Undo()
        {
            var pts = _drawing.GetPoints();
            if (pts.Count == 0) return;

            pts.RemoveAt(pts.Count - 1);
            RenderPreview();
        }

        private List<DomainPoint3D> GetPreviewPoints()
        {
            var previewPoints = new List<DomainPoint3D>(_drawing.GetPoints());

            if (_currentHover != null)
                previewPoints.Add(_currentHover);

            return previewPoints;
        }

        private void RenderPreview()
        {
            var previewPoints = GetPreviewPoints();

            if (previewPoints.Count < 2)
            {
                _render.ClearLayer("Preview");
                return;
            }
            var elements = _scene.GetElements();

            double minX = elements.Min(e => e.ElementCOG.X);
            double maxX = elements.Max(e => e.ElementCOG.X);

            double sceneSize = maxX - minX;

            // radius = 2% من حجم المشروع
            double adaptiveRadius = sceneSize * 0.02;
            _render.Render(
                new[] { previewPoints },
                new PreviewLinesBuilder(),
                "Preview"
            );
        }

        private bool ArePointsEqual(DomainPoint3D a, DomainPoint3D b)
        {
            return System.Math.Abs(a.X - b.X) < 0.001 &&
                   System.Math.Abs(a.Y - b.Y) < 0.001 &&
                   System.Math.Abs(a.Z - b.Z) < 0.001;
        }
    }
}

            => ZoneNamePlaceholder.Visibility = string.IsNullOrEmpty(TxtZoneName.Text)
                ? Visibility.Visible
                : Visibility.Collapsed;

        {
            ErrorLabel.Text = string.Empty;

            if (!double.TryParse(TxtMinHeight.Text, out double min) ||
                !double.TryParse(TxtMaxHeight.Text, out double max) ||
                min >= max)
            {
                ErrorLabel.Text = "Invalid height range. Min must be less than Max.";
                return;
            }

            ZoneName = TxtZoneName.Text.Trim();
            MinHeight = min;
            MaxHeight = max;
            ZoneType = RadioAllowed.IsChecked == true ? "Allowed" : "Forbidden";

            DialogResult = true;
            Close();
        }

        {
            DialogResult = false;
            Close();

﻿using CraneOptimizer.Domain.Common;
using CraneOptimizer.UI.Features.F7_Zones.ViewModels;
using HelixToolkit.Wpf;

namespace CraneOptimizer.UI.Features.F7_Zones.Views
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Interaction logic for ZonesTabView.xaml
    /// </summary>
    public partial class ZonesTabView : UserControl
    {
        public ZonesTabView()
        {
            InitializeComponent();
            DataContext = App.ServiceProvider.GetRequiredService<DrawingViewModel>();
        }
        private Point3D GetWorldPoint(HelixViewport3D viewport, System.Windows.Point screenPt)
        {
            try
            {
                var hit = viewport.FindNearestPoint(screenPt);
                if (hit.HasValue)
                    return hit.Value;
            }
            catch { }

            try
            {
                bool ok = Viewport3DHelper.Point2DtoPoint3D(
                    viewport.Viewport,
                    screenPt,
                    out Point3D near,
                    out Point3D far);

                if (ok)
                {
                    var dir = far - near;

                    if (System.Math.Abs(dir.Z) > 1e-9)
                    {
                        double t = -near.Z / dir.Z;
                        if (t > 0)
                            return near + t * dir;
                    }
                }
            }
            catch { }

            return new Point3D();
        }

        private void Viewport_MouseDown(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
        {
            var viewport = sender as HelixViewport3D;
            if (viewport == null) return;

            var screen = e.GetPosition(viewport);
            var world = GetWorldPoint(viewport, screen);

            var point = new DomainPoint3D(world.X, world.Y, world.Z);

            if (DataContext is DrawingViewModel vm)
            {
                if (!vm.IsDrawing) return;

                vm.AddPoint(point);
            }
        }
    }

using CraneOptimizer.UI.Core.Interfaces;
using HelixToolkit.Geometry;
using System.Numerics;
using System.Windows.Media;
using System.Windows.Media.Media3D;

namespace CraneOptimizer.UI.Features.F8_GAOptimizer
{
    public class BestPointVisualBuilder : IVisualBuilder<(double x, double y, double z)>
    {
        private readonly double _markerRadiusInMillimeters;

        public BestPointVisualBuilder(double markerRadiusInMillimeters)
        {
            _markerRadiusInMillimeters = Math.Max(1.0, markerRadiusInMillimeters);
        }

        public Visual3D Build((double x, double y, double z) item)
        {
            // FIX: use raw mm coordinates (same as IFC rendering)
            var center = new Point3D(item.x, item.y, 0);

            // FIX: keep radius in mm (NO scaling)
            var renderRadius = _markerRadiusInMillimeters;

            var meshBuilder = new MeshBuilder(true, true);
            meshBuilder.AddSphere(
                new Vector3((float)center.X, (float)center.Y, (float)center.Z),
                (float)renderRadius,
                18,
                12);

            var helixMesh = meshBuilder.ToMesh();
            var mesh = new System.Windows.Media.Media3D.MeshGeometry3D
            {
                Positions = new Point3DCollection(
                    helixMesh.Positions.Select(position => new Point3D(position.X, position.Y, position.Z))),
                TriangleIndices = new Int32Collection(helixMesh.TriangleIndices)
            };

            if (helixMesh.Normals != null)
            {
                mesh.Normals = new Vector3DCollection(
                    helixMesh.Normals.Select(normal => new Vector3D(normal.X, normal.Y, normal.Z)));
            }

            var geometryModel = new GeometryModel3D
            {
                Geometry = mesh,
                Material = new DiffuseMaterial(new SolidColorBrush(Colors.Blue)),
                BackMaterial = new DiffuseMaterial(new SolidColorBrush(Colors.Blue))
            };

            return new ModelVisual3D
            {
                Content = geometryModel
            };
        }
    }
}

namespace CraneOptimizer.UI.Features.F8_GAOptimizer
{
    public static class CoordinateMapper
    {
        public const double RenderScale = 0.001;

        public static Point3D ToRenderPoint(double x, double y, double z = 0)
        {
            return new Point3D(
                x * RenderScale,
                y * RenderScale,
                z * RenderScale);
        }

        public static double ToRenderLength(double length)
        {
            return length * RenderScale;
        }

        public static double ToModelMillimeters(double renderLength)
        {
            return renderLength / RenderScale;
        }
    }
