namespace CraneOptimizer.Application.Features.CranePlacement.DTOs
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Final result returned from the Crane Placement optimization.
    /// Contains best positions, fitness, coverage, and statistics.
    /// </summary>
    public class CranePlacementResult
    {
        /// <summary>
        /// Best crane positions found by the optimization.
        /// </summary>
        public List<CranePositionResult> Positions { get; set; } = new();

        /// <summary>
        /// Final fitness score of the solution.
        /// </summary>
        public double FitnessScore { get; set; }

        /// <summary>
        /// Percentage of elements that can be successfully lifted.
        /// </summary>
        public double CoverageRatio { get; set; }

        /// <summary>
        /// Aggregated statistics of lift results.
        /// </summary>
        public LiftStatistics Statistics { get; set; } = new();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Represents a single crane position in the solution.
    /// </summary>
    public class CranePositionResult
    {
        /// <summary>
        /// X coordinate of crane position.
        /// </summary>
        public double X { get; set; }

        /// <summary>
        /// Y coordinate of crane position.
        /// </summary>
        public double Y { get; set; }

        /// <summary>
        /// Evaluation results of all elements for this position.
        /// </summary>
        public List<ElementLiftResult> ElementResults { get; set; } = new();
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Represents lift evaluation result for a single element.
    /// </summary>
    public class ElementLiftResult
    {
        /// <summary>
        /// Element unique identifier.
        /// </summary>
        public string ElementId { get; set; }

        /// <summary>
        /// Lift feasibility status.
        /// </summary>
        public LiftStatus Status { get; set; }

        /// <summary>
        /// Working radius between crane and element.
        /// </summary>
        public double Radius { get; set; }

        /// <summary>
        /// Required lifting capacity for the element.
        /// </summary>
        public double RequiredCapacity { get; set; }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Aggregated lift statistics across all elements.
    /// </summary>
    public class LiftStatistics
    {
        public int Liftable { get; set; }

        public int OutOfRadius { get; set; }

        public int Overweight { get; set; }

        public int HeightFail { get; set; }

        public int SpecialCase { get; set; }
    }
}using CraneOptimizer.Application.Features.CranePlacement.DTOs;

        public async Task<CranePlacementResult> RunOptimizationAsync(GASettings settings, Crane crane)
        {
            var input = await _inputBuilder.BuildAsync(settings, crane);

            var allElements = input.Elements;
            var remainingElements = new List<PrecastElement>(allElements);

            var coveredElements = new HashSet<string>();

            var finalResult = new CranePlacementResult();

            double previousCoverage = 0;

            int maxPoints = 4;
            double targetCoverage = 0.95;
            double minImprovement = 0.05;

            int iteration = 0;

            while (remainingElements.Count > 0 && iteration < maxPoints)
            {
                iteration++;

                // Run GA on remaining elements only
                input.Elements = remainingElements;

                var solution = await Task.Run(() => _gaEngine.Run(input));

                var assignment = _assignmentService.EvaluateAssignment(
                    solution,
                    remainingElements,
                    input.Assignment,
                    input.CraneSpec,
                    input.Settings);

                var iterationResult = MapResult(solution, assignment);

                if (iterationResult.Positions.Count == 0)
                    break;

                var bestPoint = iterationResult.Positions[0];

                // Get NEW elements only (no duplication)
                var newElements = bestPoint.ElementResults
                    .Where(e => e.Status == LiftStatus.Liftable && !coveredElements.Contains(e.ElementId))
                    .ToList();

                // Stop if no new contribution
                if (newElements.Count == 0)
                    break;

                // Add to covered set
                foreach (var e in newElements)
                    coveredElements.Add(e.ElementId);

                // Add filtered result (only new elements)
                finalResult.Positions.Add(new CranePositionResult
                {
                    X = bestPoint.X,
                    Y = bestPoint.Y,
                    ElementResults = newElements
                });

                // Calculate coverage
                double currentCoverage = (double)coveredElements.Count / allElements.Count;

                double improvement = currentCoverage - previousCoverage;

                // Stop conditions
                if (currentCoverage >= targetCoverage)
                    break;

                if (improvement < minImprovement)
                    break;

                previousCoverage = currentCoverage;

                // Update remaining elements
                remainingElements = allElements
                    .Where(e => !coveredElements.Contains(e.ElementID))
                    .ToList();
            }

            // Final stats
            finalResult.CoverageRatio = (double)coveredElements.Count / allElements.Count;
            finalResult.FitnessScore = finalResult.CoverageRatio;

            return finalResult;
        }

        private CranePlacementResult MapResult(
            CraneSolution solution,
            AssignmentResult assignment)
        {
            var result = new CranePlacementResult
            {
                FitnessScore = solution.Fitness
            };

            var positions = solution.Chromosome.CranePositions;
            result.Positions = new List<CranePositionResult>(positions.Count);

            for (int i = 0; i < positions.Count; i++)
            {
                var scenePoint = _coordinateService.DenormalizePoint(positions[i]);
                result.Positions.Add(new CranePositionResult
                {
                    X = scenePoint.X,
                    Y = scenePoint.Y
                });
            }

            var statistics = new LiftStatistics();
            var evaluationResults = assignment.EvaluationResults;

            for (int i = 0; i < evaluationResults.Count; i++)
            {
                var evaluation = evaluationResults[i];
                UpdateStatistics(statistics, evaluation.Status);

                if (evaluation.AssignedCraneIndex < 0 || evaluation.AssignedCraneIndex >= result.Positions.Count)
                    continue;

                result.Positions[evaluation.AssignedCraneIndex].ElementResults.Add(new ElementLiftResult
                {
                    ElementId = evaluation.ElementId,
                    Status = evaluation.Status,
                    Radius = evaluation.Radius,
                    RequiredCapacity = evaluation.RequiredCapacity
                });
            }

            result.Statistics = statistics;

            int totalElements = evaluationResults.Count;
            result.CoverageRatio = totalElements == 0
                ? 0
                : (double)statistics.Liftable / totalElements;

            return result;
        }

        private static void UpdateStatistics(LiftStatistics statistics, LiftStatus status)
        {
            switch (status)
            {
                case LiftStatus.Liftable:
                    statistics.Liftable++;
                    break;
                case LiftStatus.OutOfRadius:
                    statistics.OutOfRadius++;
                    break;
                case LiftStatus.Overweight:
                    statistics.Overweight++;
                    break;
                case LiftStatus.HeightFail:
                    statistics.HeightFail++;
                    break;
                case LiftStatus.SpecialCase:
                    statistics.SpecialCase++;
                    break;
            }
        }
    }
}

namespace CraneOptimizer.UI.Features.F8_GAOptimizer.Services
{
    public class GAInputBuilder
    {
        private readonly ISceneService _sceneService;
        private readonly CoordinateService _coordinateService;

        public GAInputBuilder(
            ISceneService sceneService,
            ICraneRepository craneRepository,
            CoordinateService coordinateService)
        {
            _sceneService = sceneService;
            _coordinateService = coordinateService;
        }

        public async Task<PlacementInput> BuildAsync(GASettings settings, Crane selectedCrane)
        {
            if (settings == null)
                throw new ArgumentNullException(nameof(settings));

            if (selectedCrane == null)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("No crane selected.");

            var sceneElements = _sceneService.GetElements();
            if (sceneElements == null || sceneElements.Count == 0)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("No elements found in the scene.");

            var elements = new List<PrecastElement>(sceneElements.Count);
            for (int i = 0; i < sceneElements.Count; i++)
            {
                var element = sceneElements[i];

                if (!_coordinateService.IsValidPoint(element.ElementCOG))
                    throw new InvalidOperationException($"Invalid coordinates found for element '{element.ElementID}'.");

                elements.Add(_coordinateService.NormalizeElementToMeters(element));
            }

            var sceneZones = _sceneService.GetZones();
            var zones = new List<GreenAreaZone>(sceneZones.Count);

            for (int i = 0; i < sceneZones.Count; i++)
            {
                var zone = sceneZones[i];
                if (zone.Type != ZoneType.Allowed)
                    continue;

                ValidateZone(zone);
                zones.Add(_coordinateService.NormalizeZoneToMeters(zone));
            }

            if (zones.Count == 0)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("No allowed zones found in the scene.");

            //  FIX: use selected crane from UI
            var craneSpec = SelectCraneSpecification(selectedCrane);

            if (craneSpec == null)
                throw new InvalidOperationException($"Crane '{selectedCrane.Name}' does not contain a valid specification.");

            if (craneSpec.LoadChart == null || craneSpec.LoadChart.Count == 0)
                throw new InvalidOperationException($"Crane '{selectedCrane.Name}' does not contain a load chart.");

            if (craneSpec.MaxRadius <= 0 || craneSpec.MaxBoomLength <= 0)
                throw new InvalidOperationException($"Crane '{selectedCrane.Name}' contains invalid specification limits.");

            if (settings.MaxRadiusForNormalisation <= 0)
                settings.MaxRadiusForNormalisation = craneSpec.MaxRadius;

            return new PlacementInput
            {
                Zones = zones,
                Elements = elements,
                Assignment = new Dictionary<int, List<string>>(),
                CraneSpec = craneSpec,
                Settings = settings
            };
        }

        private CraneSpecification? SelectCraneSpecification(Crane crane)
        {
            CraneSpecification? firstSpec = null;

            foreach (var specification in crane.Specifications)
            {
                if (specification == null)
                    continue;

                firstSpec ??= specification;

                if (specification.LoadChart != null && specification.LoadChart.Count > 0)
                    return specification;
            }

            return firstSpec;
        }

        private void ValidateZone(GreenAreaZone zone)
        {
            if (zone.Vertices == null || zone.Vertices.Count < 3)
                throw new InvalidOperationException($"Allowed zone '{zone.Name}' is invalid.");

            for (int i = 0; i < zone.Vertices.Count; i++)
            {
                if (!_coordinateService.IsValidPoint(zone.Vertices[i]))
                    throw new InvalidOperationException($"Allowed zone '{zone.Name}' contains invalid coordinates.");
            }
        }
    }
}

using System.Windows.Input;
using CraneOptimizer.UI.Core.Commands;
using CraneOptimizer.UI.Features.F8_GAOptimizer;

namespace CraneOptimizer.UI.Features.F6_CranePlacement.ViewModels
{
    public class CranePlacementViewModel : ViewModelBase 
    {

        private readonly IRenderingService _render;

        private bool _isPlacing;
        private DomainPoint3D? _currentPosition;
        private Crane? _selectedCrane;

        public bool IsPlacing
        {
            get => _isPlacing;
            set
            {
                _isPlacing = value;
                OnPropertyChanged();
            }
        }

        public DomainPoint3D? CurrentPosition
        {
            get => _currentPosition;
            set
            {
                _currentPosition = value;
                OnPropertyChanged();
            }
        }

        public Crane? SelectedCrane
        {
            get => _selectedCrane;
            set
            {
                _selectedCrane = value;
                OnPropertyChanged();
            }
        }

        public ICommand StartPlacementCommand { get; }


        public CranePlacementViewModel(IRenderingService render)
        {
            _render = render;

            StartPlacementCommand = new RelayCommand(StartPlacement);
        }

        private void StartPlacement()
        {
            IsPlacing = true;
        }

        public void Place(DomainPoint3D point)
        {
            if (!IsPlacing || SelectedCrane == null)
                return;

            CurrentPosition = point;

            _render.Render(
                new[] { (point.X, point.Y, point.Z + 500.0) },
                new BestPointVisualBuilder(200.0),
                "CranePosition"
            );

            IsPlacing = false;
        }
    }
}

using CraneOptimizer.Application.Features.CranePlacement.DTOs;
using CraneOptimizer.Application.Optimization.GeneticAlgorithms.Models;
using CraneOptimizer.Application.Optimization.GeneticAlgorithms.Settings;
using CraneOptimizer.Domain.Entities;
using CraneOptimizer.Domain.Interfaces;

namespace CraneOptimizer.UI.Features.F8_GAOptimizer.Views
{
    public partial class CraneOptimizerDialog : Window
    {
        const string POINT_LAYER = "GA_SelectedPoint";
        private class PointItem
        {
            public CranePositionResult Point { get; set; }

            public string DisplayText =>
                $"Point ({Point.X:F0}, {Point.Y:F0}) - {Point.ElementResults.Count} elements";
        }

        private readonly ICranePlacementService _placementService;
        private readonly IRenderingService _renderingService;
        private readonly IDialogService _dialogService;
        private readonly ICraneRepository _craneRepository;
        private readonly ISceneService _sceneService;

        private CranePlacementResult? _currentResult;
        private bool _isRunning;

        public CranePlacementResult? LatestResult { get; private set; }

        public CraneOptimizerDialog(
            ICranePlacementService placementService,
            IRenderingService renderingService,
            IDialogService dialogService,
            ICraneRepository craneRepository,
            ISceneService sceneService)
        {
            InitializeComponent();

            _placementService = placementService;
            _renderingService = renderingService;
            _dialogService = dialogService;
            _craneRepository = craneRepository;
            _sceneService = sceneService;

            Loaded += OnLoaded;
        }

        private async void OnLoaded(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            await LoadCranesAsync();
        }

        private async Task LoadCranesAsync()
        {
            var cranes = await _craneRepository.GetAllWithSpecsAsync();
            CboCrane.ItemsSource = cranes;
        }

        // ============================
        // RUN GA (FULLY FIXED)
        // ============================
        private async void BtnRun_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            if (_isRunning) return;

            var selectedCrane = CboCrane.SelectedItem as Crane;

            if (selectedCrane == null)
            {
                _dialogService.ShowMessage("Please select a crane.");
                return;
            }

            _isRunning = true;

            ClearResultPanel();
            _renderingService.ClearLayer("GA_SelectedPoint");

            BtnRun.IsEnabled = false;
            BtnApply.IsEnabled = false;

            ProgBar.IsIndeterminate = true;
            TxtStatus.Text = "Running optimizer...";

            try
            {
                var settings = BuildSettings();

                //  FIX: pass crane to service
                var result = await _placementService.RunOptimizationAsync(settings, selectedCrane);

                LatestResult = result;
                _currentResult = result;

                // Bind points
                PointsList.ItemsSource = result.Positions
                    .Select(p => new PointItem { Point = p })
                    .ToList();

                if (PointsList.Items.Count > 0)
                    PointsList.SelectedIndex = 0;

                UpdateResultPanel(result);

                TxtStatus.Text = "Optimization completed.";
                ProgBar.IsIndeterminate = false;
                ProgBar.Value = 100;

                BtnApply.IsEnabled = true;
            }
            catch (Exception ex)
            {
                TxtStatus.Text = "Optimization failed.";
                ProgBar.IsIndeterminate = false;
                ProgBar.Value = 0;

                _dialogService.ShowMessage(ex.Message);
            }
            finally
            {
                _isRunning = false;
                BtnRun.IsEnabled = true;
            }
        }

        // ============================
        // POINT SELECTION (FULLY LINKED)
        // ============================
        private void PointsList_SelectionChanged(object sender, SelectionChangedEventArgs e)
        {
            if (PointsList.SelectedItem is not PointItem item)
                return;

            ShowPoint(item.Point);
            UpdateResultPanelForPoint(item.Point); //  FIX: UI sync
        }

        private void ShowPoint(CranePositionResult point)
        {
            if (point == null)
                return;

            _renderingService.ClearLayer(POINT_LAYER);

            var markerRadius = CalculateMarkerRadius();
            var markerZ = CalculateMarkerZ(markerRadius);

            _renderingService.Render(
                new[] { (point.X, point.Y, markerZ) },
                new BestPointVisualBuilder(markerRadius),
                POINT_LAYER
            );

            var elements = _sceneService.GetElements();
            if (elements == null) return;

            var statusMap = point.ElementResults
                .ToDictionary(e => e.ElementId, e => e.Status);

            var elementsWithStatus = elements.Select(e =>
            {
                if (statusMap.TryGetValue(e.ElementID, out var status))
                {
                    return (e, (LiftStatus?)status);
                }
                else
                {
                    return (e, null);
                }
            });

            _renderingService.Render(
                elementsWithStatus,
                new ElementVisualBuilder(),
                "Elements"
            );
        }

        // ============================
        // SETTINGS (FIXED)
        // ============================
        private GASettings BuildSettings()
        {
            if (CboCrane.SelectedItem == null)
                throw new InvalidOperationException("Please select a crane.");

            return new GASettings
            {
                PopulationSize = int.TryParse(TxtPopulation.Text, out var p) ? p : 30,
                MaxGenerations = int.TryParse(TxtGenerations.Text, out var g) ? g : 30,
                MutationRate = double.TryParse(TxtMutRate.Text, out var m) ? m : 0.1,
                RandomSeed = 42
            };
        }

        // ============================
        // RESULT PANEL (FULLY FIXED)
        // ============================
        private void UpdateResultPanel(CranePlacementResult result)
        {
            PanelResults.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;

            TxtScore.Text = $"Fitness: {result.FitnessScore:F2}";
            TxtCoverage.Text = $"Total Coverage: {result.CoverageRatio:P0}";

            if (result.Positions.Any())
                UpdateResultPanelForPoint(result.Positions[0]);
        }

        private void UpdateResultPanelForPoint(CranePositionResult point)
        {
            TxtPosition.Text = $"({point.X:F0}, {point.Y:F0})";

            int liftable = point.ElementResults.Count(e => e.Status == LiftStatus.Liftable);
            int nonLiftable = point.ElementResults.Count(e => e.Status == LiftStatus.Overweight);
            int unreachable = point.ElementResults.Count(e => e.Status == LiftStatus.OutOfRadius);

            TxtCountL.Text = liftable.ToString();
            TxtCountNL.Text = nonLiftable.ToString();
            TxtCountUR.Text = unreachable.ToString();

            int total = point.ElementResults.Count;
            double coverage = total == 0 ? 0 : (double)liftable / total;

            TxtCoverage.Text = $"Point Coverage: {coverage:P0}";
        }

        private void ClearResultPanel()
        {
            PanelResults.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;
            PointsList.ItemsSource = null;
        }

        // ============================
        // HELPERS
        // ============================
        private double CalculateMarkerRadius() => 200;
        private double CalculateMarkerZ(double r) => 500;

        private void CboCrane_SelectionChanged(object sender, SelectionChangedEventArgs e) { }
        private void RbExclusion_Checked(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e) { }
        private void BtnCancelRun_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e) { }
        private void BtnApply_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e) { }
        private void BtnIncludeAll_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e) { }
        private void BtnExcludeAll_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e) { }
        private void BtnNoSlabs_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e) { }
        private void BtnNoStairs_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e) { }
        private void BtnNoRoofs_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e) { }
    }

namespace CraneOptimizer.UI.Features.F9_Settings.Views
{
    public partial class UnitsSettingsDialog : Window
    {
        public UnitsSettingsDialog()
        {
            InitializeComponent();
            LoadOptions();
        }

        private void LoadOptions()
        {
            CboLength.ItemsSource    = new[] { "Metres (m)", "Feet (ft)", "Millimetres (mm)" };
            CboArea.ItemsSource      = new[] { "m²", "ft²" };
            CboPrecision.ItemsSource = new[] { "0", "1", "2", "3" };
            CboFormat.ItemsSource    = new[] { "1.23 m", "1m 23cm", "1'-2\"" };

            CboLength.SelectedIndex    = 0;
            CboArea.SelectedIndex      = 0;
            CboPrecision.SelectedIndex = 2;
            CboFormat.SelectedIndex    = 0;

            UpdatePreview();
        }

        private void OnAnyComboChanged(object sender, SelectionChangedEventArgs e) => UpdatePreview();

        private void UpdatePreview()
        {
            TxtPreview.Text     = "12.34 m";
            TxtPreviewArea.Text = "152.00 m²";
        }

        private void BtnSave_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            DialogResult = true;
            Close();
        }

        private void BtnCancel_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            DialogResult = false;
            Close();
        }
    }

namespace CraneOptimizer.UI.Shared.Layouts
{
    public partial class TopNavigation : UserControl
    {
        public TopNavigation()
        {
            InitializeComponent();
        }

        private void Tab_Checked(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            // Guard: elements may not yet be ready during InitializeComponent
            if (PanelHome == null) return;

            // Hide all panels
            PanelHome.Visibility    = Visibility.Collapsed;
            PanelIFC.Visibility     = Visibility.Collapsed;
            PanelDXF.Visibility     = Visibility.Collapsed;
            PanelCranes.Visibility  = Visibility.Collapsed;
            PanelZones.Visibility   = Visibility.Collapsed;
            PanelAnalyze.Visibility = Visibility.Collapsed;

            // Show the selected panel
            if (sender == TabHome)    PanelHome.Visibility    = Visibility.Visible;
            if (sender == TabIFC)     PanelIFC.Visibility     = Visibility.Visible;
            if (sender == TabDXF)     PanelDXF.Visibility     = Visibility.Visible;
            if (sender == TabCranes)  PanelCranes.Visibility  = Visibility.Visible;
            if (sender == TabZones)   PanelZones.Visibility   = Visibility.Visible;
            if (sender == TabAnalyze) PanelAnalyze.Visibility = Visibility.Visible;
        }
    }

using CraneOptimizer.Domain.Entities;

namespace CraneOptimizer.UI.Shell.ViewModels
{
    public class MainViewModel : ViewModelBase, IDisposable
    {
        #region Fields
        private readonly IIfcReaderRepository _ifcReader;
        private readonly IRenderingService _render;
        private readonly ICraneRepository _craneRepo;
        private readonly IDialogService _dialog;
        private readonly ICranePlacementService _cranePlacementService;
        private Crane? _selectedCrane;
        private bool _disposed;
        public ISceneService Scene { get; }
        public CraneSetupViewModel CraneSetup { get; }
        #endregion

        #region Constructor
        public MainViewModel(
            ISceneService scene,
            DrawingViewModel drawing,
            CranePlacementViewModel cranePlacement,
            IfcViewerViewModel ifcViewer,
            DxfTabViewModel dxf,
            IIfcReaderRepository ifcReader,
            IRenderingService render,
            ICraneRepository craneRepo,
            IDialogService dialog,
            CraneSetupViewModel craneSetup,


            ICranePlacementService cranePlacementService)
        {
            Scene = scene;
            Drawing = drawing;
            CranePlacement = cranePlacement;
            IfcViewer = ifcViewer;
            Dxf = dxf;
            CraneSetup = craneSetup;

            _ifcReader = ifcReader;
            _render = render;
            _craneRepo = craneRepo;
            _dialog = dialog;
            _cranePlacementService = cranePlacementService;

            Scene.ElementsChanged += OnElementsChanged;

            OptimizeCommand = new RelayCommand(OpenOptimizerDialog);


            _ = LoadCranesAsync();

        }
        #endregion

        #region Collections
        // =========================
        // Collections
        // =========================
        public ObservableCollection<PrecastElement> Elements { get; } = new();
        public ObservableCollection<PrecastElement> FilteredElements { get; } = new();
        public ObservableCollection<Crane> Cranes { get; } = new();

        #endregion

        #region ViewModels
        public CranePlacementViewModel CranePlacement { get; }
        public DrawingViewModel Drawing { get; }
        public IfcViewerViewModel IfcViewer { get; }
        public DxfTabViewModel Dxf { get; }
        #endregion

        #region Commands
        public ICommand StartDrawingCommand { get; }
        public ICommand OptimizeCommand { get; }
        #endregion

        #region Crane Selected
        // =========================
        // Selected Crane
        // =========================
        public Crane? SelectedCrane
        {
            get => _selectedCrane;
            set
            {
                _selectedCrane = value;
                OnPropertyChanged();
                OnPropertyChanged(nameof(SelectedCraneSpec));

                CranePlacement.SelectedCrane = value;
                CraneSetup.SelectedCrane = value;
                StatusText = $"Crane Selected: {value?.Name}";
            }
        }

        public CraneSpecification? SelectedCraneSpec =>
            SelectedCrane?.Specifications.FirstOrDefault();
        #endregion

        #region GA_Run
        private void OpenOptimizerDialog()
        {
            var dialog = new CraneOptimizerDialog(
                _cranePlacementService,
                _render,
                _dialog,
                _craneRepo,
                Scene);

            if (System.Windows.Application.Current?.MainWindow != null)
                dialog.Owner = System.Windows.Application.Current.MainWindow;

            dialog.ShowDialog();

            if (dialog.LatestResult != null)
            {
                StatusText = "Optimization Completed";
                HistoryBreadcrumb = $"Best Fitness: {dialog.LatestResult.FitnessScore:F2}";
            }
        }
        #endregion

        #region Scene sync
        private void OnElementsChanged(List<PrecastElement> elements)
        {
            Elements.Clear();
            FilteredElements.Clear();

            foreach (var e in elements)
            {
                Elements.Add(e);
                FilteredElements.Add(e);
            }

            _render.Render(
                elements.Select(e => (e, (LiftStatus?)null)),
                new ElementVisualBuilder(),
                "Elements"
            );

            IsModelLoaded = true;
            StatusText = $"Model Loaded ({elements.Count} elements)";
        }
        #endregion

        #region Dispose
        public void Dispose()
        {
            if (_disposed) return;
            _disposed = true;

            Scene.ElementsChanged -= OnElementsChanged;
        }
        #endregion

        #region Status Properties
        private string _coordX = "0.00M";
        public string CoordX
        {
            get => _coordX;
            set { _coordX = value; OnPropertyChanged(); }
        }

        private string _coordY = "0.00M";
        public string CoordY
        {
            get => _coordY;
            set { _coordY = value; OnPropertyChanged(); }
        }

        private string _statusText = "Ready";
        public string StatusText
        {
            get => _statusText;
            set { _statusText = value; OnPropertyChanged(); }
        }

        private string _historyBreadcrumb = "No recent action";
        public string HistoryBreadcrumb
        {
            get => _historyBreadcrumb;
            set { _historyBreadcrumb = value; OnPropertyChanged(); }
        }

        private bool _isModelLoaded;
        public bool IsModelLoaded
        {
            get => _isModelLoaded;
            set { _isModelLoaded = value; OnPropertyChanged(); }
        }

        private string _selectedElementName = string.Empty;
        public string SelectedElementName
        {
            get => _selectedElementName;
            set { _selectedElementName = value; OnPropertyChanged(); }
        }

        private string _renderQualityLabel = "● STD";
        public string RenderQualityLabel
        {
            get => _renderQualityLabel;
            set { _renderQualityLabel = value; OnPropertyChanged(); }
        }
        #endregion

        #region Helpers
        public void SetCoordinates(double x, double y)
        {
            CoordX = $"{x:F2}M";
            CoordY = $"{y:F2}M";
        }

        private async Task LoadCranesAsync()
        {
            var cranes = await _craneRepo.GetAllWithSpecsAsync();
            Cranes.Clear();
            foreach (var c in cranes)
                Cranes.Add(c);
        }
        #endregion
    }
}

using System.Windows;
using System.Windows.Input;
using System.Windows.Media.Media3D;

namespace CraneOptimizer.UI.Shell.Views
{
    public partial class MainWindow : Window
    {
        private readonly IRenderingService _renderingService;
        private readonly ISceneService _sceneService;
        private CraneSetupViewModel? _craneSetup;
        // ← NEW

        public MainWindow(
            MainViewModel vm,
            IRenderingService renderingService,
            ISceneService sceneService,
            CraneSetupViewModel craneSetup)
        {
            InitializeComponent();

            _renderingService = renderingService;
            _sceneService = sceneService;
            _craneSetup = craneSetup;                // ← NEW


            DataContext = vm;

            _renderingService.Initialize(IfcViewer);

            IfcViewer.MouseLeftButtonDown += Viewport_MouseDown;
            IfcViewer.MouseMove += Viewport_MouseMove;
            IfcViewer.MouseLeftButtonUp += Viewport_MouseUp;

            #region DXF
            // Wire the DXF uploader to the same Helix viewport.
            // Mirrors the IRenderingService pattern — must be done after InitializeComponent.
            vm.Dxf.Initialize(IfcViewer);
            #endregion

            #region Zones Interaction
            _sceneService.ZoneAdded += OnZoneAdded;
            _sceneService.ZoneSelected += OnZoneSelected;
            _sceneService.ZoneRemoved += OnZoneChanged;
            _sceneService.ZoneUpdated += OnZoneChanged;
            _sceneService.ZonesCleared += OnZonesCleared;
            #endregion
        }

        private MainViewModel? VM => DataContext as MainViewModel;

        #region Zones Interaction

        private void OnZoneAdded(GreenAreaZone zone) => RenderZones();
        private void OnZoneSelected(GreenAreaZone? zone) => RenderZones();
        private void OnZoneChanged(GreenAreaZone zone) => RenderZones();

        private void OnZonesCleared()
        {
            RenderZones();
        }

        private void RenderZones()
        {
            _renderingService.Render(
                _sceneService.GetZones(),
                new ZoneVisualBuilder(_sceneService),
                "Zones"
            );
        }

        private void HandleZoneSelection(MouseButtonEventArgs e)
        {
            var viewport = IfcViewer;
            var hits = viewport.Viewport.FindHits(e.GetPosition(viewport));

            if (hits == null || hits.Count == 0)
            {
                _sceneService.SetSelectedZone(null);
                return;
            }

            foreach (var hit in hits)
            {
                var visual = hit.Visual;

                if (visual is ModelVisual3D mv &&
                    mv.GetValue(FrameworkElement.TagProperty) is GreenAreaZone zone)
                {
                    _sceneService.SetSelectedZone(zone);
                    return;
                }
            }

            _sceneService.SetSelectedZone(null);
        }

        #endregion

        protected override void OnClosed(EventArgs e)
        {
            #region Zones Interaction
            _sceneService.ZoneAdded -= OnZoneAdded;
            _sceneService.ZoneSelected -= OnZoneSelected;
            _sceneService.ZoneRemoved -= OnZoneChanged;
            _sceneService.ZoneUpdated -= OnZoneChanged;
            _sceneService.ZonesCleared -= OnZonesCleared;
            #endregion

            base.OnClosed(e);
        }

        #region Viewport Interaction

        private void IfcViewer_MouseMove(object sender, MouseEventArgs e)
        {
            var viewport = sender as HelixViewport3D;
            if (viewport == null) return;

            var vm = VM?.Drawing;

            if (vm == null || !vm.IsDrawing) return;

            var screen = e.GetPosition(viewport);
            var world = GetWorldPoint(viewport, screen);

            vm.SetHoverPoint(new DomainPoint3D(world.X, world.Y, world.Z));
        }

        private void IfcViewer_MouseDown(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
        {
            var viewport = sender as HelixViewport3D;
            if (viewport == null) return;

            var vm = VM?.Drawing;

            if (vm != null && !vm.IsDrawing)
            {
                HandleZoneSelection(e);
                return;
            }

            if (vm == null) return;

            if (e.ChangedButton == MouseButton.Right)
            {
                vm.Finish();
                e.Handled = true;
                return;
            }

            if (e.ChangedButton != MouseButton.Left)
                return;

            var screen = e.GetPosition(viewport);
            var world = GetWorldPoint(viewport, screen);

            vm.AddPoint(new DomainPoint3D(world.X, world.Y, world.Z));
            e.Handled = true;
        }

        #endregion

        #region Window Chrome + UI Events (required by XAML)

        private void TitleBar_MouseLeftButtonDown(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
        {
            DragMove();
        }

        private void MinimizeWindow_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            WindowState = WindowState.Minimized;
        }

        private void MaximizeWindow_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            WindowState = WindowState == WindowState.Maximized
                ? WindowState.Normal
                : WindowState.Maximized;
        }

        private void CloseWindow_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            Close();
        }

        private void BackToWelcome_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e) { }
        private void SaveProject_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e) { }
        private void UndoBtn_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e) { }
        private void RedoBtn_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e) { }
        private void ClearHistory_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e) { }
        private void BtnDimensionTool_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e) { }
        private void ElementItem_Click(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e) { }

        private void ResetCamera_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            IfcViewer?.CameraController?.ResetCamera();
        }

        private void IfcViewer_PreviewMouseWheel(object sender, MouseWheelEventArgs e) { }

        private void RenderQualityDropBtn_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            RenderQualityPopup.IsOpen = true;
        }

        private void RenderQuality_Changed(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e) { }

        private void OsnapDropBtn_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e)
        {
            OsnapPopup.IsOpen = true;
        }

        private void StatusOsnapMaster_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e) { }
        private void StatusOsnap_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e) { }

        private void ShowCommandPanel_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e) { }
        private void ShowLogsPanel_Click(object sender, RoutedEventArgs e) { }

        #endregion

        #region Helpers

        #region Dragging the Crane Visual   
        private Point3D GetWorldPoint(HelixViewport3D viewport, System.Windows.Point screenPt)
        {
            try
            {
                var hit = viewport.FindNearestPoint(screenPt);
                if (hit.HasValue)
                    return hit.Value;
            }
            catch { }

            try
            {
                bool ok = Viewport3DHelper.Point2DtoPoint3D(
                    viewport.Viewport,
                    screenPt,
                    out Point3D near,
                    out Point3D far);

                if (ok)
                {
                    var dir = far - near;

                    if (System.Math.Abs(dir.Z) > 1e-9)
                    {
                        double t = -near.Z / dir.Z;
                        if (t > 0)
                            return near + t * dir;
                    }
                }
            }
            catch { }

            return new Point3D();
        }
        private void Viewport_MouseDown(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
        {
            if (_craneSetup?.SelectedCrane == null) return;

            // HelixTool's FindHits() performs a 3D ray-cast from the mouse position
            // and returns all 3D objects under the cursor.
            var mousePos = e.GetPosition(IfcViewer);
            var hits = Viewport3DHelper.FindHits(IfcViewer.Viewport, mousePos);

            // Check if any hit belongs to the crane layer
            if (hits != null && hits.Count > 0)
            {
                // The crane visual was clicked → begin drag
                _craneSetup.BeginDrag();
                IfcViewer.CaptureMouse(); // keep receiving events even if mouse leaves viewport
                e.Handled = true;         // prevent HelixTool's default camera rotation
            }
        }
        private void Viewport_MouseMove(object sender, MouseEventArgs e)
        {
            if (_craneSetup == null || !_craneSetup.IsDraggingActive) return;

            var worldPoint = ScreenToGroundPlane(e.GetPosition(IfcViewer));
            if (worldPoint == null) return;

            // Convert WPF Point3D to your domain type
            var domainPoint = new DomainPoint3D(worldPoint.Value.X, worldPoint.Value.Y, 0);

            // Update drag (includes zone constraint check)
            var zones = VM?.Scene.GetZones() ?? new List<GreenAreaZone>();
            _craneSetup.UpdateDrag(domainPoint, zones);

            // Show live coordinates in status bar
            VM?.SetCoordinates(domainPoint.X, domainPoint.Y);
            e.Handled = true;
        }

        // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
        // MOUSE UP — finish drag
        // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
        private void Viewport_MouseUp(object sender, MouseButtonEventArgs e)
        {
            if (_craneSetup == null || !_craneSetup.IsDraggingActive) return;

            var zones = VM?.Scene.GetZones() ?? new List<GreenAreaZone>();
            _craneSetup.EndDrag(zones);

            IfcViewer.ReleaseMouseCapture();
            e.Handled = true;
        }

        // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
        // COORDINATE CONVERSION: Screen pixel → 3D ground plane point
        // ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
        /// <summary>
        /// Converts a 2D mouse position (screen pixels) into a 3D point on the
        /// ground plane (Z = 0) using ray-plane intersection.
        ///
        /// How it works:
        ///   1. HelixTool shoots a ray from the camera through the mouse pixel.
        ///   2. We find where that ray intersects the Z=0 horizontal plane.
        ///   3. That intersection is the "world position" under the cursor.
        /// </summary>
        private Point3D? ScreenToGroundPlane(System.Windows.Point mousePos)
        {
            // Point2DtoRay3D: HelixTool converts screen position → 3D ray
            var ray = IfcViewer.Viewport.Point2DtoRay3D(mousePos);
            if (ray == null) return null;

            // PlaneIntersection: find where the ray hits Z=0 plane
            // Parameters: a point on the plane (origin), the plane normal (Z-up)
            return ray.PlaneIntersection(
                new Point3D(0, 0, 0),
                new Vector3D(0, 0, 1)
            );
        }
        #endregion
        #endregion
 

    }
}
